title: Lead Software Engineer - Paris
description: <p><strong>Présentation du poste :</strong></p> <p>Au sein de l’équipe technique d’Artefact, vous rejoignez une communauté de Software Engineers en tant que Manager et référent technique auprès de nos grands comptes clients. Dans un environnement à forte accélération sur la Data et l’IA Générative, vous intervenez pour piloter des projets d'ingénierie complexes, encadrer les équipes et porter l'excellence opérationnelle et technique.</p> <p><strong>Ce qu’on attend de vous :</strong></p> <p>En tant que Manager, vous supervisez la conception et le déploiement d'architectures critiques (Data Platforms, Agentic Platforms) tout en assurant l'encadrement, le mentorat et le développement de carrières des membres de l'équipe. Vous jouez un rôle clé dans la relation client, le cadrage technique des affaires et le rayonnement de la communauté tech Artefact.</p> <p><strong>Vos missions :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Piloter et encadrer la réalisation de projets Data & IA complexes (ex. solutions multi-agents LangGraph sur Kubernetes, architectures Médaillon).</li> <li>Superviser le cadrage et la construction de Data Platforms robustes sur GCP, AWS, Azure ou Snowflake en garantissant l'alignement avec les meilleures pratiques d'Infrastructure as Code (IaC) et d'ingénierie logicielle.</li> <li>Définir la vision technique des projets GenAI / LLM (orchestration, évaluation, contrôle) et promouvoir l'usage quotidien des coding agents au sein des équipes.</li> <li>Assurer la gestion de carrière, le suivi de performance et le mentoring continu des Software Engineers sous votre responsabilité.</li> <li>Mener les cadrages techniques auprès des clients grands comptes et défendre avec pédagogie les choix stratégiques et d'architecture.</li> <li>Veiller au respect des standards de qualité de code, de sécurité et de livrables sur l'ensemble de vos périmètres applicatifs.</li> <li>Contribuer activement à l'animation de la communauté technique (Talks Tech, Guildes, REX) et participer au processus de recrutement et de montée en compétences de la pratique.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Profil recherché :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Expérience & Leadership :</strong> Expérience confirmée en tant que Lead / Engineering Manager ou Senior Architect ayant déjà encadré des équipes techniques et piloté des projets stratégiques.</li> <li><strong>Résolution de problèmes :</strong> Solides intuitions techniques et capacité à traduire des enjeux business complexes en architectures techniques pérennes.</li> <li><strong>Management & Transmission :</strong> Posture bienveillante, pédagogique et exemplaire, à l'aise pour faire grandir les talents, donner du feedback constructif et animer une équipe.</li> <li><strong>Spécialisations (au moins 1) :</strong> Expertise avérée en Analytics Engineering, Software Development, SRE, Cloud Architecture ou AI Engineering.</li> <li><strong>Stack technique :</strong> Maîtrise avancée de l'écosystème tech (Python, FastAPI, dbt, LangGraph, Docker, Terraform, GCP, AWS, Azure, Snowflake, Kubernetes).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Process de recrutement :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>HR Interview (30-45 min) :</strong> Échange sur votre parcours, vos compétences managériales et l'adéquation culturelle avec un Talent Acquisition Specialist.</li> <li><strong>Technical Deep Dive (60 min) :</strong> Session de live coding et d'architecture system design avec un Senior Engineering Lead basé en France.</li> <li><strong>US / Manager Interview (60 min) :</strong> Échange avec un Director / Partner pour évaluer le fit managérial, opérationnel et la posture client.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Rémunération :</strong> Package :  75 000 € à 85 000 € brut annuel (fixe) + 8 000 € de variable, selon expérience et séniorité.</p> <p><strong>Présentation de l’entreprise</strong></p> <p>Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable.</p> <p>A la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients.</p> <p>Envie d'en savoir plus? Découvrez Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : <a href="https://www.artefact.com/">https://www.artefact.com</a></p> <p> </p> <p><em>Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l'adéquation avec le rôle.</em></p> <p><br><br><br></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer  - Distributed Systems (Applied AI)
location: Bordeaux; Grenoble; Lyon; Montpellier; Nantes; Nice; Paris; Sophia Antipolis
description: <p>At Datadog, Batch Engineering owns something most engineers only dream about: a domain. They are responsible for the systems that apply signal finding models at scale, and are looking for a senior backend engineer to own and grow this space from our Paris hub.</p> <p>You'd be architecting the scalable systems that power both internal data science and external customers, while building influence over a team that's tackling real, meaty infrastructure problems every day. The core here is Kafka and Flink while collaborating with data scientists on signal systems that work at scale. Most backend engineers work in one or the other; you'd own both end-to-end.</p> <p><em>At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships that it builds, the creativity it brings to the table, and the collaboration of being together. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our employees can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.</em></p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, build, and operate the backend systems that apply signal finding models at scale for internal data science teams and external customers.</li> <li>Own Kafka and Flink components end to end, from architecture and implementation through production reliability, performance, and evolution.</li> <li>Partner with data scientists to turn models and signal requirements into robust production workflows.</li> <li>Improve the scalability, observability, and operational resilience of data processing systems as usage grows.</li> <li>Lead technical decisions in your domain, collaborate across engineering teams, and help other engineers grow through design reviews and mentorship.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have significant backend engineering experience building and operating distributed systems in production.</li> <li>You have hands-on experience with Kafka and Flink, including designing or improving data processing pipelines at scale.</li> <li>You can reason through tradeoffs in throughput, latency, reliability, and maintainability, and turn those decisions into clear designs and working code.</li> <li>You enjoy collaborating with data scientists and engineering partners to translate open-ended requirements into dependable systems.</li> <li>You can take ownership of a technical area while sharing context, reviewing designs, and supporting the growth of teammates.</li> <li>You’re curious about using AI tools to improve how you build software and able to evaluate their output critically.</li> </ul> <p><em>Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.</em></p> <p><strong>Benefits and Growth</strong></p> <ul> <li>New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)</li> <li>Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing</li> <li>Intradepartmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking</li> <li>An inclusive company culture, ability to join our Community Guilds (Datadog employee resource groups)</li> <li>Access to Inclusion Talks, our internal panel discussions</li> <li>Free, global mental health benefits for employees and dependents age 6+</li> <li>Competitive global benefits</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>About Datadog: </strong></p> <p>Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. title: Lead Software Engineer - Paris
description: <p><strong>Présentation du poste :</strong></p> <p>Au sein de l’équipe technique d’Artefact, vous rejoignez une communauté de Software Engineers en tant que Manager et référent technique auprès de nos grands comptes clients. Dans un environnement à forte accélération sur la Data et l’IA Générative, vous intervenez pour piloter des projets d'ingénierie complexes, encadrer les équipes et porter l'excellence opérationnelle et technique.</p> <p><strong>Ce qu’on attend de vous :</strong></p> <p>En tant que Manager, vous supervisez la conception et le déploiement d'architectures critiques (Data Platforms, Agentic Platforms) tout en assurant l'encadrement, le mentorat et le développement de carrières des membres de l'équipe. Vous jouez un rôle clé dans la relation client, le cadrage technique des affaires et le rayonnement de la communauté tech Artefact.</p> <p><strong>Vos missions :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Piloter et encadrer la réalisation de projets Data & IA complexes (ex. solutions multi-agents LangGraph sur Kubernetes, architectures Médaillon).</li> <li>Superviser le cadrage et la construction de Data Platforms robustes sur GCP, AWS, Azure ou Snowflake en garantissant l'alignement avec les meilleures pratiques d'Infrastructure as Code (IaC) et d'ingénierie logicielle.</li> <li>Définir la vision technique des projets GenAI / LLM (orchestration, évaluation, contrôle) et promouvoir l'usage quotidien des coding agents au sein des équipes.</li> <li>Assurer la gestion de carrière, le suivi de performance et le mentoring continu des Software Engineers sous votre responsabilité.</li> <li>Mener les cadrages techniques auprès des clients grands comptes et défendre avec pédagogie les choix stratégiques et d'architecture.</li> <li>Veiller au respect des standards de qualité de code, de sécurité et de livrables sur l'ensemble de vos périmètres applicatifs.</li> <li>Contribuer activement à l'animation de la communauté technique (Talks Tech, Guildes, REX) et participer au processus de recrutement et de montée en compétences de la pratique.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Profil recherché :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Expérience & Leadership :</strong> Expérience confirmée en tant que Lead / Engineering Manager ou Senior Architect ayant déjà encadré des équipes techniques et piloté des projets stratégiques.</li> <li><strong>Résolution de problèmes :</strong> Solides intuitions techniques et capacité à traduire des enjeux business complexes en architectures techniques pérennes.</li> <li><strong>Management & Transmission :</strong> Posture bienveillante, pédagogique et exemplaire, à l'aise pour faire grandir les talents, donner du feedback constructif et animer une équipe.</li> <li><strong>Spécialisations (au moins 1) :</strong> Expertise avérée en Analytics Engineering, Software Development, SRE, Cloud Architecture ou AI Engineering.</li> <li><strong>Stack technique :</strong> Maîtrise avancée de l'écosystème tech (Python, FastAPI, dbt, LangGraph, Docker, Terraform, GCP, AWS, Azure, Snowflake, Kubernetes).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Process de recrutement :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>HR Interview (30-45 min) :</strong> Échange sur votre parcours, vos compétences managériales et l'adéquation culturelle avec un Talent Acquisition Specialist.</li> <li><strong>Technical Deep Dive (60 min) :</strong> Session de live coding et d'architecture system design avec un Senior Engineering Lead basé en France.</li> <li><strong>US / Manager Interview (60 min) :</strong> Échange avec un Director / Partner pour évaluer le fit managérial, opérationnel et la posture client.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Rémunération :</strong> Package :  75 000 € à 85 000 € brut annuel (fixe) + 8 000 € de variable, selon expérience et séniorité.</p> <p><strong>Présentation de l’entreprise</strong></p> <p>Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable.</p> <p>A la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients.</p> <p>Envie d'en savoir plus? Découvrez Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : <a href="https://www.artefact.com/">https://www.artefact.com</a></p> <p> </p> <p><em>Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l'adéquation avec le rôle.</em></p> <p><br><br><br></p> <p> </p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Commercial Support Associate
description: Location: Berlin , hybrid (2-3 days per week in our office) Hi, we're AMBOSS and we're searching for a Commercial Support Associate to support how we manage tenders, vendor registrations, and customer assurance requests for our institutional customers. About AMBOSS AMBOSS is the copilot for medical professionals, empowering them to provide the best possible care through our learning and clinical decision support tool. Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology. Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2012 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we've grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town. Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique. Why can this position be exciting for you? In this role, you'll coordinate the tenders, vendor registrations, and documentation requests that let institutional and business customers say yes to AMBOSS. You'll sit at the center of the company, working closely with Sales and pulling in expertise from IT, Legal, Finance, Product, Security, and Engineering to get every request answered accurately and on time. Every tender we win and every questionnaire we complete well helps bring AMBOSS into more hospitals, health systems, and medical schools: directly supporting our mission of empowering medical professionals to provide the best possible care. You'll start with structured, recurring processes and grow into someone institutional customers and internal teams alike rely on to get things done. You will: Support tender and procurement processes, coordinating the company information, documentation, and internal contributions they require. Complete and maintain customer vendor registrations and onboarding requirements in procurement and vendor-management systems. Coordinate documentation and information requests from Sales and from prospective or existing customers. Maintain commonly requested company documents and keep current, approved versions easily accessible. Track requests, deadlines, dependencies, and outstanding contributions from internal stakeholders. Identify and coordinate with the right subject-matter experts across IT, Legal, Finance, Product, Engineering, Security, and other teams. Support completion of customer questionnaires covering company information, technology, privacy, AI, security, and compliance topics. Help document and improve internal processes so recurring commercial and customer-assurance requests can be handled more efficiently. You bring: First professional experience in operations, administration, sales support, customer support, project coordination, or another structured cross-functional role; relevant internship or working-student experience also welcome. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Experience managing multiple requests, stakeholders, and deadlines at the same time. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English (C1) and German (C1). Ability to work independently while knowing when to ask questions or escalate. Comfort reaching out to colleagues across departments and following up on outstanding information. Nice to have: previous exposure to tenders, procurement portals, vendor onboarding, customer questionnaires, or documentation management. You enjoy: Structured, detail-oriented work and keeping track of many moving pieces at once. Coordinating with people across different teams to get to an answer. Learning unfamiliar terminology and processes quickly. Gradually taking ownership of recurring workflows and making them run more smoothly. Benefits: AMBOSSians tell us that innovative work keeps them energized and employee benefits help them to feel appreciated and empowered. We invest in every AMBOSSian with our employee benefits package, crafted to support financial, physical, and mental health, and work-life harmony. 🌴 Rest & Time Off (30 paid vacation days, AMBOSS holiday, personal purpose day and more) 🥙 Food & Office Comfort (Daily healthy breakfast & lunch by in-house chef in Berlin HQ, AMBOSS daycare, work remotely from other office spaces in Cologne, Sardinia, Cape Town) 🏃 Health, Fitness & Mobility (Urban Sports Club – M plan, Fitbit Versa 3, Deutschland Ticket…) Check out the full list of benefits below: https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de We believe that diversity is a powerful driver of innovation and progress. That's why we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive environment where everyone—regardless of gender, age, ethnic or cultural background, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity—is valued and given equal opportunity to thrive. We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfil our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care 🩺 Even if you don't meet every single point in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. We'd love to hear from you! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Risk Management Specialist (f/m/x)
description: About lemon.markets 🍋 We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers. lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months. As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market. Your Mission As Senior Risk Management Specialist, you will help scale and further develop lemon.markets’ Risk Management Framework in a period of growing regulatory expectations, business complexity, and organisational maturity. Sitting within the Risk team and working closely with the Head of Risk, you will take over meaningful responsibilities across multiple risk domains and help ensure our controls, assessments, and governance evolve with the company. Over the next 6 to 12 months, your focus will be on strengthening risk processes across operational and non-financial risk topics, contributing to financial risk topics such as ICAAP and ILAAP, and improving the structure, transparency, and efficiency of our risk tooling and reporting. This role matters because strong, pragmatic risk management is a core enabler of scalable growth in a regulated Brokerage-as-a-Service business. You will work across Product, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, and other stakeholders to turn regulatory and risk requirements into practical, tech-enabled solutions that reduce manual work and improve decision-making. It is a strong opportunity for someone who combines broad risk knowledge with a hands-on mindset and wants to help build a mature framework in a fast-moving environment. In this role you will: Own the identification, assessment, and documentation of risks across key domains together with the Risk team, business stakeholders, and control owners, so lemon.markets can make informed decisions and maintain a resilient risk profile as the business grows. Drive risk assessments, control testing, and issue remediation tracking with teams across Product, Engineering, Operations, and Compliance, so we can detect weaknesses early, strengthen controls, and follow through on corrective actions. Maintain and improve our internal control framework, risk register, and operational risk procedures in close collaboration with the Head of Risk and cross-functional stakeholders, so our framework remains effective, usable, and aligned with business and regulatory needs. Contribute to risk topics across operational and non-financial risk, financial risk, ICAAP, ILAAP, third-party risk, and security-related assessments, so we can build a broader and more integrated view of risk across the organisation. Draft clear business and technical requirements for process improvements, tooling enhancements, and automation initiatives with Product, Engineering, and Operations, so we can increase risk transparency, improve reporting quality, and reduce manual work. Collaborate with auditors, supervisory stakeholders, and internal teams on evidence gathering, incident analysis, root-cause identification, and follow-up actions, so lemon.markets stays audit-ready and continues to improve the effectiveness of its risk management practices. You’ll be successful in this role if you: You bring strong hands-on experience in Risk Management within FinTech, banking, audit, consulting, or a similarly regulated environment, with broad exposure across multiple risk domains. You have solid knowledge of operational and non-financial risk, internal controls, risk governance, and risk assessments, plus a good understanding of financial risk topics such as credit, market, liquidity, ICAAP, and ILAAP. You are familiar with the relevant regulatory foundations, including MaRisk, DORA, CRR, IFR, and applicable EBA and ESMA guidelines; knowledge of MiFID, MaComp, and WpHG is a strong plus. You are confident working with risk management tools, structured documentation, reporting, testing, and validation, and you are comfortable translating requirements into pragmatic process or tooling improvements. You communicate clearly in English, and bring professional working proficiency in German to navigate regulatory documents and stakeholder communication in a German market context. You are hands-on, analytical, and collaborative: you enjoy building, improving, and following through, work well across functions, and stay effective in fast-moving or sometimes ambiguous environments. How we take care of you 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets. 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration. 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributor lemoneers work 4 days or more and leadership lemoneers work 7 days or more per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites, or over team dinners. 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations, as well as an annual learning budget. 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like Polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day and our monthly new-joiner breakfasts. But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate. 💛 Perks & benefits: We choose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing. 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total. As an equal opportunity employer, lemon.markets is committed to building an inclusive workplace. The company welcomes people from all different backgrounds, including age, citizenship, ethnic and racial origins, gender identities, individuals with disabilities, marital status, religions and ideologies, and sexual orientations to apply. If you feel this role could be a great match for you even if you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you, please apply. You have any questions? title: Working Student – Control System Support (f/m/d)
description: About Focused Energy Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies. Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally. Your Role Focused Energy is seeking a Working Student - Control System Support (f/m/d) to join the control-system team within our Laser organization. In this role, you will work directly with our control systems engineers on the practical, hands-on aspects of building and testing the systems that operate our laser platforms. Your responsibilities will include implementation support, testing, debugging, documentation, and following up on issues until they are resolved. This position offers a unique opportunity to work closely with real experimental hardware and control-system engineering in a company tackling one of the most challenging problems in energy. What You'll Do Support the control-system team with implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation of control-system components. Help investigate issues affecting system progress and follow them through to resolution. Maintain and improve control-system documentation, test records, interface descriptions, I/O lists, cable schedules, wiring documentation, test procedures, and commissioning records. Work closely with electrical, mechanical, controls, and laser engineers to bring an instrumentation system for high energy lasers into reliable operation. title: Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d)
description: Agora Industry Are you passionate about biomass feedstocks as a means to decarbonise heavy industry applications? Do you bring expertise in the technical, economic and climate policy aspects of biomass availability, processing and use? Are you excited to work in a diverse, multi-disciplinary and international team? Then, this is the perfect opportunity for you! Reaching a climate-neutral industry will require unprecedented investments in a wide range of GHG mitigation technologies, due to the sector’s inherent complexity and regional diversity. While a significant share of emissions can be reduced by advancing energy efficiency and expanding direct electrification powered by renewable energy, there is also the need for more complex and costly measures as well as alternative feedstocks for processes, where biomass and hydrogen technologies can be implemented. To tap into this potential, climate-effective biomass uses in industry require thorough understanding of availability and costs across different regions to give recommendations on policies that help to decarbonise industry in a competitive way, incorporating ecological sustainability boundaries. Under the umbrella of the Agora Think Tanks, Agora Industry develops politically feasible and science-based strategies and solutions for the transformation to climate neutrality – in Germany, Europe, and internationally. As a think tank and policy lab we facilitate a productive exchange of ideas amongst stakeholders from politics, business, science and civil society. As a non-partisan, non-profit organisation funded by foundations and public institutions, we are independent of corporate and partisan interests. Our exclusive mission is to serve the climate and the common good.To strengthen our team, we are looking for a Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d) Full- or part-time (min. 32 hours)– based in Berlin You will work on the supply side of biomass as a feedstock for hard-to-electrify applications in industry. The geographical scope will be global, covering different conditions and contexts that vary across geographies. This position is part of Agora Industry’s central Technologies & Analysis team, working closely with regional teams. Your responsibilities include Contributing to the development and implementation of international projects focused on climate-effective biomass solutions for industrial decarbonisation, encompassing farm- and forest-level availability, logistics and conversion technologies, as well as biomass supply for industrial carbon dioxide removal (CDR). Analysing biomass supply costs, availability and potentials for different agriculture and forestry products across multiple geographies, taking into account competing uses in different sectors and market implications. Conducting and coordinating projects on biomass for industrial applications and related technological enablers and policy support mechanisms Analysing policy and regulatory gaps that hinder biomass use in various regions with a focus on economic, regulatory, and governance frameworks. Monitoring the development of technology and business models related to the scaling, mobilization and system integration of biomass value chains and logistics. Supporting stakeholder engagement with policymakers, industry, civil society, funders, among others, to inform discussions around biomass applications across different industry sectors. Pro-actively contributing to building partnerships and working closely with network partners across the globe. Liaising with expert colleagues across the Agora Think Tanks (including Agora Agriculture) to facilitate their contributions to projects and knowledge sharing across different regions. Actively contributing to internal discussions. Managing subcontractors including preparing agreements and work plans, supervising and guiding project progress, and managing the quality of deliverables. As Project Officer, the focus is on contributing to the technical management of specific projects with smaller budget, largely independent research, contributing to the conceptualisation and development of complex topics, and of project-related reporting and communication. As Project Manager , the focus is on technical management and responsibility for specific projects with smaller budgets, independent comprehensive research, conceptualisation and development of complex topics, technical supervision of students and interns, and project-related reporting and communication. We are looking for A Master’s degree in energy, environmental engineering or forestry/agriculture engineering, natural sciences, renewable energies, agricultural economist, or similar As Project Officer : Preferably 2 years of experience (including internships, student work or post-graduate roles) in the field of quantitative analysis of biomass systems. As Project Manager : At least 4 years of overall professional experience, with 2 years specifically in the field of biomass A proven track record and expertise in biomass supply cost, transport logistics and conversion technologies. Solid knowledge of the farming and forestry sectors. Familiarity with agricultural systems and ideally forest systems in different world regions is a plus. Good background understanding of industrial transformation is a plus. Experience with Life-Cycle Assessment is a plus. Familiarity with sustainable biomass certification and deforestation-free frameworks is a plus. Strong networking skills and the ability to engage with business, industry associations, research partners and policy makers. A creative and result-oriented mind, capable of developing new ideas and proposals with a view to having impact. Outstanding communication skills, both verbal and written; track-record in writing high quality documents. Full command of the English language in reading and writing, knowledge of other languages is a plus. Willingness to travel outside Europe. We assume that there are excellent candidates for the job who do not meet all the criteria in the description. Maybe you have certain skills we haven’t thought of yet? Tell us why you are the right person for the job. What we offer An opportunity to work in a mission-driven, highly motivated, and professional international team. Opportunities for professional growth and advancement; including access to a mental well-being platform. Flexible working hours and a hybrid work environment, with access to an attractive office space in central Berlin and a good setup to work from home. Weekly breakfast, team events and other get-togethers with colleagues from around the globe. One option from our benefit basket (e.g. job ticket, shopping vouchers, Urban Sports, etc.). Opportunities for professional and personal development and advancement. Entitlement of 29 paid leave days per year (5-days working week); 24th & 31st December off-work. A cooperative working atmosphere with flat communication and decision-making hierarchies. Assistance with visa and work permits for international candidates if required. A structured onboarding programme and regular team and organisation-wide retreats to bring us all together; and A full or part-time role, initially limited to two years. How to apply We assume that there are excellent candidates for the job who do not meet all the criteria in the description. Maybe you have certain skills we haven’t thought of yet? Tell us why you are the right person for the job. We look forward to receiving your application by 30th of September 2026 via our website. For reasons of objectivity, we ask that you refrain from submitting an application photo. We want an energy transition for everyone from everyone. Therefore, we are particularly pleased to receive applications from people from groups that have been underrepresented in energy and industrial policy. We welcome applications regardless of gender and gender identity, nationality, ethnic origin, religion or belief, disability and age, and sexual orientation. Our offices are not completely barrier-free, but we are open to find individual solutions. As part of this, we are soliciting anonymous information on a voluntary basis regarding our applicant’s background. Your input will not be forwarded to third parties and will not be used in connection with your application. title: Senior Software Engineer - Paris
description: About H: When we released Holo4 on 28 September, we published every trajectory behind its public benchmark scores at trajectories.hcompany.ai . For OSWorld that's 369 desktop tasks, each run 3 times, with the steps, tokens and time of every attempt. This role builds and runs the evaluation framework that produces runs like these. H builds computer-use agents and the models behind them. Developers use them through a managed API , and our forward deployed engineers take them into enterprise workflows. What this team owns The evaluation framework: orchestration, runtimes and observability. Researchers and forward deployed engineers bring the benchmarks, across web apps, desktop applications and the command line. Your job is to make the framework that runs them reliable, fast and cheap, and to make adding a new one quick. Research uses the results to choose checkpoints and decide whether a model ships. Product and the forward deployed engineers use them to measure agents on customer workflows. It carries roughly 50 benchmarks now. That number should be between 100 and 200 soon, and the framework has to keep up. What you'd be doing Integration support for researchers and forward deployed engineers bringing in a benchmark, with a shorter path each time. Setting the standard for how a benchmark enters the framework, and building the checks that enforce it. Scheduling and observability, so cluster capacity isn't left idle while evaluation jobs queue. Reproducible results across trials, so a release decision rests on numbers that hold. Whatever stack a benchmark calls for. One week that's cluster tuning; the next it's a browser extension or desktop environments. Time with customers, from single developers to large companies, to find out what they want measured, then automating it so the results flow back into our harnesses and models. The first few months By 3 months you'll have helped researchers or forward deployed engineers integrate 5 benchmarks, and started fixing what slows the framework down. By 6 months one part of it is yours, for example scaling the runs, observability, or a group of related benchmarks, and a release will have gone out on your numbers. By 12 months you'll know the design and trade-offs of the whole evaluation system, and be the person the rest of H asks about evaluations. Who you'd work with Ceiran Chapman, our VP Engineering, is hiring for this role. You'd join the evaluation team. The people relying on your work day to day are H's researchers and forward deployed engineers. What we think it takes Likely a good fit if you Have spent 5+ years in backend development, with production Python at the core, and use coding agents to go faster without letting quality drop. Have built test, QA or evaluation tooling that other teams depended on, and care whether a number is right. Have operated distributed systems on Kubernetes in a public cloud. AWS experience helps most. Have built and shipped systems end to end, including APIs (REST or GraphQL) and integrations with outside services. Know relational and non-relational databases, and message queues such as SQS, RabbitMQ or Kafka. Instrument what you build, with metrics, tracing and monitoring from the start. Stronger still if you have Measured LLM quality before, or built agents yourself. Packaged and run workloads in Docker and on virtual machines. Used Temporal, Dask, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Grafana or Datadog. Automated web or desktop software with Playwright, Selenium or a browser extension you wrote. Set standards other engineers follow, through code review, design review or mentoring. You do not need a background in machine learning. We'll work that out with you. If you match most of this but not all of it, apply anyway. How we hire A 30 minute call with our Talent team, a 60 minute technical challenge, a 60 minute system design interview, and a 30 minute final conversation with Ceiran. About 3.5 hours in total. Practicalities Paris posting: Hybrid in Paris. That means 3 office days a week and a London trip about once every 4 to 6 weeks. There is a London posting for the same role. We offer a competitive package. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Automation Lead
description: About us, and our mission At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with a large cohort of patient-derived tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical outcomes, validate therapies and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we aim to make drug development smarter, faster and more personalized. We collaborate with leading hospitals, research institutes and pharmaceutical companies. Backed by leading investors, Orakl is a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of biology, automation and AI. Position overview Orakl runs a high-throughput 3D cell‑culture platform to culture patient-derived organoids (PDOs). These patient-derived specimens reveal critical information into the patient disease, but require heavy maintenance work. Automating these workflows will be critical to improve the reliability and traceability of experimental work. We are hiring our first automation lead to build the Automation function from scratch. This is a high ownership and high autonomy job. You will map our processes, decide what to automate and what to leave alone, specify and source the equipment, negotiate with vendors and integrators, commission the machines, run them with the lab team, and hire the people the function needs. As the ideal candidate, you have already put automated lines or special machines into service, and you know what typically breaks between commissioning and the first experimental runs. While previous experience in biology is a plus, it is not a strict requirement: you will be taught all you need to know. However, you do need a proven experience in working deeply embedded in interdisciplinary teams. Key responsibilities Map cell culture workflows end to end and identify key process automation and optimisation opportunities. Own the automation roadmap. Present and lead the implementation of the major decisions to Orakl’s leadership. In line with the automation strategy you will have identified, evaluate vendors and integrators. Write user requirement specifications, acceptance criteria and interface requirements for each project. Negotiate price, scope, delivery, acceptance, support and consumables terms autonomously within agreed thresholds. Lead design reviews and factory and site acceptance tests. Translate our proprietary cell culture protocols into automated machine execution with our team of cell biologists and scientists. Track machine availability, hands-on time per line, interventions, failures and recovery time. Use the data to decide the next step. Coordinate with Orakl’s management to anticipate future automation needs on the platform and adjust the roadmap accordingly. Hire and develop the automation technicians and engineers the roadmap needs. Set the standards for the automated platform: documentation, quality control, safety, qualification, change control, vendor management. In this role you will collaborate closely with our cell culture, cell biology and data science teams. You will be at the heart of Orakl Oncology’s capabilities roadmap and help generate unprecedented amounts of biological data to power scientific discovery in cancer. Key qualifications Must-have Engineering degree (generalist, robotics, industrial, mechanical or process engineering) or equivalent, and at least eight years of experience. Exceptional process thinking skills: you map flows, time operations, find bottlenecks and question the processes. Experience in supplier negotiation and budget ownership on your own projects. Experience in PLC and robot programming concepts, scheduling software, instrument interfaces, basic scripting. You enjoy and are comfortable spending time on the floor with operators. You have experience in communicating and operating with engineers, technicians and workers at the heart of production processes. Autonomy: you tell your manager what you decided and why, not what you need decided. Fluency in English is required. Nice-to-have You have put automated lines, cells or special machines into service end to end: requirements, vendor selection, negotiation, integration, factory and site acceptance, ramp-up, budget. This doesn’t have to be in a lab environment : plant, food and fermentation, pharma or cosmetics are other examples of relevant experience. Automation in life-science or regulated environments: cell culture, biotech, food and fermentation, pharma, cleanroom or BSL-2 work. A working understanding of cell culture and what it demands: sterility, contamination risk, variability between samples, and steps governed by the biological pace. Liquid handling, plate-based workflows, incubators and imagers; laboratory scheduling software. Experience hiring and leading an automation team. What we offer You will be Orakl's first automation hire. You will have a unique degree of ownership and scope with a strong mandate to deliver. Short decision lines and fast execution. An interdisciplinary environment with a results-driven culture. Recruitment process Introductory call with Talent / People — 20 minutes Interview with the Lab Director, hiring manager — 45 minutes, including a 15-minute live mini-case on a small lab process Technical deep dive with the CTO and the Lab Director Case study on a real part of our lab: a take-home capped at four hours, then a half day on site with presentation, challenge round, lab walk. Cross-functional interviews with the technicians who run the culture, Platform Operations, the Senior Laboratory Engineers and the Data team — 60 minutes Reference calls: a former manager, a vendor or integrator you negotiated with, and an operator who ran a line you delivered Founder conversation — 45 minutes Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Solutions Architect, Defence, DACH
description: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Why this role? In this role as a Solutions Architect (SA) for Cohere in the DACH region, you will play an instrumental part in growing Cohere’s defence business across Germany, Austria, Switzerland and the wider European region, with Germany as the main focus. You will partner with account executives, our partner ecosystem and executive leadership to help the region's defence and security organisations adopt AI securely and at scale, building on Cohere's success with organisations in defence and the public sector. These customers need AI that runs on their own infrastructure, often air-gapped or at the tactical edge, and that can handle classified information. SAs at Cohere sit at the cross-section of Forward Deployed Engineering and AI transformation. Our SAs embody the following traits: Technical experts in the field Trusted advisors to customers and colleagues Product evangelists of Cohere technology Thought leaders in pushing the frontiers of applied AI Responsibilities include developing a deep understanding of customer problems, mapping them to Cohere solutions, and working closely with our partners as the trusted technical advisor who owns the technical relationship with our stakeholders. By leveraging your expertise, you will help to increase the adoption of Cohere products, both internally and externally, and will gather valuable insights and feedback from customers to help shape the future of our products. In this dynamic and demanding role, you will need to be both a strategic thinker and a builder. You will personally lead the design and deployment of customer pilots that showcase the impact of our technology to strategic enterprise and government customers. You will own the customer's technical narrative end to end, from discovery and architecture to pilot results and business case, and bring structured customer feedback back to our Product and Engineering teams. A typical day at Cohere might include: Leading the technical talk track on customer calls. Designing enterprise architectures for North deployments, including on-prem, air-gapped and sovereign cloud setups that meet German and EU requirements such as GDPR, BSI C5 and the EU AI Act. Designing for classified and disconnected environments (VS-NfD and above, air-gapped, DDIL and tactical edge), together with the customer's IT security and accreditation teams. Deep dives on customer queries and Cohere technology. Working with customer executives to prioritise use cases, define success metrics and build the business case for AI adoption. Translating defence and operational requirements into AI use cases, from logistics, maintenance and training to intelligence analysis and staff work. Facilitating customer evaluations and pilots inside their stack Owning the technical response of RFPs and public tenders, including defence procurement, from security questionnaires to mapping the customer's requirements specification (Lastenheft) to our solution. Developing and documenting processes to enable the solutions architect team and adjacent teams to scale effectively within Cohere. Collaborating with the Product and Engineering teams to ensure our offering matches the customers’ needs. Working closely with our partners (system integrators, defence companies and sovereign cloud providers), who lead many of the larger deals in Germany, to develop a strategy for enabling and accelerating their customers. This might be for you if you have some of the following: 3+ years in customer-facing technical roles where you both built and advised, such as consulting data scientist, forward deployed engineer, deployment strategist, or solutions architect, taking AI or data solutions from executive problem framing to production. A passion for Agentic AI, and a practical understanding of where LLMs deliver value in production, and where they don't. Solid grounding in ML fundamentals (training, evaluation, retrieval etc.) and the ability to design evaluation frameworks for customer pilots. Excellent communication skills - you can toggle seamlessly between presenting to CEOs, and getting in the weeds with technical audiences. You thrive in ambiguity and can put high-impact structure and processes in place where none exist. Comfortable working with Python and Assistive Coding tools Experience in or with the defence sector, e.g. in the Bundeswehr (including reserve service), at a defence company, in federal IT or at NATO, and a deep understanding of how defence organisations buy and run IT. Eligible and willing to undergo a German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung under the SÜG, Ü2 or higher). An existing clearance is a strong plus. Preferred : experience in the German defence market, e.g. at a system integrator or consultancy, or working on RFPs and public tenders. Must have: Professional fluency in English and German (C1 or higher, verhandlungssicher) Please note: for this role we are open to a range of experience levels, from Associate to Staff-level Individual Contributors (ICs). Experience level stated is a bare minimum. We also welcome and support employees who actively serve in the Bundeswehr reserve. Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks: A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. How and Where We Work: Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form , and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an ----- or ----- email alias. In this role, you will be the bridge between consulting sharpness and execution obsession, leading the end-to-end launch of our most critical company missions. Moderately technical, with the ability to configure SaaS solutions and provide recommendations. Experience in customer onboarding, customer service, support, account management, or customer success (advantage). Fluent in English (required), additional languages (German and Spanish as a priority) are an advantage. Why you will love Maltego Maltego is a scale-up company. We provide you the benefits and security of larger corporations, coupled with the dynamic and fast-paced work environment and flat hierarchies of a start-up. We are proud to have a large global community that loves our product because it helps to solve the investigations that are most important. Here are some of the reasons why you will love Maltego: Play a key role in creating exceptional onboarding experiences for customers in the cybersecurity space. Empower organizations to get the most value from innovative technology used to uncover threats, investigate risks, and solve complex challenges. Build scalable onboarding journeys that accelerate customer adoption and success. Collaborate with talented and mission-driven teams across the business. At Maltego, we are committed to supporting diversity and inclusion in our organization. We are an equal opportunity employer. But without QEC, the industry’s defining technical challenge, such breakthroughs can never be achieved.  Riverlane is the world leader in QEC technology. QEC is a complex problem that requires a range of skills, talent and passion. </span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW243923852 BCX8" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW243923852 BCX8">Having raised more than $125M in funding to date to accelerate our </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW243923852 BCX8">cutting-edge</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW243923852 BCX8"> R&D in quantum error correction (QEC), Riverlane partners with many of the world’s leading quantum hardware providers and government agencies to make fault-tolerant quantum computing a reality. </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW243923852 BCX8">We’re</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW243923852 BCX8"> making remarkable progress and growing fast. </span></span><span class="EOP SCXW243923852 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">About the role</span></strong><strong><span data-contrast="none"> </span></strong></p> <p>We are looking for an exceptional Senior Product Manager with a background in science or engineering and quantum computing or HPC experience to help define and grow an important part of Riverlane’s software product portfolio.</p> <p>This is an early-stage, fast-moving area of our product roadmap: you’ll help shape its direction as much as run what already exists.</p> <p>You’ll sit right at the heart of this product area, working closely with users, partners and cross-functional teams to deeply understand real-world challenges and translate them into a compelling product direction. title: Product Design Manager
description: The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact. Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve: Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register . We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us. We're looking for an experienced design manager to lead our Product Design team. This is a management role. Your job is to develop designers, raise the quality of the work, and make sure design has real influence on where the product goes. It is not a player-coach role, and it is not a step up for a strong IC looking for their first management position. We need someone who has already managed product designers and can do it well from day one. n8n is a powerful, flexible technical tool, which means the problems your team tackles are complex. Design decisions have to account for diverse user workflows, technical constraints, and how changes ripple across the whole platform. You'll need enough craft depth to recognise excellent work, challenge it constructively, and help designers get better. The team needs a manager whose design judgment they trust. You'll manage a team spanning product designers, design engineers and user researchers at a range of seniority levels, working across our product areas. You'll work alongside our other design manager. You'll report to our VP of Product until our Head of Design joins the team. That search is running now. More than 80% of workflows built on n8n involve AI agents, and we're widening from a developer audience to a broader set of builders. That shift is the central design problem here, and your team is at the centre of it. 🎯 Your main goal is to build a Product Design team that consistently produces excellent work and shapes how n8n's product evolves. Here's what that involves: Lead and develop the team Run regular, high-quality 1:1s and coach designers, design engineers and researchers across different levels. Own performance management: evidence-based reviews, honest feedback, and real support for anyone who isn't where they need to be. Help people understand what's expected at their level and what growth looks like, evolving our progression framework for Product Design. Hire excellent designers as the team grows, and broaden the range of backgrounds and perspectives on the team. Raise the design bar Set and hold a high standard across problem framing, user understanding, interaction design, information architecture and visual craft. Facilitate design critiques and reviews that measurably improve the work, and help designers think beyond the feature in front of them. Develop designers' judgment and autonomy rather than becoming the final approval layer for every decision. Own the whole product experience Keep a holistic view across features and product areas, identifying inconsistencies, recurring UX problems, and opportunities for more coherent patterns. Work with the team to address fragmentation systematically rather than feature by feature. Make design a real partner Partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership so design contributes early to problem definition and product direction, not late to execution. Help designers influence product decisions through strong reasoning rather than positional authority. Improve how the team works across critique, collaboration, decision-making and knowledge sharing, introducing structure where it helps the team scale and resisting process that slows things down. How much of this is hands-on? Worth being direct, because it's the question every good candidate asks. This is a management role: developing designers, raising the bar, and making design count in product decisions is the job, and that's where your time goes. You'll stay close to the craft in critiques, in reviews and in the detail of the work, and you'll occasionally pick up design work yourself. When that happens it sits outside the squads and varies with the period: an exploratory concept, a gap during someone's leave, a problem that needs a first pass. It is not a 50/50 split, and if what you want is to keep a squad's worth of delivery alongside managing the team, this isn't the role. REQUIREMENTS Must-haves 👥 Proven design management: You've managed product designers in a product-led technology company for 3+ years, with a team of five or more. This is not a first management role. 🧭 Running a team well: You've run effective 1:1s, evidence-based performance reviews and difficult feedback conversations, including with people who weren't performing. You've built or improved a career progression framework for designers, and you're comfortable with the administrative side of managing a team rather than treating it as overhead. 📈 Growing people: You coach and mentor, you run critique that changes the work, and you can point to specific designers who got measurably better or grew in scope while reporting to you. 🎨 Design taste and judgment: Your own craft is strong enough that designers trust your read on quality, you can articulate what separates adequate design from excellent design, and you'll step into the work directly when the situation calls for it. 🎯 Hiring: You've hired designers consistently well, you know where good design talent is and how to attract it, and you can tell the difference quickly. 🤖 AI fluency: You use AI tools hands-on in your own work and in how your team designs, and you have an informed view on designing AI-enabled products. AI agents are the product here, so this one is not optional. Nice-to-haves 🛠️ Technical products: You've managed design teams in B2B SaaS, developer tools, workflow automation or similarly technical products. 🧠 Technical mindset: You don't need to write code, but genuine curiosity about what's happening underneath (APIs, webhooks, data structures, how workflows actually execute) earns you credibility with engineers here. 👩‍💻 Designing for developers: You've designed products for developers, technical operators or other sophisticated users. 🔭 Systems view: You can step back from individual projects to spot patterns and UX problems across a broader product experience. 🤝 Influence without authority: You bring Product and Engineering peers with you through reasoning rather than positional authority. 📊 Scaling teams: You've grown a design team through a period of rapid company growth. 🌍 Distributed teams: You've managed designers in remote-first or highly distributed organisations. 🔓 Open source: You've worked on open-source or community-driven products. 🌱 Inclusive hiring: You've meaningfully broadened the diversity of a design team through how you hire. Our hiring process We'll tell you the whole shape of it upfront, and there's very little homework. Screening call with our recruiter. 45 minutes, no prep. Leading designers with the hiring manager, 75 minutes. You'll present for 20 minutes on a team you built, grew or turned around. Reuse existing material; it shouldn't take more than two or three hours. We don't need case studies of your own design work. Live critique and coaching , 60 minutes. We'll send you a real piece of n8n design work 24 hours ahead. You'll critique it, then have a coaching conversation with the designer who made it. No preparation beyond reading it and trying the product. Conversation with our VP of Product , and a culture call with Jan, our CEO. 45 minutes each, same day where we can. Meet two or three of the designers you'd be managing. Not scored; it's for you as much as for us. We'll also ask for two references, one of them a former direct report. A portfolio is welcome if you have one, though we know not every design manager keeps theirs current. Why join us? At n8n, your work won't disappear into a slide deck. You'll lead design for a product that hundreds of thousands of builders use to automate real work, sitting right where developer tools, AI agents and no-code interaction models meet. The design problems are genuinely hard and largely unsolved. You're inheriting an established team with strong designers, not building from zero, and there's real room to shape how the team coaches, critiques, grows and works with Product and Engineering, rather than inheriting a rigid design organisation. You'll stay close enough to the craft to influence quality directly, while your main job is making the designers around you better. You'll join a fast-growing, Europe remote-first company where autonomy, experimentation, and craft matter, at the point where n8n is scaling from a beloved open-source project into a major B2B platform. Design's contribution to product thinking is established here, and has a long way still to run. Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on? Apply now and help us build the future of automation. n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work. Our company language is English. You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n ( https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35 ). Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future. Benefits Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay. Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity. Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge: Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are. US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are. Health & wellness 🩺 – Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.* US : Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage. Future planning 💰 – Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.* US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match. Financial security 🛡️ – Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.* US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones. Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills. A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

title: Senior/Staff ML Scientist - Bidding & Optimization (f/m/d)
description: adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile app growth and monetization, challenging the status quo of adtech by redefining how apps acquire users and generate revenue. Our two products, Playtime Arcade and adjoe Ads, sit at opposite ends of the mobile advertising spectrum: rewarded engagement and programmatic in-app advertising. Together they run on 13% of the world’s smartphones , connecting advertisers, publishers, and hundreds of millions of users, with one goal: making mobile advertising work better for everyone in the ecosystem. Next-Gen Machine Intelligence for Auctions & Real-Time Bidding The Data Science Research team builds the foundational algorithms that govern real-time bidding, budget pacing, and allocation mechanics across our products. Operating as a horizontal deep-tech layer, the team leverages advanced AI—specifically reinforcement learning, objective-based optimization, and control theory—to deliver critical systems that perfectly harmonize advertiser ROI, platform health, and user relevance. These frameworks scale adjoe’s products beyond standard industry limitations, utilizing behavioral and transactional data from over 770 million users . The team operates at the intersection of high-load, low-latency engineering, auction mechanism design, and state-of-the-art machine learning . Acting as the company’s internal science bar raiser, they translate complex business constraints into mathematical objectives. The stack is optimized for high throughput: PyTorch for training deep learning and RL models, distributed architectures for large-scale Bayesian inference, Trino and Athena for querying massive user-behavior data lakes, and dedicated GPU infrastructure. The full lifecycle of these AI capabilities is owned by the team—from academic paper translation and offline prototyping to deploying core algorithmic frameworks built to sustain ultra-low latency, real-time production environments evaluating tens of thousands of requests per second. Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For: PhD or equivalent research depth, with a production track record. You have a PhD in CS, Statistics, Math, or Physics (or an MSc with extensive industry research) and a track record of peer-reviewed publications in fields like Computational Advertising, Auction Theory, Mechanism Design, or Game Theory. You’ve spent 4+ years optimizing complex systems through automated algorithms in AdTech, marketplaces, or high-frequency trading. You translate research into production, not just prototypes. You distill SOTA research into robust, production-ready code optimized for sub-millisecond latency. At adjoe, that means architecting sophisticated auction mechanics, real-time bidding engines, and allocation algorithms serving millions of requests across a stack built on 770 million users. Deep expertise in Reinforcement Learning and Optimization. You have hands-on, deep theoretical and technical expertise in objective-based optimization, control theory, or RL applied specifically to bidding, pricing strategy, and budget pacing under extreme production constraints. Mastering high-dimensional data at scale. Large-scale Bayesian inference and handling sparse, high-dimensional advertising data are core to your work. You are strongly proficient in Python and related stacks, and know exactly how to architect scalable data pipelines to feed real-time optimization models. Raises the technical bar around them. You lead architectural debates, collaborate tightly with Product Managers and Engineers to map business goals to mathematical objective functions, mentor junior scientists, and drive the team’s research direction without needing a roadmap handed to you. 🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team. What’s in It for You? At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day. Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries. Move Fast. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other. Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy. title: Lead Project Manager Dual Use In-Orbit Services
description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation. At The Exploration Company, we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable orbital vehicle designed to carry cargo and, in the longer term, humans. Nyx is being developed with the capabilities required for safe, reliable and repeatable rendezvous, proximity operations and docking, including missions to the International Space Station. Building on this heritage, our Future Projects activities are developing new orbital services and spacecraft applications for institutional, commercial and defence customers. We are seeking an experienced Dual Use In-Orbit Services Project Manager to lead the complete development and delivery of orbiters for defence and dual-use applications. This is a high-impact role for an experienced spacecraft project manager who can translate customer needs into executable programmes and lead multidisciplinary teams from early concept and proposal phases through design, qualification, launch, commissioning and operations. The successful candidate will combine strong spacecraft engineering understanding with a proven record of delivering flight hardware and managing demanding institutional and defence stakeholders. Key Responsibilities In your capacity as Dual Use In-Orbit Services Project Manager, your role will be continuously evolving, but day-to-day your duties will include: Lead the complete development of orbiters and associated in-orbit service capabilities for defence and dual-use missions, from mission definition and early concept studies through qualification, launch, commissioning, flight and operations. Translate customer objectives and operational needs into clear mission, system and programme requirements. Establish and maintain the project baseline, including scope, schedule, budget, resources, technical performance and quality objectives. Define the project organisation, work breakdown structure, milestones, reviews and decision gates. Drive disciplined decision-making, issue resolution and change control throughout the project lifecycle. Ensure successful delivery against commitments in terms of technical performance, schedule, cost, quality and customer satisfaction. Monitor industrialisation, procurement, manufacturing and supply-chain activities, ensuring that critical path items and long-lead equipment are actively managed. Work closely with engineering and industrial teams to ensure the timely delivery of flight and ground hardware, software, documentation and operational products Act as the main point of contact for institutional and defence customers throughout the project lifecycle.
