title: Management Accountant
description: About Black Forest Labs We're the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX—foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and video. We’re creating the generative models that power how people make images and video—tools used by millions of creators, developers, and businesses worldwide. Our FLUX models are among the most advanced in the world, and we're just getting started. Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we're scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity. Why This Role We're seeking a bilingual Management Accountant to serve as the cornerstone of our German accounting operations. This role combines hands-on accounting execution with strategic financial operations, ensuring seamless coordination between our German and US entities while maintaining compliance with both German and US GAAP standards. You'll work at the intersection of day-to-day financial operations and cross-border business requirements, partnering closely with our Head of Finance, People Operations, external payroll providers, and local German accounting advisors to maintain accurate, timely financial reporting across our dual-entity structure. What You’ll Work On Core Accounting Operations Manage full-cycle billing, collections, and accounts payable for German entity Execute treasury and cash management functions, including inter-company settlements Process and reconcile inter-company transactions between German and US entities Partner with People Operations and external payroll agencies across Europe to ensure accurate and timely payroll accounting entries Review payroll outputs from external providers and post journal entries to the general ledger Reconcile payroll-related balance sheet accounts (accruals, statutory deductions, benefits) each month Maintain accurate books and records in accordance with German GAAP (HGB) Maintain dual bookkeeping across DATEV (German statutory books) and Rillet (global ERP), ensuring both systems remain accurate, aligned, and reconciled on an ongoing basis Tax & Compliance Coordinate with external German accountants (Steuerberater) to ensure accurate VAT returns and filings Support annual tax compliance including Körperschaftsteuer and Gewerbesteuer Maintain documentation for tax audits and statutory requirements Monitor regulatory changes affecting German accounting and tax obligations US GAAP Reporting Support Assist in reconciling German GAAP accounts to US GAAP basis Provide monthly financial data and schedules for consolidated US GAAP reporting Support quarter-end and year-end close processes for global consolidation Help maintain documentation for US GAAP accounting policies and procedures Process & Systems Implement and improve accounting processes and internal controls Work with ERP and financial systems to enhance efficiency and accuracy Support integration of German operations into global financial infrastructure Maintain organized documentation for internal and external stakeholders What We’re Looking For: Education : Completed Ausbildung as Steuerfachangestellter/ Steuerfachwirt or similar accounting qualification; Bachelor's degree in Finance/Accounting preferred Experience : 3 plus years experience in accounting role(s), preferably in fast-growing companies or startups Language : Full fluency in both German and English is a core requirement Technical : Strong proficiency with accounting software and Excel; experience with ERP systems Location : Based in or willing to relocate to Freiburg, Germany While not required, it’s an added plus if you also have: Experience with DATEV and/or modern cloud ERP systems (e.g., Rillet, NetSuite) Familiarity with both German GAAP (HGB) and US GAAP principles Experience working in dual-entity or international company structures Prior work with German Steuerberater and understanding of VAT compliance Experience coordinating with People Operations and third-party payroll providers (rather than running payroll directly) Experience in technology or SaaS companies Knowledge of intercompany accounting and transfer pricing basics How We Work Together We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry. Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now. You will play a key role in delivering Kraken's Human Design principles and Operating Model to transform our clients Operations, leading implementation through a hands-on, consultative approach. A strong understanding of Human Design principles and change management best practice is essential, as is the ability to influence leaders, navigate change with confidence and bring sharp project management and analytical skills. While operations will be your core focus, you’ll also need a solid grasp of broader retail functions – how data, comms and marketing interact with operations to shape customer outcomes and influence the success of the new model. While the primary focus is the C&I function, you’ll also need B2C experience to effectively support clients across the portfolio. When executed well, these transformations can feel truly magical – across the whole organisation, and most importantly, our clients’ customers. The SCDL role is to make sure that magic is felt. Key Responsibilities: what you'll do Consultative Leadership & Client Engagement: Lead client interactions through the entire BOT program lifecycle, providing hands-on consulting and fostering a learning environment by guiding clients to take ownership early in the migration process of the operational programme. Help mobilise and set up initiatives such as Operations Transformation Office (OTO - client’s internal change management team), Early Adopters and work closely with Kraken’s Tech Teams to enable a smooth transformation. Establish strong relationships within the client’s Senior Leadership team, acting as a trusted advisor and helping to shape, influence and unblock strategic decisions. Empower the client’s migration ‘Ambassadors’ to become champions of the model, ensuring the program’s long term adoption and accountability across the organisation. Shape planning so it aligns with the client’s goals and aspirations. Partner tightly with internal Tech teams so operational and technical migrations run in lockstep, reducing friction and keeping delivery on track. Drive continuous improvement and iteration, tailoring solutions based on client-specific needs. Mentorship & Coaching: Cultivate future leadership by mentoring and coaching the client’s OTO and internal teams, enabling them to be successful in a Kraken powered organisation. Ensure that internal stakeholders, including the OTO team, are fully equipped to take over ownership of scaling the operational transformation, with formalised check-ins at agreed points. Support the creation of high performing teams, able to think, lead and problem solve and lead in keeping with agile, customer centric methodologies. Leverage client and Kraken data to identify red flags, understand cause-and-effect relationships, and drive corrective actions to improve client outcomes. Being able to correlate and articulate the connection between employee engagement and customer satisfaction, and how operational changes can impact cost to serve. Collaborate across departments to ensure that Kraken’s core offering aligns with client expectations. Ensure that operations never become a blocker to continued migration. Remain up to date with new features and products and ensure the client is trained and adopts new functionality. Driving Organisational Change: Lead cultural and operational transformations, embedding sustainable change within the client’s organisation, using Kraken’s Human Design approach. title: Business Development Manager
description: About TACTILIA: At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup. This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible. You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor? The Role: As Business Development Manager, you will own TACTILIA's commercial launch: finding the right customers, opening doors, and turning early interest into signed deals. You'll sell a technically demanding product to engineering and business decision-makers in robotics and industrial automation, and you'll help define which markets and partnerships we pursue first. Your feedback from the field will directly shape our product roadmap and go-to-market. What you will do: Identify, prioritize, and win target accounts across robotics OEMs, system integrators, and industrial end users Own the full sales cycle, from first contact and qualification through technical evaluation, proposal, negotiation, and close Build relationships with decision-makers on both the technical side (R&D, engineering leads) and the commercial side (management, procurement) Develop strategic partnerships with ecosystem players, and leverage SCHUNK's industrial network where it opens doors Translate customer requirements into clear value propositions, working closely with our engineering team Bring structured market and customer insight back to the team to inform pricing, positioning, and product priorities What you bring: 5+ years in business development or B2B sales, ideally selling technical products or solutions to industrial or engineering customers A track record of winning new accounts and closing complex deals with long sales cycles Confidence discussing technical products credibly with engineers, without needing to be an engineer yourself Strong presentation and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trust at both the engineering and executive level Ownership mentality: you're comfortable building structure and pipeline without a ready-made playbook Fluent English; German is a plus Bonus: Experience in robotics, automation, mechatronics, or industrial hardware industries Existing network among robotics companies, integrators, or industrial automation buyers Experience in a startup or scale-up where you helped build the sales function The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world. At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability and robustness to interact with the physical world at industrial scale. The technology is taking shape, the team is being built, and the standards around robotic hands and their skills are still open. That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI. Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next. If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that works reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: MAÎTRE DE CONFÉRENCES dans le domaine du Génie Civil et de la microstructure des matériaux de construction H/F - CDI - IMT Mines Alès
description: Créée en 1843, IMT Mines Alès compte à ce jour 1400 élèves (dont 250 étrangers) et 380 personnels. L’école dispose de 3 centres de recherche et d’enseignement de haut niveau scientifique et technologique, qui œuvrent dans les domaines des matériaux et du génie civil (C2MA), de l’environnement et des risques (CREER), de l’intelligence artificielle et du génie industriel et numérique (CERIS). Elle dispose de 12 plateformes technologiques et compte 1600 entreprises partenaires. Pour en savoir plus : https://www.imt-mines-ales.fr . Vous êtes rattaché(e) au Centre des Matériaux des Mines Alès (C2MA) de l'IMT Mines Alès et dans l'équipe de recherche : UMR LMGC "Laboratoire de Mécanique et Génie Civil". En tant que Maître de Conférences de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, vous réalisez des tâches d’enseignement, de recherche et de transfert technologique. Activités d'enseignement Participer aux activités d’enseignements de l’école du département Génie Civil et Bâtiment Durable (GCBD), dans les filières Infrastructures et Grands Ouvrages (IGO), Bâtiment et Energie (BE), et Bâtiment (BAT), sous forme de cours magistraux, travaux dirigés, travaux pratiques, encadrement de projets et tutorat d'étudiants ; Assurer des enseignements dans les domaines du génie civil, des matériaux et du calcul des structures ; Dispenser des enseignements en anglais ou développer des méthodes de pédagogie active ; Participer aux jurys de recrutement des élèves et aux actions de promotion de la formation d’ingénieurs ; Piloter une spécialisation en dernière année d’études et proposer des missions de recherche et développement ; Assurer un volume minimal de 150 heures d'enseignement par an. Activités de recherche Mener des activités de recherche au sein de l'axe « Milieux divisés » du LMGC ; Renforcer la thématique sur les matrices cimentaires bas carbone, en lien avec les propriétés macroscopiques et la durabilité de ces matériaux, et fédérer d’autres chercheurs en faisant le lien avec les aspects modélisation et mécaniques développées au LMGC ; S’intéresser aux méthodes de caractérisation expérimentale des propriétés des matériaux cimentaires de l’état frais et à l’état durci en particulier de la microstructure nécessitant des connaissances en physico-chimie des matrices cimentaires et sur l’adjuvantation ; Contribuer à la gestion collective de la plateforme Génie-Civil. Activités de valorisation et de transfert technologique Rechercher et monter des contrats de recherche avec des partenaires industriels et académiques ainsi que rédiger des dossiers de demande de financements auprès d’organismes publics ou de programmes internationaux ; Assurer l'interface avec le partenaire contractuel, prendre en charge les objectifs scientifiques définis dans le projet, animer une équipe projet et assurer le suivi de son déroulement, ainsi que la communication afférente ; Développer une compréhension du processus d’exploitation commerciale de résultats de recherche afin de contribuer à la coopération entre la recherche académique, la recherche industrielle et les secteurs de production. Réaliser, dans son champ de compétences scientifiques et techniques, des actions destinées à accompagner des entreprises ou l’incubateur de l’école afin de favoriser la création de spin off et le développement d’entreprises technologiques. Vous trouvez plus d’information sur le descriptif du poste ici : https://partage.imt.fr/index.php/s/Zqr5eBT6ijzic9y Le poste requiert une expérience confirmée en enseignement du génie civil et des matériaux de construction, ainsi qu’une aptitude à concevoir et mettre en œuvre des pédagogies innovantes adaptées aux compétences visées. Vous devrez disposer d’une expérience solide en recherche, démontrer votre capacité à développer des collaborations scientifiques, à publier vos travaux et à valoriser les résultats de recherche auprès de partenaires académiques et industriels. La maîtrise de l’anglais scientifique est requise ; une expérience internationale et une capacité à vous intégrer aux projets du LMGC et du C2MA constitueront des atouts. Les critères d'évaluation sont : Diplôme requis : diplôme d’ingénieur ou master en génie civil ou en bâtiment durable, ainsi qu’un doctorat en génie civil ou en sciences des matériaux. Critères de sélection prévalant pour l’activité d’enseignement : Niveau des enseignements dispensés Importance accordée à l’innovation pédagogique Action et notoriété dans la communauté du domaine Critères de sélection prévalant pour l’activité de recherche Reconnaissance nationale et internationale des résultats de recherche obtenus Responsabilités exercées dans le domaine d’expertise Relations avec les mondes académique et industriel L’exercice de responsabilités, les activités d’organisation et la participation à des instances de concertation et de décision entrent également en compte dans les critères examinés. Modalités de candidature Le dossier de candidature est à télécharger sur ce lien : https://partage.imt.fr/index.php/s/DT9ZZPFPNpHm5HD Il est à compléter en français uniquement si vous remplissez les conditions indiquées ci-dessus. Il est accompagné, notamment, d’un curriculum vitae, d’une lettre de motivation, d’éventuelles lettres de recommandation ainsi que d’une copie de votre carte d’identité, de vos diplômes et de toute attestation de formation ou de stage. Les candidats admissibles seront informés dans les meilleurs délais après cette date. title: Post-doctorant·e en apprentissage décentralisé sûr, conficentiel et explicable - CDD 12 mois
description: Présentation de Télécom SudParis : Télécom SudParis est une grande école publique d'ingénieurs reconnue au meilleur niveau des sciences et technologies du numérique. La qualité de ses formations est basée sur l’excellence scientifique de son corps professoral et une pédagogie mettant l’accent sur les projets d’équipes, l’innovation de rupture et l’entreprenariat. Télécom SudParis compte 1 000 étudiantes et étudiants dont 700 élèves ingénieurs et environ de 150 doctorantes et doctorants. Télécom SudParis fait partie de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’école d’ingénieurs en France, et partage son campus avec Institut Mines-Télécom Business School. Télécom SudParis est co- fondatrice de l'Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris), Institut de Sciences et Technologies à vocation mondiale avec l’École polytechnique, l’ENSTA Paris, l’ENSAE Paris, l'ENPC et Télécom Paris. Vidéo présentation de Télécom SudParis À propos de l'Institut Mines-Télécom : L'Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT) est un établissement public dédié à l'enseignement supérieur et la recherche pour l'innovation dans les domaines de l'ingénierie et du numérique. À l’écoute permanente du monde économique, l'IMT conjugue une forte légitimité académique et scientifique, une proximité avec les entreprises et un positionnement unique sur les transformations majeures au XXIe siècle : numériques, énergétiques, industrielles et éducatives siècle. Ses activités se déploient au sein des grandes écoles Mines et Télécom sous tutelle du ministre en charge de l’Industrie et des communications électroniques, de deux filiales et de partenaires associés ou sous convention. L'IMT est membre fondateur de l’Alliance Industrie du Futur. Il est doublement labellisé Carnot pour la qualité de sa recherche partenariale. Vidéo de présentation de l'Institut Mines-Télécom Missions Analyser les enjeux de sécurité, de vie privée et d’éthique liés au déploiement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle (IA) dans des domaines critiques et variés, notamment la santé, la finance et les transports. Étudier les méthodes d’apprentissage automatique préservant la vie privée ( Privacy-Preserving Machine Learning – PPML ) et leur capacité à répondre aux exigences réglementaires et éthiques, notamment celles découlant du RGPD et de l’AI Act. Concevoir et évaluer des approches de protection de la vie privée dans des environnements d’apprentissage décentralisé, en particulier dans le cadre de l’apprentissage fédéré. Identifier et caractériser les vulnérabilités de sécurité propres à l’apprentissage collaboratif et fédéré, notamment les attaques par empoisonnement de données, l’injection de portes dérobées ( backdoors ) et les attaques visant la confidentialité des données et des utilisateurs. Étudier les mécanismes d’inférence à partir des mises à jour de modèles , notamment les attaques par inférence d’appartenance et par inférence de propriétés, afin d’évaluer les risques de divulgation d’informations sensibles. Évaluer la robustesse et la confidentialité des modèles d’IA dans des contextes où les données, les nœuds et les processus d’apprentissage sont distribués et difficilement auditables. Étudier les méthodes d’intelligence artificielle explicable (XAI) afin d’améliorer la transparence, l’interprétabilité et la compréhension des décisions produites par les modèles d’IA. Analyser les interactions et compromis entre explicabilité, vie privée et robustesse dans les systèmes d’apprentissage décentralisé. Développer et expérimenter des méthodes permettant de concilier transparence et protection de la vie privée , en tenant compte des contraintes propres aux environnements distribués. Mettre en place des protocoles expérimentaux et des critères d’évaluation permettant de mesurer les niveaux de confidentialité, de robustesse et d’explicabilité des approches étudiées. Contribuer à la valorisation et à la diffusion des résultats de recherche , notamment par la rédaction de publications scientifiques, la présentation des travaux dans des conférences et la participation aux échanges avec les partenaires du projet. Assurer une veille scientifique et technologique sur les avancées en IA de confiance, Activités Concevoir et développer des mécanismes d’apprentissage décentralisé offrant de fortes garanties de confidentialité, une résistance aux comportements malveillants et des capacités d’explicabilité pertinentes. Étudier la confidentialité des mécanismes d’explicabilité , en particulier les risques de fuite d’informations susceptibles d’être induits par les méthodes d’explicabilité appliquées aux modèles d’apprentissage fédéré. Développer de nouvelles stratégies d’attaque et d’évaluation permettant de caractériser les informations susceptibles d’être divulguées par les mécanismes d’explicabilité. Concevoir des mécanismes de protection adaptés permettant de limiter les fuites d’informations identifiées tout en préservant la qualité et la pertinence des explications produites. Développer des approches d’apprentissage collaboratif conciliant confidentialité et explicabilité , en tenant compte des contraintes propres aux environnements fédérés et décentralisés. Étudier l’utilisation de la confidentialité différentielle (Differential Privacy – DP) pour protéger les modèles agrégés contre les attaques par inférence et analyser son impact sur la qualité et la fidélité des explications. Explorer des primitives cryptographiques adaptées à l’apprentissage fédéré , notamment le chiffrement partiellement ou totalement homomorphe et les techniques de calcul multipartite sécurisé ( Secure Multi-Party Computation – MPC ). Combiner les mécanismes cryptographiques et la confidentialité différentielle afin d’explorer des compromis entre niveau de confidentialité, qualité des explications, coût de calcul et éventuelles fuites d’information. Étudier l’impact des mécanismes de protection de la vie privée sur les méthodes d’explicabilité , notamment les méthodes fondées sur l’attribution, et identifier des stratégies permettant de préserver leur fidélité. Analyser les vulnérabilités des systèmes d’apprentissage fédéré face aux attaques byzantines et aux attaques par empoisonnement , en particulier lorsque les stratégies adverses exploitent des métriques ou informations issues de l’explicabilité. Étudier des scénarios d’attaque réalistes prenant en compte l’hétérogénéité et le déséquilibre des données détenues par les différents clients, l’empoisonnement des étiquettes ( label poisoning ) et la présence de clients associés à des attributs protégés. Développer des algorithmes d’agrégation robustes et préservant la vie privée , capables de maintenir les performances du modèle dans des environnements comportant une proportion importante de participants malveillants. Concevoir des mécanismes de défense adaptatifs exploitant l’explicabilité , notamment pour identifier les comportements anormaux, les mises à jour suspectes ou les participants potentiellement malveillants. Analyser conjointement les compromis entre vie privée, robustesse, explicabilité et utilité du modèle , en intégrant également les contraintes liées à l’efficacité computationnelle et aux communications. Définir des protocoles et métriques d’évaluation permettant de comparer les approches proposées selon différents niveaux de confidentialité, de robustesse, de fidélité des explications et de coût computationnel. Expérimenter et évaluer les méthodes développées sur des scénarios réalistes d’apprentissage décentralisé , notamment dans le domaine de la santé et dans d’autres contextes traitant des données sensibles. Contribuer à la validation expérimentale et à la valorisation des résultats , notamment par la mise en œuvre de prototypes, l’analyse des résultats, la rédaction de publications scientifiques et la présentation des travaux dans des événements scientifiques. Formation Doctorat ou PhD en informatique depuis moins de 3 ans Compétences, connaissances et expériences indispensables Expériences en IA ou machine learning (ML) appliquée à la cybersécurité Compétences en apprentissage fédéré (Federated Learning) Compétences en mathématiques avancées Anglais parlé, écrit Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables Compétences en cryptographie homomorphe, en particulier CKKS Compétences en confidentialité différentielle Compétences en IA explicable (XAI) Compétences en technologies de protection de la vie privée (PET) Capacités et aptitudes Rigueur, méthode de gestion de projets Aisance relationnelle avec des interlocuteurs de tous niveaux, esprit d’écoute et de coopération Capacité à travailler en équipe Respect strict des obligations de confidentialité au regard des données utilisées Indications de rémunération: Fourchette indicative de rémunération (hors bonus annuel variable): 35.400- 38.000 euros bruts annuels, selon le profil et l’expérience (charges salariales réduites en secteur public). Informations complémentaires et candidature Date limite de candidature : 31 octobre 2026 Nature du contrat : CDD de 12 mois Catégorie et métier du poste (usage interne): II -P, Post-doctorat A (fonction publique) Poste ouvert aux métiers de niveau immédiatement inférieur (usage interne) Localisation du poste: Evry-Courcouronnes (91) Les postes offerts au recrutement sont ouverts à toutes et tous avec, sur demande, des aménagements pour les candidats en situation de handicap Emploi ouvert aux titulaires de la fonction publique et/ou aux contractuels Conditions de travail : 44 jours de congés, télétravail possible, restaurant et cafétéria sur site, accessibilité en transport en commun (avec participation de l'employeur) ou proche des axes routiers, association du personnel et association sportive sur le campus Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Graduate Electronics & Software Engineer (2027 start)
description: <p> </p> <h3><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Introduction</span></strong></h3> <p>We’re looking for STEM graduates keen to start making real products for our clients.  You’ll need to be eager to turn your hand to a lot of different tasks and enjoy constantly learning new things.  In return we can offer the chance to tackle some of the hardest engineering problems around, such as <a href="https://www.cambridgeconsultants.com/project/a-step-change-in-ai-based-robotics-for-military-logistics/">novel applications of robotics</a>, <a href="https://www.wired.com/video/watch/an-inside-look-at-legos-new-tech-packed-smart-brick">collaborating with LEGO</a> to develop <a href="https://www.wired.com/story/exclusive-inside-look-at-new-lego-smart-brick/">LEGO® SMART Play™</a>  and <a href="https://www.cambridgeconsultants.com/project/overcoming-smart-meter-challenges-for-the-last-5/">other embedded products</a>, as well as defence and national security projects such as <a href="https://www.cambridgeconsultants.com/project/pioneering-ai-cyberattack-response-for-the-uk-military/">pioneering AI cyberattack response for the UK military</a>.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">Overview </span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134245418":true,"134245529":true,"335559738":160,"335559739":80}"> </span></strong></h3> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Cambridge Consultants undertakes over 300 technology, design and consulting projects every year. You will get to work across the broad range of markets, from Consumer Devices to Industrial Systems to Defence and National Security. The Electronics and Software group is a cohesive team of multi-disciplinary experts in everything to do with embedded systems and devices – whether that’s electronics, embedded software, physics, control, communications, security or algorithm design.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We’re much more interested in the engineer you can become than the one you are now, and we mentor our team to grow them into brilliant technologists. We need people who are enthusiastic about learning, keen to pick up new skills, and can show evidence of a rigorous approach to solving real-world problems. An ability to learn and a determination to grow are more important than the knowledge you already have.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p> </p> <h3><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">Your responsibilities</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134245418":true,"134245529":true,"335559738":160,"335559739":80}"> </span></strong></h3> <p><span data-contrast="auto">With lots of support and guidance from your peers, you will work as part of our technical team on client assignments in multi-disciplinary projects for a wide range of markets. You may work on one or more projects at a time, in a variety of different disciplines and roles.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">You will work on the design and implementation of systems for a wide range of applications and products. You will have many opportunities to develop your technical design skills for analogue and digital hardware, information engineering, embedded software, control, communications and whole product design. This could include writing software in C for embedded targets, writing SystemVerilog for FPGAs, PCB design and hardware testing.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">You will have the chance to interact directly with clients at all phases of projects, from requirements capture and progress updates to final handover.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>About you</strong></h3> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We’re looking for applicants with the following experience or skills:</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <ul> <li><span data-contrast="auto">An excellent degree or PhD in general, electrical, electronic or information engineering, computer science or physics.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Experience through university, work or home projects in at least one of the following areas, and enthusiasm for learning about the others:</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span> <ul> <li><span data-contrast="auto">PCB design</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Digital electronics (processors, memory, DSP, Verilog, VHDL)</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Analogue electronics (general, interfaces, RF, power)</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></li> <li><span data-ccp-props="{}"><span data-contrast="auto">Software implementation in C, C++, Rust, or a similar programming language</span> </span></li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We welcome applications from recent graduates with industrial experience, final year students and graduates with relevant academic course or research experience. We are looking for excellence and are as interested in your skills and ability to learn quickly as we are in your experience.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Along with your CV, please describe why you are attracted to this position, what you feel you offer Cambridge Consultants, and any achievements that you are particularly proud of. We are especially interested to hear about any software, electronics or engineering projects you have done, for a hobby, for work or for university.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p> </p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{}"><span data-contrast="auto">Some projects at Cambridge Consultants are subject to security restrictions. </span>This role requires you to obtain a Security Check level security clearance ( <a href="https://www.gov.uk/guidance/united-kingdom-security-vetting-applicant">https://www.gov.uk/guidance/united-kingdom-security-vetting-applicant</a> ). You must be able to work in the UK without restrictions in accordance with UK National Law and be prepared to successfully undertake an appropriate level of UK National Security Vetting according to UK Government National Security Vetting criteria.</span></p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p style="text-align: center;"><strong>By submitting an application to Cambridge Consultants, you confirm that the information provided in this application, together with any supporting documentation, is true, complete, and accurate to the best of your knowledge and belief. You understand that any false statement, misleading information, or material omission may render you liable to disqualification from the recruitment process, withdrawal of any offer of employment, or dismissal without notice if discovered following appointment. You acknowledge that the organisation reserves the right to verify the information supplied.</strong><br></p> <hr> <p style="text-align: center;"> </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Graduate DSP Engineer (2027 start)
description: <h3><strong>Introduction </strong></h3> <p>We are looking for a Graduate DSP (Digital Signal Processing) Embedded Engineer with a passion for designing and implementing efficient real-time systems to join our team. Our projects span a range of industries and</p> <p>applications including Communications, Sensors and Audio. </p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Successful candidates can join us between May- September 2027.</span></strong></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">There is no deadline for this role, as we recruit on a rolling basis. Once the position is filled, we will close the advert. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible. </span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></strong></p> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>What we can offer</strong></h3> <p>With lots of support from guidance, you will support our signal processing group. Here are some examples of previous projects the team have worked on: </p> <ul> <li><a href="https://www.cambridgeconsultants.com/press-releases/cambridge-consultants-and-iridium-continue-world-changing-partnership-3-billion">ultra-reliable communications for satellites</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.cambridgeconsultants.com/press-releases/unveiling-worlds-lowest-power-voice-detection">IP block acceleration of Voice Activity Detection</a> </li> <li><a href="https://www.cambridgeconsultants.com/case-studies/trace-positioning-system">map based indoor navigation using sensor fusion,</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.cambridgeconsultants.com/case-studies/wireless-breakthrough-ocado-smart-platform">development of the communication system for a fleet of moving bots in a challenging indoor environment.</a></li> </ul> <p>We can provide a huge amount of variety in this role. You may be designing filters for simulation of a system one week, getting hands on with programming for a platform the next, or providing vectors or interpreting results from our hardware test team.  </p> <p>We take pride in being ahead of the technology curve, working with and developing exciting new technology. Our accolades include being an <a href="https://www.cambridgeconsultants.com/press-releases/cambridge-consultants-becomes-arm-approved-design-partner">Arm Approved Design partner</a> collaborating to design cutting edge systems with the latest low-power technologies. The platforms on which we develop solutions includes devices from TI, ARM devices, PicoChip, Dialog, Tensilica HIFI, Ambiq, Cirrus Logic, and custom ASICs developed in-house. </p> <p>The wide history of projects previously undertaken by the group have been implemented using a variety of software technologies. For embedded systems: C, C++, Assembler. For scripting and modelling: Matlab, Python, native Windows/Linux scripting languages. Utilising systems and processes: version control systems, issue tracking, continuous integration, test driven development.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>What you can bring</strong></h3> <p>You’ll have the opportunity to work on a range of projects, each with their own distinct set of challenges. You’ll be able to get involved with everything from first-principles thinking and research through to the design, development and deployment of live systems – utilising knowledge and practical experience attained from your degree.</p> <p>We are looking for someone who has:</p> <ul> <li>a good degree in a relevant subject, such as electronic/electrical/communications engineering, computer science, mathematics or physics</li> <li>programming skills – scripting languages such as Python or Matlab are particularly useful in our day-to-day work, we also use low level languages such as C for implementation so similar experience would be valuable, or of course a willingness to learn!</li> <li>an interest or understanding of the constraints of embedded systems, and how they can be implemented in an optimised way. An understanding of digital signal processing (DSP) concepts/mathematics would also be beneficial</li> </ul> <p>We are a nurturing team, and though not a formal graduate scheme you will be supported throughout to develop your career in the direction you want, with mentoring and training provided.</p> <p><strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">Please ensure your CV includes your A Level (or equivalent) subjects and grades, as well as any relevant university modules.</span></strong></p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{}"><span data-contrast="auto">Covering statements are advantageous though by no means a necessity. </span> </span></p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p style="text-align: center;"><strong>By submitting an application to Cambridge Consultants, you confirm that the information provided in this application, together with any supporting documentation, is true, complete, and accurate to the best of your knowledge and belief. title: Staff Product Manager, Comms Platform
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.</p></div><p data-pm-slice="1 1 []"><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to help shape the next generation of Affirm’s Comms Plat. The opportunity spans two connected areas: (1) Modernizing the platform that powers critical transactional communications across channels; (2) Building shared capabilities that help Affirm create a more coordinated experience across marketing and transactional comms. Together, this work will simplify how teams build and manage communications, strengthen the reliability and scalability of our systems, and help us deliver more relevant and consistent customer experiences.</p> <p>You’ll partner closely with Engineering and teams across Product, Marketing, Ops, Design, Analytics, and Legal and Compliance to set product direction and turn it into capabilities teams can successfully adopt. You’ll navigate complex technical and business tradeoffs, balance near-term needs with longer-term platform investments, and help determine where Affirm should build capabilities directly versus work with third-party partners.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong> </p> <ul> <li> <p>Set product strategy and roadmap for Comms Plat, connecting customer needs, business priorities, and technical opportunities.</p> </li> <li> <p>Help modernize Affirm’s comms infrastructure and build shared capabilities that support more consistent experiences across transactional and marketing comms.</p> </li> <li> <p>Lead complex platform initiatives from strategy through launch and adoption, working closely with Engineering and cross-functional partners.</p> </li> <li> <p>Build strong relationships across Affirm so communications needs for new products, markets, and customer journeys are understood early and reflected in platform plans.</p> </li> <li> <p>Shape channel, platform, and partner strategy, including thoughtful build-versus-buy decisions across the communications ecosystem.</p> </li> <li> <p>Make clear tradeoffs across customer experience, reliability, scalability, cost, regulatory requirements, and speed.</p> </li> <li> <p>Define meaningful measures of success and use customer, product, operational, and business signals to guide priorities and investment.</p> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What we look for</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>8+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience, with a track record of leading complex products or platforms.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience building platform or other technically complex products. Comms or messaging experience is helpful, but not required.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong product judgment and the ability to turn complex, ambiguous problems into a clear strategy and actionable roadmap.</p> </li> <li> <p>Technical fluency and comfort partnering deeply with Engineering on architecture, reliability, scalability, and platform tradeoffs.</p> </li> <li> <p>A track record of taking products beyond launch and driving adoption across multiple teams or customer groups.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong cross-functional influence and the ability to build alignment across teams with different priorities and constraints.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong analytical and business judgment, including the ability to weigh customer impact, operating complexity, cost, and risk when making decisions.</p> </li> <li> <p>Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex topics understandable and bring stakeholders along in the decision-making process.</p> </li> <li> <p>A customer-first mindset and the ability to stay focused on the experience the platform ultimately creates, even when working deep in infrastructure.</p> </li> <li> <p>Comfort operating with ambiguity, using judgment and available information to move work forward while adapting as you learn.</p> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>This is a remote-first position based in the UK with the option to work from our London office for candidates who prefer an office environment.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Compensation & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Base Pay Grade: P</p> <p>Equity Grade: UK 7</p> <p>Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure based on a variety of factors, including location, experience, and job-related skills.</p> <p>Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness, and tech spending, and benefits including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental, and vision for you and your dependents. In addition, employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc.</p> <p>GBR base pay range per year<strong>: £<span data-formula-id="_c_f_4zYZFddFQ5_0" data-error="false" data-placeholder="false" data-loading="false" data-recalculating="false" data-inactive="false">142,000</span> - <span data-formula-id="_c_f_4zYZFddFQ5_1" data-error="false" data-placeholder="false" data-loading="false" data-recalculating="false" data-inactive="false">190,000</span></strong></p> <p>Location: Remote UK</p> <p>#LI-Remote</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><strong>Remote-first with flexibility built in</strong><strong><br></strong>Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.</p> <p><strong>Benefits designed for you</strong><strong><br></strong>Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:</p> <ul> <li>Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.</li> <li>Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.</li> <li>Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.</li> <li>Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.</li> </ul> <p>We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.</p> <p>For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.</p> </div> <div> <p>By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's <a href="https://www.affirm.com/global-candidate-privacy-notice" target="_blank">Global Candidate Privacy Notice</a> and consent to the use of your personal information as described.</p> </div></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Learn more at <a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div> </div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p></div><h2>What You’ll Do:</h2> <p>The Central & Eastern Europe Sales organization is responsible for establishing CoreWeave as the preferred AI cloud platform for enterprises, AI labs, digital-native companies, and emerging AI builders across Germany and the wider DACH region, Poland, the Baltics, and the Balkans. Balkans, aligned to CoreWeave’s EMEA and global priorities.</li> <li>Design the regional segmentation, territory, account, and coverage model across Enterprise, AI Labs, Digital Natives, and Startup customers.</li> <li>Build and scale the regional sales organization, recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing leaders and individual contributors as the business grows.</li> <li>Lead, coach, and develop Account Executives and Account Managers, establishing clear expectations, strong inspection disciplines, and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Partner closely with Account Solutions Architects to connect customer business objectives with CoreWeave’s infrastructure, platform, and developer capabilities.</li> <li>Personally develop relationships with senior executives, founders, technical leaders, and strategic stakeholders across the region.</li> <li>Lead from the front on the region’s most strategic opportunities, remaining actively involved from initial engagement through solution development, commercial negotiation, and closure, with final contracting execution by EMEA/HQ </li> <li>Own the acquisition of new strategic customers while developing account strategies that increase adoption, consumption, retention, and long-term customer value across the existing customer base.</li> <li>Build a high-quality, appropriately covered pipeline and establish a consistent operating cadence for opportunity inspection, account planning, forecasting, risk management, and corrective action.</li> <li>Deliver accurate and transparent forecasts, with clear visibility into customer demand, consumption, commercial risk, capacity requirements, and execution dependencies.</li> <li>Develop and close, subject to HQ review and execution, complex, high-value, multi-year commercial agreements, including strategic capacity commitments and enterprise-wide platform relationships.</li> <li>Drive adoption of CoreWeave’s broader platform and Success, Capacity, Product, Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, and executive leadership to deliver coordinated customer outcomes.</li> <li>Support CoreWeave’s partner, venture capital, startup ecosystem, sovereign AI, and government-relations strategies across the region.</li> <li>Represent regional customer requirements and market dynamics within CoreWeave, ensuring that global product, capacity, investment, and go-to-market decisions reflect the opportunities and needs of Central & Eastern Europe.</li> <li>Establish CoreWeave’s reputation in the region through active participation in the AI, technology, business, research, and investment communities.</li> <li>Build a regional culture that reflects CoreWeave’s values, rewards ownership, develops talent, encourages collaboration, and delivers best-in-class customer experiences.</li> </ul> <h2>Who You Are:</h2> <ul> <li>15+ years of experience in enterprise technology sales, including significant experience selling cloud title: Infrastructure Software Engineer

title: Maintenance Technician (m/f/d) part time | ideal alongside your studies
description: Would you like to maintain more than just another technical system and work with a technology that is truly unique worldwide? ⚡ Our client is a fast growing GreenTech startup developing one of the world’s first scalable road based power plants. The technology uses existing road infrastructure to generate renewable energy from passing traffic without requiring any additional land. As a Maintenance Technician in Hamburg , you will be responsible for the technical operation and maintenance of the road based power plant installed there. You will ensure reliable operation, carry out maintenance and repairs, and systematically investigate technical faults. You will not simply follow existing procedures. Since this is an entirely new technology, you will actively help shape how maintenance, service, and technical support processes are developed for the future . Your hands on experience from daily operations will directly contribute to the continued development of the service structure. Your Benefits • Unique technology: Work with the world’s first road based power plant in active operation and contribute to a GreenTech solution that currently exists nowhere else in this form. • Real opportunity to shape processes: Develop maintenance schedules, service processes, and maintenance structures together with the team instead of simply following existing procedures. • Flexible part time schedule: Work 20 to 30 hours per week with flexible working hours that can easily be combined with university studies or other commitments. • Independent work: Take responsibility for the technical operation of the plant in Hamburg and enjoy a high degree of autonomy when it comes to maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs. • Development opportunities: Grow together with the technology and take on additional responsibility for operations and service as your experience increases. • Attractive compensation: Receive competitive compensation based on your qualifications and practical experience. Your Responsibilities As a Maintenance Technician , you will help ensure the reliable technical operation of the road based power plant in Hamburg. • Maintenance and repairs: Inspect and maintain the system across mechanical, hydraulic, and electrical components. Your responsibilities will also include tasks such as monitoring and maintaining the hydraulic oil. • Troubleshooting: Analyse technical issues, resolve faults, and document both the solution and the underlying cause. • Service development: Create and continuously improve maintenance schedules, spare parts lists, and technical service documentation for the system. • Spare parts management: Keep track of spare parts stored on site and ensure they are managed in a structured and reliable way. Your Profile as a Maintenance Technician • You have a technical background in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, energy technology , or a comparable technical qualification. • You have practical experience in the mechanical maintenance and repair of technical systems or machinery. • You have a solid understanding of hydraulic systems and are able to independently understand technical relationships and identify potential issues. • You are available for 20 to 30 hours per week and are flexible enough to occasionally work early mornings, evenings, or weekends when suitable maintenance windows are available at the terminal. • You enjoy taking responsibility, work independently, and remain calm and solution oriented when dealing with technical problems. • You enjoy working directly on technical equipment and outdoors and feel comfortable in an active traffic and logistics environment. • The ability to confidently read technical drawings, hydraulic schematics, and electrical circuit diagrams is an advantage. Would you like to do more than simply maintain a globally unique GreenTech system and actively help shape how its future operation and service structure are developed? ⚡ Then send us your CV and learn more about the company, the technology, and your future role in a short ten minute introductory call . title: CDI - BARISTA - Flagship Le Marais
description: AMI cherche un.e nouvel.le ambassadeur.drice BARISTA pour rejoindre notre Flagship du Marais . Chez AMI, nous avons à cœur de créer une expérience client à la fois chaleureuse, authentique et exigeante, à l’image de notre Maison. Sous la responsabilité du Store Manager, vous contribuez à offrir une expérience accueillante et qualitative à nos clients à travers la préparation et le service des boissons, tout en veillant à la qualité et au bon fonctionnement de l’espace Café de la boutique. Vos principales missions seront les suivantes : Accueil et relation client Accueillir chaque client, conseiller sur la carte, créer une expérience à la hauteur de l'image de la Maison Assurer la fluidité du service en période d'affluence Faire le lien avec les équipes de la boutique : le Café et le Retail partagent le même espace et la même clientèle Préparation des boissons Extraction espresso, boissons lactées et latte art. Création de recettes d'espresso et de filtre pour chaque nouveau café. Réglages quotidiens du moulin et de la machine, contrôle de la constance tout au long du service Dégustation et ajustement des recettes, participation aux évolutions de la carte Gestion des stocks et des achats Suivi des niveaux de stock (café, lait, consommables, packaging) Passage des commandes fournisseurs et relation directe avec eux (torréfacteur, grossistes, consommables) Réception et contrôle des livraisons, gestion des DLC, limitation des pertes Inventaires réguliers et remontée des écarts Gestion du matériel Nettoyage quotidien et hebdomadaire des machines, du moulin et de l'ensemble du poste Planification et suivi des maintenances préventives, gestion de la relation avec les techniciens Détection et signalement des dysfonctionnements, gestion des interventions curatives Respect et suivi des règles d'hygiène applicables au poste Encadrement Encadrer et former le second barista : gestes techniques, standards de service, montée en compétence Organiser les plannings du binôme et la répartition des tâches Participer aux recrutements à venir : définition du besoin, entretiens, intégration des nouveaux arrivants Expérience confirmée en tant que barista en coffee shop de spécialité (2 à 3 ans minimum) -Maîtrise technique : réglages, extraction, latte art -Autonomie démontrée sur les stocks et la relation fournisseurs -À l'aise avec l'entretien et la maintenance courante du matériel -Connaissance de la filière café de spécialité (torréfacteurs, sourcing, tendances) Vous êtes curieux.se et avez envie de vous investir dans un tout nouveau projet. Vous êtes souriant.e, dynamique, impliqué.e et doté.e d'excellentes qualités relationnelles. Vous avez un sens développé du service client et avez à cœur de satisfaire les besoins de la clientèle. Vous avez une forte sensibilité pour la Mode et à l'univers de la marque La pratique de l'anglais est indispensable . Date de démarrage : 15 novembre. Why join the « F.ami.LY »? Ami Paris se distingue par la sincérité de son expression. Nous réunissons des personnes passionnées et motivées, qui travaillent avec cœur et une énergie positive dans un cadre respectueux. Chaque membre de l’équipe contribue à créer un environnement dynamique, ou créativité et engagement vont de pair. Rejoignez une Maison de mode en pleine croissance, engagée et bienveillante, où chacun peut apporter sa personnalité et contribuer à une aventure collective. Nous recherchons des personnalités qui savent créer du lien, prendre des initiatives et faire preuve d’implication. Chez Ami, la qualité de l’expérience client repose autant sur le savoir-faire que sur le savoir-être : confiance, optimisme, créativité, engagement et esprit d’équipe. Nous sommes convaincus que la diversité de nos équipes est une force. Nous étudions toutes les candidatures avec la même attention, sans distinction de genre, de handicap, d'origine, d'âge ou d'orientation. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d)
description: Über die Position Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus Connected Growers entwickelt June: Die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche. Dafür suchen wir einen Product Manager (m/w/d) für unseren Bereich Grower Experience, der gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design unsere Anwendung für Gartenbaubetriebe weiterentwickelt. Deine Rolle bei June Als Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Produktentwicklung unserer Anwendung für Gärtner*innen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO. Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. Du entwickelst daraus technische Lösungen und Standards für die Branche. Du definierst relevante KPIs für deinen Produktbereich und misst den Erfolg deiner Arbeit konsequent an ihnen. Anforderungen Was du mitbringst Mindestens 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-Softwareprodukten. Erfahrung im eigenständigen Führen von User Interviews, Bereitschaft zu unregelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Besuchen bei Gärtner*innen. (Führerschein erforderlich) Kenntnisse gängiger Tracking- und Analytics-Tools. Exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation (Roadmaps, PRDs). AI-Erfahrung am Puls der Zeit: Du bist bei neuen Entwicklungen up-to-date und findest wege, wie du AI für Deine Arbeit und eingebettet im Softwareteam effizient nutzen kannst. Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch. Das wäre ein Plus Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel. Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung. Aufgabenbereich Was du bei uns bewegst Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience. Du sprichst wöchentlich eigenständig mit unseren Gärtner*innen, baust Beziehungen zu ihnen auf und triffst die Betriebe in unregelmäßigen Abständen auch vor Ort. Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst. Du verstehst und artikulierst den Business Value deiner Produktentscheidungen, u. a. über KPI-Frameworks, und nutzt Tracking- und Analytics-Daten, um Annahmen zu validieren und Produktentscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen. Du kommunizierst Roadmaps, PRDs und Produktentscheidungen klar und überzeugend – schriftlich wie mündlich. Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich in deinem Alltag – für Prototyping, eigene Datenanalysen und einen effizienten, AI-gestützten Produktentwicklungsprozess gemeinsam mit deinem Engineering-Team. Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf unser Produkt, unsere Kunden und den Erfolg von June. So arbeiten wir Unsere Produktteams verantworten ihre Bereiche vollständig: von der Produktstrategie über User Research und Priorisierung bis hin zum Release und den kommerziellen KPIs ihres Bereichs. Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering übernehmt ihr Verantwortung für den Erfolg eures Produktbereichs und arbeitet kontinuierlich daran, ihn zu verbessern. Wir sprechen regelmäßig mit unseren Kunden, besuchen sie vor Ort und testen unsere Lösungen gemeinsam mit ihnen. Wir glauben, dass gute Produktentscheidungen nur entstehen, wenn man die Probleme der Nutzer wirklich versteht. Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, treffen Entscheidungen früh und passen sie an, wenn neue Erkenntnisse entstehen. Wir haben starke Meinungen, halten aber nicht dogmatisch an ihnen fest. Verantwortung endet bei uns nicht mit dem Release. Die Perspektive Was dich erwartet Die Möglichkeit, Produktverantwortung für einen der zentralen Bereiche von June zu übernehmen. Die Chance, den europäischen Gartenbau grundlegend zu verändern Ein erfahrenes Design, Product und Engineering-Team an deiner Seite. Großer Gestaltungsspielraum für Produktstrategie und Roadmap. Viel Verantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege. Modernes, AI-gestütztes Arbeiten im gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess. Die Möglichkeit, unsere Produktkultur aktiv mitzugestalten. Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei den Gärtner*innen vor Ort. Hinweis: Die Stelle wird zunächst über Bridgemaker besetzt und im weiteren Verlauf zu Connected Growers überführt. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Data Center Facilities Operations Technician (all genders)
description: Your creative field We are looking for a full-time, permanent Data Center Facilities Operations Technician (all genders) to join our new data center in Lauterbourg as soon as possible . Our customers all around the world rely on Contabo's infrastructure. With our support they run their businesses and store their data. What they never see is what makes it all possible: the humming servers, the precisely cooled halls and our power systems that never sleep. That's your world. As a Data Center Facilities Operations Technician at our Lauterbourg site, you are the person who makes sure the lights stay on. You know your facility better than anyone: every cable tray, every cooling unit, every alarm. You monitor and maintain our complete infrastructure: electrical systems from MV/LV distribution to grounding, UPS systems kept tested and ready and HVAC/cooling systems that keep everything running at optimal temperature and efficiency. You work hands-on with our Building Management System, catch issues before they become incidents and when something does go wrong, you're the one who keeps calm, diagnoses fast and gets things back on track. Beyond day-to-day operations, you'll plan and execute preventive maintenance, coordinate with external subcontractors and continuously push to make our processes sharper and more reliable. Over time, you'll take the lead on maintenance activities, develop predictive approaches and eventually help shape the infrastructure strategy itself. Also it’s important that you have fun to pass your knowledge on to our technicians in the team. To be honest: there's never been a more exciting time to join us. We're not just maintaining a data center; we're still in the process building one hall. A brand-new HPC facility is taking shape on site and you'll be part of that from The Ground up. Your fingerprints will be on the infrastructure that powers Contabo's next chapter. The Presales Engineer is a critical part of the sales team focused on our both New Business and Strategic segments.</p> <p>Twilio’s Presales Engineers are responsible for delivering the Technical Win and best Product Fit to our customers. For this role, approximately 35% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way. </p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Twilio thinks big. Do you?</strong></p> <p>We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call <a href="https://www.twilio.com/company/values">Twilio Magic</a>. Additionally, we empower employees to build <a href="https://twilio.org/support-and-resources/impact-fund">positive change in their communities</a> by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.</p> <p>So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, <a href="https://www.twilio.com/company/jobs#open-positions">please consider other open positions.</a></p> <p><strong><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span></strong></p> <p><strong>Stay alert to recruitment fraud</strong></p> <p>We care about your safety. title: Scientist I, Platform Innovation
description: About us Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. We believe the future of medicine lies in reprogramming the body to repair itself, and we design the models and the medicines to teach it how. Our EDEN models are trained on BaseData, the world's largest proprietary genomic dataset, with over 10B genes collected through partnerships in more than 30 countries across all seven continents. This gives our AI models access to genetic diversity that doesn't exist in public databases, and enables EDEN to design cell and gene therapies, enzymes, and peptides directly from information about a disease. Our pipeline of EDEN-designed therapeutics, beginning with in vivo cell therapy, is advancing towards clinical development. In September 2026 we closed an oversubscribed $140M Series C led by S32, with participation from NVIDIA, Anthropic's Anthology Fund, Catalio, European Tech Collective, Firebrand River Capital, King Philanthropies, NATO Innovation Fund, NVentures (NVIDIA's venture arm), Redalpine, Rockefeller Foundation, Singular, Sovereign AI and True Ventures. We have offices and labs in London and Boston, we partner with biopharma companies and academic institutions worldwide, and our work has been recognised by Fast Company's Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Biotech, the FT-backed Sifted AI100 list of Europe's leading AI startups as well as Barclays Eagle Labs Ones to watch, AI100. At Basecamp Research, we pride ourselves on being a lean collaborative and global team with extremely specialist and unique skills. Our biologists, engineers, ML scientists and field explorers are united by a sense of adventure and the belief that AI, biology and data, will result in new medicines for patients who have few options today. The Role We are seeking a highly capable and proactive Scientist I, Platform Innovation to join our Cambridge, MA team, reporting to the Head of Innovation Science. This role will establish our new platform innovation lab, leveraging our proprietary biodiversity knowledge to develop transformative solutions in gene editing and cellular engineering—specifically targeted cargo integration in dividing and non-dividing cells. You are an energetic and highly motivated scientist with broad experience in gene editing, NGS assay development, and protein engineering. You're comfortable with cutting-edge tools in molecular biology, cellular engineering, and high-throughput screening, with demonstrated expertise in developing and productionizing new assays. This is a collaborative position working closely with our Data Science and AI teams to tackle some of the most exciting and unique challenges in the field. Key Responsibilities Contribute to establishing a new screening platform for discovery and engineering of novel gene editing tools. You will work closely with other team members. Responsibilities include: Contribute to strategy for design, build, test cycles of novel protein enzymes, with a strong emphasis on discovery, validation, and engineering of novel gene editing tools; Build and screen plasmid libraries, and develop the cloning workflows that let us do it at scale; Quantify editing outcomes using ddPCR, qPCR, flow-cytometry and NGS readouts. Optimise hits for activity and specificity using human primary cells and cell lines to develop leads for therapeutic development; Contribute to an open and high-integrity scientific culture at Basecamp Research; Establish strong documentation practices and lab SOPs as a founding member of the lab team. Required Skills and Experience A PhD in molecular biology, biochemistry, genetics, bioengineering, or a life-sciences related field, or an MSc with equivalent hands-on laboratory experience. Experience with gene editing, NGS assay development, protein engineering and cell therapy; Experience with high-throughput methods of cloning and producing DNA constructs for cellular screening; Experience with mammalian cell culture, transfection, and cell-line generation; Knowledge of emerging technologies in gene editing and on/off-target analytics that enable regulatory approval; Expertise with DNA/RNA extraction, PCR, ddPCR, NGS library preparation and QC Excellent communication skills to both internal and external stakeholders Advantageous Skills and Experience Experience contributing to a preclinical cell therapy program (in vivo or ex vivo); Expertise in flow cytometry using both antibody panels and fluorescent reporters; Experience developing novel methods for gene editing off-target analytics using both long and short-read sequencing; Mechanistic understanding of gene editing tools, including nucleases, base editors, transposons, retrotransposons, and recombinases; Ability to reason about proteins as molecular machines; Experience integrating AI protein design tools with high-throughput wet lab screening methodologies; Fluency in NGS instrumentation, basic bioinformatics tools, and traceable data pipelines. Proactive Problem-Solving: A proactive, resourceful, and independent mindset. You take initiative to identify problems or inefficiencies and act on them. You’re the kind of person who spots an issue and rallies the right people to fix it before it escalates. Adaptability: Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid change. Our environment evolves quickly – you should thrive in a dynamic setting and be flexible in adjusting plans, while maintaining a positive, can-do attitude. Ownership & Drive: High degree of ownership over your work. You care about outcomes and reliably follow through on tasks and take pride in delivering quality results. What we offer in return Impactful Mission: This is a rare opportunity to do work that genuinely matters. You'll join a talented, fast-moving team, access unique biological datasets at scale, and see your contributions shape real breakthroughs in AI and curative therapeutics. Collaborative Culture: You'll be surrounded by world-class engineers, scientists, and researchers who care deeply about their work and about each other. With offices in Boston and London, we've built a flexible, cross-functional environment where personal development and real ownership aren't just talking points. High Growth: We truly believe in investing our top talent, we make coaching available to team members during steep growth journeys and we have twice yearly promotion opportunities. People who are really successful here own it and go directly to solve problems at pace and we ensure reward increases with impact. Comprehensive Benefits: We've built a benefits package people value. That means competitive salary, equity, and healthcare so strong that most employees' family members opt into our plan over their own. We also offer Carrot Fertility with IVF stipend, 401(k), life insurance, and more. Salary ranges for this role are depending on skills and experience: $110K - $140K base. Apply for the job Do you want to join our team as our new Scientist I, Platform Innovation? Then we'd love to hear about you! We are committed to equal opportunity employment regardless of ethnic or national origin, race, religion, sex, age, citizenship, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, gender identity or any other basis. If you have a disability or additional need that needs accommodating do let us know. Compensation: $110K – $140K • $110K – $140K Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: AI Search Manager (m/w/d)

Unterstützt von TUM Venture Labs und NCA VC, in Forschungspartnerschaft mit der TUM, sind wir bereits live mit Kunden wie UniCredit, Axel Springer, Beurer, Lyceum Technologies und 50 weiteren Unternehmen. Automatisierung: Mit Claude Code oder Codex baust du dir Audits, Datenabzüge, Auswertungen und kleine interne Tools selbst. Reporting: Du zeigst Kunden im wöchentlichen Termin, was sich bewegt, von Klicks und CTR bis zu Zitationen in AI Search, und leitest klare nächste Schritte ab. Dein Erfolg ist messbar: wie viel mehr Conversion wurde durch die Sichtbarkeit in der KI Suche erzielt. Qualifikation 1-2 Jahre Berufserfahrung als SEO Manager in einer führenden SEO- oder Digitalagentur. Du bist vertraut mit Claude Code oder Codex und hast damit schon Skripte, Automatisierungen oder kleine Tools gebaut. Du willst verstehen, wie LLMs Quellen auswählen, und testest das lieber selbst, als darüber zu lesen. Google Search Console, Sistrix oder Ahrefs und Screaming Frog sind für dich Routine. Du kommunizierst klar und trittst vor Enterprise-Kunden sicher auf. Low ego, high ownership - dir ist wichtiger, dass es richtig ist, als recht zu haben. Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und sehr gutes Englisch, in Wort und Schrift. Gültige Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland.
