title: Tracking Specialist Intern
description: Hi, we’re Back Market. We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new . We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new. Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have. Are you ready to join us? JOB DESCRIPTION: The Data & Measurement team makes sure every interaction on our website and apps is measured accurately, reliably and in a privacy-compliant way. We own the tracking architecture (Google Tag Manager web and server-side, GA4, advertising platform tags) across 17 markets. The data we collect powers marketing performance, product analytics and business decisions across the company. Be a part of the movement. Join the circular revolution. YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇 Implement and maintain tags, triggers and variables in our Google Tag Manager containers (web and server-side), for analytics and advertising platforms such as Google Ads and Meta. Specify and QA dataLayer events with our developers, and make sure new features ship with the right tracking. Run tracking audits and QA across markets: detect broken or missing events, investigate data discrepancies, and follow fixes through to production. Contribute to tracking monitoring by building checks and alerts on data quality in BigQuery. Make sure tracking respects user consent choices and privacy regulations, working with our consent management platform and legal teams. Keep our tracking plan and documentation up to date, so every team knows what is collected and why. Answer tracking questions from Marketing, Product and Data teams, and help them trust the numbers. YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐ You are in the final year of a Master's degree in engineering, business, data or digital marketing (or equivalent), looking for a 6-month internship. You have a first experience or a strong interest in web analytics and tag management (GTM, GA4 or similar). You understand JavaScript and can read, debug and write simple scripts, and you are comfortable with HTML and browser developer tools. You know some SQL, or want to get hands-on with BigQuery. You care about data quality and details, and enjoy investigating why a number looks wrong. You have an interest in privacy and consent topics (GDPR, cookies, CMPs). You communicate clearly and are comfortable working with developers, marketers and analysts. You are fluent in French and English (both are mandatory). BONUS POINT : Knowledge of server-side tagging, experience with an advertising platform (Google Ads, Meta), or a personal project involving tracking or data. ABOUT THE INTERNSHIP: Start date: January 2027 Duration : 6 months Full-time internship (35h/week) Location : Paris (France) RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅 Skill fit interview and live case study with a team member (45min) Video-call Interview with the Talent Acquisition Specialist (30 min) Cultural fit interview with the manager (30min) WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼 At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2). No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like: - A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously. - Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days. - Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training. At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values. We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications. If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team. title: Senior Technical Recruiter
description: Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors. Menlo Security's Talent Acquisition team builds great experiences for candidates and hiring teams alike. As a Senior Technical Recruiter, you'll be the trusted talent partner for department leaders across Engineering, Product, and Design, finding and closing the right people while protecting Menlo's distinctive, inclusive culture. You'll work closely with senior stakeholders as a subject matter expert on technical hiring, and you'll be part of a collaborative team that values ownership and high-quality work. The team uses AI-assisted sourcing and screening tools to move faster and reach a wider, more diverse pool of candidates, so you can spend more time on the parts of recruiting that need human judgment: relationship-building, negotiation, and candidate advocacy. Outcomes & KPIs Key Outcome(s) Owned: A strong, diverse pipeline of technical talent that consistently meets Menlo's hiring needs across Engineering, Product, and Design A consistently strong candidate and hiring-manager experience throughout the recruiting cycle Success Metrics / KPIs (drafted — adjust as needed): Time-to-fill for technical roles Pipeline diversity across stages Hiring manager satisfaction score Offer-acceptance rate Candidate experience score What You'll Do Own full-cycle recruiting for technical roles, primarily Engineering, Product, and Design, flexing to other teams as business needs shift Build an ongoing pipeline of skilled, diverse talent by combining market knowledge, business priorities, and external hiring trends Partner with senior leaders and hiring managers as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert on technical hiring Use AI-assisted sourcing and resume-screening tools to widen and speed up pipeline generation, then apply judgment on fit and bias review Improve recruiting processes, tools, and systems in partnership with the broader Talent Acquisition team to help Menlo scale Report on recruiting metrics and turn the data into clear, actionable recommendations Build talent communities and pipelines for hard-to-fill roles and diversity sourcing efforts that convert into real hires Functional Competencies Required: 6+ years sourcing and/or full-cycle recruiting for technical roles at technology companies A track record of successful full-cycle hiring at a fast-growing company Experience using an ATS (Menlo uses Ashby) to track candidates and report on recruiting metrics Ability to build trust and influence stakeholders at every level, from hiring managers to senior leaders A track record of creative sourcing to reach diverse and hard-to-find talent groups Strong written and verbal communication skills, with strong interpersonal awareness Preferred / Nice to Have: B2B SaaS recruiting experience Comfort using AI-assisted sourcing, screening, and interview-summary tools as part of daily recruiting work Experience building or scaling talent communities for critical or hard-to-fill skill areas MSGL-I4 Follow us on LinkedIn ! Why Menlo? At Menlo, we don't settle for the status quo — in our technology or our culture. How we think and act is just as important as what we build. Our culture is defined by five core mindsets: Proactive Leadership , Straight Talk , United Impact , Elevated Talent , and Customer-Compelled . We take ownership and drive outcomes without waiting to be told. We communicate directly and seek hard truths. We break down silos and win together. We hold a high bar for ourselves and the people around us. And we treat every customer interaction as mission-critical. If you're someone who sees it, owns it, solves it, and does it — you'll thrive here. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability . TO ALL AGENCIES: Please, no phone calls or emails to any employee of Menlo Security outside of the Talent organization. Menlo Security’s policy is to only accept resumes from agencies via Ashby (ATS). Agencies must have a valid services agreement executed and must have been assigned by the Talent team to a specific requisition. Any resume submitted outside of this process will be deemed the sole property of Menlo Security. In the event a candidate submitted outside of this policy is hired, no fee or payment will be paid. Bei Salonkee lernst du den Vertrieb von Grund auf kennen und baust dir in Berlin dein eigenes Netzwerk auf. Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software – von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen. Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche. Deine Rolle Du verantwortest das Wachstum in deiner Region und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson vor Ort Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu – telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise). Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann. Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss. Deine Woche planst du eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt. Das bringst du mit Vertriebserfahrung ist nicht unbedingt notwendig. Wenn du aus dem Hospitality, Beauty, Retail, Fitness, Event oder einem anderen Bereich mit viel Kundenkontakt kommst, bringst du das Wichtigste schon mit. Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch – egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort. Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken. Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn. Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln. Du bist strukturiert, organisiert und sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools. Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse. Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein. Das erwartet dich bei uns Vertrieb von Grund auf lernen: Bootcamp zum Start, gezieltes Ramp-Up Programm , Shadowing bei erfahrenen Kolleg:innen, Roleplays und regelmäßiges Coaching . Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region – du startest nicht allein. Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad : von Junior über Senior bis hin zu Führungsrollen. Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst. Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit. Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone. 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio. Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision . Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate. Wie geht es weiter? Bewerbung & Sichtung – wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30–45 Minuten). Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft. Field Day – zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales. Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität. title: Agentic Software Engineer (f/m/d)
description: Who is Sonar? Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable. Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code. We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like: SonarQube: The world's leading AI code review and verification platform. SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair. SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective. Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE: Committed to our customers and community. Obsessed with quality. Deliberate in our decisions. Effective as one team. With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you're hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you. The Impact You Will Have: As an Agentic Software Engineer on the Platform Architecture squad, you will build the multi-agent systems that autonomously refactor and modernize Sonar's own codebase — starting with one of our biggest technical bets: unifying SonarQube Cloud (SQC) and SonarQube Server (SQS) onto a single, portable architecture ("build once, deploy twice"). You will: Design and build agentic refactoring pipelines that can safely extract a domain's logic from our existing SQS/SQC codebases and re-platform it onto our Unified Core (a hexagonal "capability-core + adapters" architecture), with minimal human oversight. Define the guardrails that make autonomous refactoring safe at scale — verification gates, automated test generation, static analysis, and rollback strategies that let agents move fast without breaking production code relied on by 7M+ developers. Prove the approach on real migrations — Micronaut-to-Spring conversions, Lambda-to-container consolidations, API convergence (consolidating overlapping API surfaces onto shared contracts), and strangler-fig domain extractions — before scaling it into a repeatable, multi-agent "coding squad" capable of tackling many domains in parallel. Stay hands-on in the Java/Spring codebase often enough to critically review what the agents produce, recognize when a refactor is architecturally wrong, and correct the agentic loop that generated it — not just the output. What You Will Do Spend the majority of your time (roughly 70%) designing, building, and iterating on agentic tooling: orchestration, tool-use, context management, and evaluation harnesses for autonomous code-modification agents. Build and refine the verification layer that gates what agents are allowed to ship — automated test generation, regression detection, static analysis (using our own SonarQube), and human-in-the-loop checkpoints where warranted. Spend the remainder of your time (roughly 30%) hands-on in our Java/Spring codebase: reviewing agent-generated pull requests, fixing what they get wrong, and feeding those lessons back into the tooling. Partner closely with the Server, Cloud Platform, and value-stream squads whose domains you're migrating — earning their trust and buy-in matters as much as the code itself. Contribute to the Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and standards that govern how our platform evolves. Track and evaluate emerging agent frameworks and techniques, bringing back what's genuinely useful — as distinct from what's just hype — for accelerating engineering across Sonar. Experience and qualifications Hands-on experience building or operating multi-agent or LLM-agent systems in a real production setting — not just prompting a coding assistant, but designing the orchestration, tool-use, and guardrails around autonomous agents. Experience building evaluation or verification systems for AI-generated changes: automated testing, static analysis, regression detection, or comparable safety nets for code you didn't personally write. Strong software engineering fundamentals in Java and Spring (or a comparable JVM/enterprise stack) — enough to read a large, mature codebase critically and tell good architecture from bad. A track record of owning complex, ambiguous technical problems independently and driving them to resolution — this is an R&D-flavored role inside a production platform team, and you'll be shaping the playbook, not following one. Experience influencing engineers and squads you don't manage — the migrations you'll enable depend on their trust as much as on your code. Additional comments This role is based in Bochum, Germany . We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Bochum , but we are willing to relocate the right candidate. Benefits Pension Scheme: 1st Pillar (Unterstützungskasse): Automatic, financed by Sonar, 3% of gross salary, an additional benefit in addition to your salary. Pension Scheme:2nd Pillar (bAV): Voluntary, 15% contribution by Sonar from social security savings. We encourage usage of our robust time-off allocations with 28 PTO days plus additional days based on seniority and circumstances. Sonar recognizes holidays on working calendar days. If the holiday date occurs on a Saturday, we will recognize the day on the preceding Friday. If the holiday date occurs on a Sunday, we will recognize the day on the following Monday. Public transport reimbursement of 60% for annual subscription. Generous discretionary Company Growth Bonus, paid annually. Global workforce with employees in 20+ countries representing 35+ unique nationalities. We have an annual kick-off somewhere in the world where we meet to build relationships and goals for the company. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at . title: Engineering Manager (m/w/d)
description: Wer wir sind Wir sind Xempus, Deutschlands führende unabhängige Software-as-Service (SaaS)-Plattform für den Vertrieb und die Verwaltung betrieblicher Vorsorgelösungen. Unsere Mission: Betriebliche Vorsorge digital und verständlich, effizient und für jeden zugänglich zu machen. Seit 2007 arbeiten wir stetig daran, die Digitalisierung der Versicherungsbranche voranzutreiben. Wir bei Xempus sind davon überzeugt, dass wir alle gemeinsam etwas bewirken können – egal von wo! Ob von einem unserer Büros oder von zu Hause ­– Komm zu uns und lass uns gemeinsam eine sicherere Zukunft für alle schaffen! Was Dich erwartet Du führst unsere Software Engineers disziplinarisch und fachlich. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit mehreren cross-funktionalen Teams zusammen und unterstützt sie bei ihrer persönlichen und fachlichen Entwicklung. Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Engineering-Aktivitäten mit der Unternehmensvision und den strategischen Produktzielen von Xempus im Einklang stehen. Du arbeitest eng mit Product, Operations, Customer-facing Teams und weiteren Stakeholdern zusammen, um technische Möglichkeiten mit geschäftlichen Anforderungen zu verbinden. Du entwickelst unsere Engineering-Prozesse, Wissensmanagement-Formate und Standards kontinuierlich weiter. Du unterstützt die langfristige Weiterentwicklung und Modernisierung unserer Plattform – mit Blick auf Stabilität, Performance, Wartbarkeit und Skalierbarkeit. Du begleitest Projekte und Produkte bis in den produktiven Betrieb und stellst gemeinsam mit den Teams einen zuverlässigen laufenden Betrieb sicher. Du kannst dich schnell in große, komplexe Codebasen einarbeiten, erkennst übergreifende Zusammenhänge und leitest daraus fundierte Architekturentscheidungen ab. Du verfügst über ein sehr gutes Verständnis von Softwarearchitektur, Design Patterns, Clean Code und modernen Engineering-Prinzipien. Du denkst strategisch und kannst langfristige Pläne für die Weiterentwicklung, Modernisierung und schrittweise Verbesserung gewachsener Systeme entwickeln und umsetzen. Du hast Freude daran, bestehende Systeme zu analysieren, zu refaktorieren und nachhaltig zu verbessern – ohne Stabilität und Performance aus dem Blick zu verlieren. Du kennst dich mit Datenbanken, APIs und dem gesamten Softwareentwicklungsprozess aus – von der technischen Konzeption über die Umsetzung bis zum Betrieb. Du hast Erfahrung in der fachlichen und disziplinarischen Führung sowie im Coaching und in der Weiterentwicklung von Software Engineers. Du kannst technische Projekte strukturieren, priorisieren und gemeinsam mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern erfolgreich umsetzen. Du treibst den Einsatz von KI aktiv voran - von KI-gestützter Softwareentwicklung über automatisierte Qualitätssicherung bis hin zur Optimierung unserer Entwicklungsabläufe. Du kommunizierst sicher mit technischen und nicht-technischen Ansprechpartnern und agierst souverän zwischen Engineering, Product, Management und externen Partnern. Du arbeitest gerne in einem agilen Umfeld, gehst konstruktiv mit Veränderungen um und bringst dich aktiv in die kontinuierliche Verbesserung unserer Entwicklungsprozesse ein. Den Aufbau von Direct Sourcing treibst du strategisch voran. Bei dir laufen alle Fäden zusammen und du entwickelst die Menschen weiter. Krisen- & Konfliktmanagement: Wenn es intern oder bei Suppliern brennt, bleibst du ruhig, deeskalierst und findest Lösungen. Erfahrung : Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Product Development, Sourcing und Supply Chain, idealerweise in der Textilbranche. Die Kategorie ist zweitrangig, Fashion-Erfahrung ist ein Plus. Leadership-Erfahrung : Du hast bereits Teams und Führungskräfte geführt und tust das mit Empathie, Klarheit und echtem Interesse an den Menschen. Product Development : Du bringst fundiertes Know-how in der Produktentwicklung mit, von der Idee über Sampling bis zur Serienreife, und erkennst, was ein Produkt erfolgreich macht. Sourcing & Supply Chain : Du hast Supplier-Landschaften bereits aktiv gesteuert, kennst Produktions- und Lieferprozesse im Detail und kannst Kosten, Qualität und Timings fachlich challengen. QM & Sustainability : Du hast ein solides Grundverständnis für Qualitätsmanagement und Nachhaltigkeit. Strategie & Hands-on : Du denkst strategisch, arbeitest aber genauso gern operativ mit, vor allem in der Supplier-Kommunikation. Ins kalte Wasser zu springen schreckt dich nicht ab. Verhandlungsstärke : Du verhandelst souverän und selbstbewusst, auch dann, wenn es ungemütlich wird. Sourcing-Netzwerk : Ein bestehendes Netzwerk im Direct Sourcing oder Erfahrung im Aufbau davon ist ein dickes Plus. Erfahrung mit Produktion in China und Pakistan ebenso. Mindset : Du sagst klar deine Meinung, übernimmst Ownership wie für dein eigenes Business und gehst mit viel Freiraum verantwortungsvoll um. Reisebereitschaft & Präsenz : Du bist regelmäßig vor Ort in Mannheim und Berlin und reist gern zu unseren Suppliern, bei Bedarf auch spontan. Sprachen : Sehr sichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. description: About us At CYCLE, we're redefining urban mobility for the people who keep cities moving: couriers, riders, and delivery pros. Our mission is simple: make last-mile delivery more reliable, affordable, and sustainable, one ride at a time. With every bike we deploy, we're helping build the backbone of smarter, greener cities. Your Mission As Head of Supply Chain , you own every part of how physical goods reach our fleet and our riders, from the purchase order to the shelf to the courier's bike. You report to our Director of Operations and work directly with Hardware, Finance, Software and our country teams. In particular you will: Own supply chain end to end: Purchasing, warehousing, stock keeping and outbound logistics across our European network, as one function with one owner. You ultimately ensure we have the right number of bikes, batteries and parts at the right time, the right place and the best price. Oversee our assembly & refurbishment activities: Manage our assembly and refurbishment partners, own the bills of material for everything we build from purchased components as well as internal refurbishment within our locations. Own the systems, not just the process: Take full responsibility for our ERP and warehouse management setup for all supply chain topics, from data model and master data through to daily execution – you will be the business owner to our software team and guide implementation. Professionalize the structure: Design and implement the processes, controls and physical setup our growing operation needs, and then get your hands dirty making them real and ensuring your organization internalizes them. Own the numbers behind the goods: You will guide the rest of the company on such topics as transfer prices, landed cost allocation and other supply-chain related financials, ensuring each business line's P&L is accurately reflecting parts consumption and asset usage – together with our Finance team. Drive the agenda across teams: Set priorities, align Hardware, Finance and Tech behind them, and hold the line when it matters. Partner with the larger organization and understand your impact on them: All you do, you do with the end goal in mind to become the best friend of our Local and Country Operations and Sales teams, who all depend on your fulfillment excellence to grow and maintain their businesses. Lead and grow your team: Build a supply chain organization that scales with us across markets. Your skills and qualifications We are looking for someone who has built structure inside a well-run company and is ready to build it again from scratch, with their sleeves rolled up. Ideally you bring: 10+ years of relevant professional experience, of which at least 5 in a managerial supply chain or operations role. Experience leading a team of at least 3 direct reports in a supply chain or operations-heavy function. Structure from an established company: You have worked inside proper processes and systems and know what good looks like. 0 to 1 experience: You have also built something from nothing in a smaller or fast-moving company or demonstrated you can excel in such a setting, and you are comfortable being scrappy when that is what the situation needs. Commercial and financial fluency: Working capital optimization, inter-company transactions or product costing, are all familiar territory for you. Cross-functional communication: You can carry a topic across teams and drive it to a decision. Ownership and a firm, professional attitude: You take the whole problem, not your part of it. English at C1 level or above Nice to have: Hands-on experience with Odoo or a comparable ERP, ideally including experience in shaping or designing a system for supply chain topics rather than execution alone. Background in bike, scooter, mobility or another hardware-heavy industry where physical goods move between internal as well as external locations. German or Dutch What you can expect from us Exciting industry: You will work in the dynamic world of mobility, which is a constantly evolving sector. Real impact: Your work improves the lives of many bike couriers. Take on immediate responsibility: Start making a difference right away and implement your own ideas. Boredom? Not a chance! Shape the future: As part of our growing start-up, you will help to shape tomorrow's mobility. International team & Strong network: Work alongside motivated colleagues from all over the world. Teamwork is very important to us. Fair conditions: We offer a stable employment with attractive salary, €50 HRmony voucher , a company e-bike, modern equipment and 28 days' holiday a year. title: Werkstudent im Bereich Legal / Compliance (d/m/w)
description: Ihre Aufgaben Bei NYALA begleitest Du die Weiterentwicklung unseres Angebots von juristischer Seite. Du lernst, regulatorische Anforderungen umzusetzen sowie zu diesen mit den Aufsichtsbehörden zu kommunizieren. Dabei wendest Du den bestehenden Rechtsrahmen aus eWpG, eWpRV, KWG und GwG an, entwickelst unsere Produkte in diesem weiter, begleitest mit uns aktuelle Entwicklungen bei der Gesetzgebung und nimmst über Stellungnahmen und Konsultationen aktiv Einfluss auf die Weiterentwicklung der Gesetzgebung zur Blockchain-Technologie. Du hast damit nicht nur die Möglichkeit, die geltenden Regelungen auf konkrete Sachverhalte im Unternehmen anzuwenden (und das anders als in der Kanzlei umfassend und gestaltend, nicht nur im Rahmen eines beschränkten Beratungsauftrags), sondern auch zukünftige Entwicklungen aktiv mitzugestalten. Im operativen Tagesgeschäft arbeitest du direkt dem Geldwäsche-, Compliance- und Risikobeauftragten zu, bereitest Sachverhalte entscheidungsreif auf und hältst Fristen, Maßnahmen und Wiedervorlagen nach. Im Schwerpunkt des Berichtswesens erstellst du Vorlagen für die Berichte an Funktionsträger im Unternehmen, pflegst Kennzahlen und Auswertungen, hältst Richtlinien, Handbücher und Arbeitsanweisungen aktuell und unterstützt bei Jahresabschluss- und Sonderprüfungen. Ihr Profil Du brennst für Technologie und speziell DLT, glaubst an die revolutionäre Chance der Blockchain im Finanzsystem und hast Interesse an kapitalmarktrechtlichen Fragestellungen. Vollständige Vorkenntnisse in eWpG, GwG und KWG erwarten wir nicht; ein großer Teil dieses Rechtsrahmens ist selbst erst wenige Jahre alt und entwickelt sich beständig weiter. Wir erwarten Sorgfalt im Detail, Verbindlichkeit bei Fristen, die Fähigkeit, komplizierte Sachverhalte knapp und nachvollziehbar zu verschriftlichen, und Diskretion im Umgang mit Kunden- und Unternehmensdaten. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch ist für Aufsichtskorrespondenz und im Meldewesen erforderlich, Englisch für Korrespondenz mit internationalen Kunden und für die Interpretation von Rechtstexten von Vorteil. Warum wir? Compliance ist bei uns nicht nur nachgelagerte Kontrollinstanz, sondern Voraussetzung des Geschäftsmodells: ohne belastbare Registerführung und rechtssichere Verfahrensabläufe gibt es kein Kryptowertpapier. Du arbeitest deshalb nicht an einem Ausschnitt, sondern siehst den vollständigen Zyklus – von der Anbahnung eines Emittenten über die Aufnahme in das Register bis zur Berichterstattung an Geschäftsführung und Aufsicht. Die Smart Registry als Institut bietet hervorragende Voraussetzungen, über den Tellerrand zu schauen: Viele unserer Produkte werden durch neue Gesetze erst ermöglicht und erst in Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden entwickelt. Wir waren im Februar 2024 der erste Kryptowertpapierregisterführer, welche elektronische Aktien nach dem eWpG eingetragen hat. Werde Teil eines motivierten, technikbegeisterten und internationalen Teams mit starker Unternehmenskultur direkt am Ku'damm in Berlin. Wir bieten dir Einarbeitung unmittelbar durch die Beauftragten, direkten Zugang zur Geschäftsführung – und die Perspektive, in Themen eigenverantwortlich hineinzuwachsen. Wer eine große, arbeitsteilige Compliance-Abteilung sucht, ist bei uns falsch; wer früh Verantwortung und einen ungewöhnlich vollständigen Blick auf ein reguliertes Geschäft will, richtig. title: Cloud Platform Engineer (m/w/d)
description: Ab sofort Das erwartet dich Wir bauen mit unserem Green-Field-Ansatz eine neue Cloud in unseren deutschen Rechenzentren auf — vollständig selbst gehostet, cloud-native und ohne Abhängigkeit von amerikanischen Hyperscalern. B. title: Product Engineer (m/w/d)
description: Warum LPE Immobilien? Die Hausverwaltung ist der unterschätzteste Beruf Deutschlands: Kein anderer entscheidet so unmittelbar darüber, wie Menschen wohnen. Trotzdem gilt der Hausverwalter bis heute als Buchhalter mit Schlüsselbund. Wir wollen das ändern, und Software ist dafür einer unserer zentralen Hebel. Mit lpeOS bauen wir die Systeme, mit denen wir selbst jeden Tag arbeiten: das Kundenportal für unsere Eigentümer, KI-Agenten, die eigenständig Aufgaben übernehmen, und das Verwaltercockpit als Arbeitsumgebung unserer Verwalter. Wir digitalisieren unsere eigenen Prozesse, um die Arbeit unserer Verwalter jeden Tag ein Stück besser zu machen, mit dem Anspruch, die Branche zu revolutionieren. Kaum eine Branche wurde von moderner Software so lange übersehen. Der Abstand zwischen dem, was ist, und dem, was möglich ist, ist riesig, und wir bauen ihn Stück für Stück zu. Du wärst eine der ersten Personen im Produktteam. Was dich bei uns erwartet – Deine Aufgaben Du entwickelst Fullstack in TypeScript , vom Kundenportal über das Verwaltercockpit bis zu den Services und der Infrastruktur dahinter, auf der grünen Wiese und ohne Altlasten. Features verantwortest du end-to-end: von der Idee über die Gestaltung bis zum Release, bei Bedarf auch ohne Designer an deiner Seite. Du baust KI-Agenten als Produktfunktionalität für unsere Verwalter und Kunden. Zugleich entwickeln wir unsere eigene Entwicklungsumgebung permanent weiter: ein modernes Setup rund um Cursor und Claude Code, inklusive Agent-Graph-Loops und Harness. Dabei arbeitest du nah an den Nutzern : Deine Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Kunden sind direkt erreichbar, Feedback bekommst du auf kurzem und direktem Weg. Wir sammeln Probleme, bewerten sie und bauen die wichtigsten in festen Cycles. Unser Stack : TypeScript durchgehend, mit React und Next.js im Frontend und Node im Backend, als Monorepo auf Google Cloud (Infrastructure as Code), dazu Postgres und event-getriebene Prozesse. title: Senior Product Manager - Client Communication
description: Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. In both cases, you will act as the bridge between engineering, operations, and business teams to ensure initiatives land with minimal disruption and maximum value.</p> <p class="FIRBody">As the owner of program delivery, you will translate ambiguity into structured, phased plans, manage complex technical dependencies across stakeholders, and keep everyone aligned from working teams through to executive leadership. You will drive implementation, ensure milestones and adoption targets are met, establish feedback loops, and make the technical trade-off decisions that balance delivery velocity with customer and business impact—whether the “customer” sits outside the company or within it.</p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335551550":6,"335551620":6,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing">Key Responsibilities</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p class="FIRBodyList">You’ll own the delivery of your programs end to end – turning ambiguous goals into structured, phased plans with clear scope, timelines, and milestones, and running the operating rhythm of daily or weekly syncs, executive status meetings, and stakeholder communications that keep everyone aligned on readiness, roadmaps, and impact. Throughout, you’ll make the technical trade-off decisions that balance internal velocity against customer and business impact.</p> <p class="FIRBodyList">Depending on the assignment, that delivery is either externally facing—acting as the trusted point of contact for major hyper-scalers and frontier model builders, owning customer communications and advisories, and driving adoption milestones and feedback loops—or internally facing, leading the cross-team platform and infrastructure programs that power Firmus AI Cloud and aligning internal sponsors and engineering leaders on roadmaps and delivery. Either way, you’ll apply the same rigour and stakeholder discipline.</p> <p class="FIRBodyList">Across both, you’ll bring enough command of our systems—AI Factory architecture, GPU performance and benchmarking, and infrastructure constraints—to answer questions directly and validate impact assessments rather than just relaying between teams. You’ll orchestrate delivery across engineering, operations, and customer-facing functions, and run a regular leadership cadence to manage escalations and hold communication timelines.</p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559685":720,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p> </p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing">Skills & Experience</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335551550":6,"335551620":6,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p class="FIRBody">You’ll bring at least 10 years in Technical Program or Project Management, including 4+ years leading large-scale transformation programs, whether that’s with direct external customer exposure or delivering internal enterprise programs. Just as important is technical fluency across the AI/ML stack: a robust understanding of AI hardware, large-scale networks, and cloud architectures, grounded in practical experience building, scaling, and operating high-density infrastructure and systems.</p> <p class="FIRBody">Communication is central to this role. You can draft a customer-facing advisory that is clear, empathetic, and technically accurate – not a cut-and-paste from an LLM – and you use a range of tools (like Jira) day to day to build the artifacts and plans that organize, communicate, and drive customer and program success. You pair this with strong stakeholder management across Sales, Customer Success, Operations, and internal engineering leaders, and you’re comfortable in high-ambiguity environments where program structures often need to be created rather than simply followed.</p> <p class="FIRBody">Ideally, you bring a proven track record delivering programs such as enterprise feature rollouts with title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Optimove, we believe people are capable of more than a single job description. You’re not hired just to fill a position- you’re empowered to shape it, grow it, and make it your own.<br>We call this being Positionless.<br>And Positionless isn’t just our culture. It’s our product.<br>Optimove is the creator of Positionless Marketing, an AI-powered platform that gives every marketer the power to analyze, create, launch, and optimize independently. The result is faster execution, deeper personalization, and 88% greater campaign efficiency.<br>Recognized as a Visionary in Gartner’s Magic Quadrant, we partner with leading brands like Sephora, Staples, and Entain. Today, more than 500 Optimovers across NYC, London, Tel Aviv, Scotland, Brazil, Estonia, and beyond are building the future of marketing together, in an environment that actively encourages ownership and growth, with two out of every three managers promoted from within.<br>If you’re looking for a place where you can do more, be more, come grow with us.</p></div><p> </p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>As a Machine Learning Engineer, you'll join our Personalize team, helping shape and build the products that let our customers personalise messages across every digital touchpoint. You'll work with text data and with cutting-edge technologies including Large Language Models (LLMs), bringing Accessible Intelligence to our customers across both Personalize and Optimove's overall platforms.</p> <p>This is a role for an engineer who's ready to own meaningful, medium-sized pieces of our personalisation roadmap end-to-end - from problem framing through to deployment and monitoring - and trusted to do so with minimal oversight. It's not solo delivery: you'll be working closely with a dynamic team spanning ML, MLOps and software engineering, and should be happy to contribute at every level, from early-stage research through to production support.</p> <p><strong>Role & Core Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the delivery of medium-sized ML features end-to-end within Personalize - problem framing, data preparation, model build/train, evaluation, deployment and monitoring - to predictable timelines.</li> <li>Develop predictive ML models for classification, ranking and personalisation, working with our text data.</li> <li>Leverage LLMs and other state-of-the-art techniques to enhance product capabilities.</li> <li>Operationalise models as APIs across real-time and batch environments.</li> <li>Monitor production models in your own scope, treating data quality issues and model degradation as a priority.</li> <li>Research new ML applications and improve pre-existing models, sharing findings with the wider ML, MLOps and engineering team.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with product, MLOps and engineering teams to define and prepare new ML applications, contributing meaningfully to planning and grooming.</li> <li>Proactively surface and resolve technical and data challenges before they affect delivery, model quality or customers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Best Bits of the Job</strong></p> <ul> <li>Exposure to a wide range of ML domains, including large-scale search, ranking, Natural Language Processing, hybridisation, classification and text data processing.</li> <li>Working with modern ML technologies, including LLMs, to enhance our products.</li> <li>Fully real-time architecture for data processing, model development and deployment.</li> <li>Deploying and enhancing ML frameworks, optimising for inference and training/retraining cycles.</li> <li>Online testing of models with live data, using our proprietary A/B/N testing technology to see quickly what performs well.</li> <li>A supportive, collaborative team spanning ML, MLOps and software engineering, where rapid experimentation is the norm.</li> <li>Dedicated time to research new methods, build proofs-of-concept, and ship to production quickly when they work.</li> <li>Everyday use of modern AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude) to speed up experimentation and review.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Essential Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics or a related field, <strong>OR</strong> 1–4 years' professional experience building and deploying ML models.</li> <li>Strong understanding of core ML concepts - supervised/unsupervised learning, model evaluation, feature engineering - and broad familiarity with common algorithms and architectures.</li> <li>Strong Python (pandas, NumPy, etc.) and SQL skills</li> <li>Comfortable with the standard ML toolkit: Git, Docker, scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow, and ML pipelines.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with text data and relevant Natural Language Processing techniques.</li> <li>Solid experience with cloud technologies and data storage solutions, including Snowflake.</li> <li>Everyday use of AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude), and a basic understanding of responsible AI practices - data privacy, bias/fairness and explainability.</li> <li>Must be eligible to work in the UK – we are unable to provide sponsorship at this time</li> <li>This is a Hybrid role, and you will be required in our Dundee office two days per week. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>Understanding of personalisation across domains such as sports betting and gaming, and what best practice looks like there.</li> <li>Full understanding of recommendation algorithms and their applications.</li> <li>Professional experience in personalisation and/or predictive CRM, and micro-segmentation.</li> <li>Experience with CI/CD pipelines and title: Solutions Engineer

product demonstrations, proof of concept support, and customer onboarding.</p> <p>You will need to quickly become fluent in Nscale’s infrastructure, platform capabilities, and software orchestration stack so that you can confidently present our solutions, map customer requirements to technical architectures, and act as a trusted advisor throughout the buying journey.</p> <p>This role is ideal for someone who combines strong technical credibility with commercial instinct, enjoys engaging directly with customers, and can translate complex GPU, AI, and cloud concepts into clear business value.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the commercial team in qualifying customer opportunities and identifying technical requirements early in the sales process</li> with customers to understand workloads, deployment requirements, performance expectations, and scaling plans</li> <li>Build a strong working knowledge of Nscale’s infrastructure stack, GPU cloud platform environments</li> <li>Good understanding of cloud infrastructure, GPU compute, AI/ML workloads, or high-performance infrastructure</li> <li>Familiarity with containers, Kubernetes, Slurm, title: Designer/ Art Director Healthcare (m/w/d)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Ogilvy  </strong></p> <p>Ogilvy has been creating impact for brands through iconic, culture-changing, value-driving ideas since the company was founded by David Ogilvy more than 75 years ago. It builds on that rich legacy through Borderless Creativity—innovating at the intersection of intelligence, imagination and influence, with experts across advertising, sports & entertainment, PR & social, consulting, and health collaborating seamlessly across more than 120 offices spanning 90 countries. Ogilvy was named <a href="https://www.ogilvy.com/ideas/ogilvy-brings-home-network-year-2026-cannes-lions-international-festival-creativity">Network of the Year</a> at the 2026 Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity and<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span><a href="https://www.ogilvy.com/ideas/ogilvy-tops-warc-effective-100-creative-100-4th-straight-year" data-outlook-id="e2c78315-ff05-4544-925f-9288319dea2c">ranks</a><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>as the #1 global agency network for creative excellence and effectiveness by WARC for the fourth consecutive year, signifying its ability to deliver creative solutions that drive unreasonable impact for clients and communities. Ogilvy is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>For more information, visit <a href="http://www.ogilvy.com/" target="_blank" data-outlook-id="39833259-880d-4fd8-930f-0d84b1c14850">Ogilvy.com</a>, and follow us on<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/ogilvy/" data-outlook-id="735e393e-6e8a-4ca8-804a-74f1bd8166b6">LinkedIn</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/ogilvy" data-outlook-id="d10960ce-761b-48c5-81d5-0a7c4cc6013a">X</a>,<a href="https://www.instagram.com/ogilvy/" data-outlook-id="92ffcb70-6ca7-4d9a-88d5-c130e36e6c4f"> Instagram</a>, and<a href="https://www.facebook.com/ogilvy/" data-outlook-id="3bd2010d-00a2-401b-8cfb-7e8c24deac52"> Facebook.</a></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>About WPP</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <u><a href="http://wpp.com/" data-outlook-id="7f087527-f491-4cb6-a79d-3b4a67d1ec89">WPP.com</a></u>.</p> <p> </p></div><p>Ogilvy Health DACH ist eine grenzenlos agierende Kreativagentur, die durch nahtlose Zusammenarbeit über Disziplinen und Märkte hinweg Projekte realisiert – von lokalen Initiativen bis hin zu globalen Kampagnen. Unser Team arbeitet an der Schnittstelle von <strong>Healthcare, Social Media, Strategie, Experience und Influence</strong>.</p> <p>Von Zürich aus betreuen wir das Healthcare-Portfolio von Ogilvy für die DACH-Region sowie ausgewählte internationale Kund:innen aus den Bereichen Pharma, Biotech und Medizintechnik. Unser interdisziplinäres Health-Team vereint Account Management, Medical Writing, PR, Digital, Strategie und Kreation.</p> <p>Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir eine:n<strong> Designer/ Art Director Health (m/w/d) </strong>in Berlin, Hamburg, Frankfurt/ Main, Düsseldorf oder Zürich. </p> <p> Das bieten wir:</p> <ul> <li>Möglichkeit zur Arbeit im Mobile Office (bis zu 100%) </li> <li>Nutzung unseres WPP Weiterbildungsnetzwerkes, inkl. LinkedIn Learning </li> <li>Unterstützung bei der privaten Altersvorsorge und die Gewährung von vermögenswirksamen Leistungen </li> <li>Jubiläumsprämien in Form von zusätzlichen Urlaubstagen </li> <li>Möglichkeit zur Nutzung eines Job Bikes </li> <li>Erweiterte Betriebliche Krankenversicherung mit einem zusätzlichen Budget von bis zu 300€ im Jahr </li> <li>Zugriff auf unser Employee Assistance Programm TELUS Health </li> <li>Kostenlose Nutzung der Headspace-App </li> <li>Subventionierte Gympass-Mitgliedschaft </li> </ul> <p>Deine Aufgaben: </p> <p>Als Art Director Health entwickelst und gestaltest du Kommunikationslösungen für renommierte Kund:innen aus dem Healthcare- und Pharmabereich. Dein Aufgabenspektrum reicht – je nach Projekt – von konkreten Kommunikationsmitteln wie Flyern, Broschüren, Präsentationen und Sales-Materialien bis hin zu visuellen Identitäten, digitalen Inhalten und integrierten Kampagnen.<br>Du entwickelst starke visuelle Konzepte, übersetzt medizinische und wissenschaftliche Inhalte in klare, relevante Kommunikation und begleitest Projekte von der ersten Idee bis zur finalen Umsetzung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Medical Writing, Client Services, Strategie, Creative Direction, Digital, PR, Production und externen Partner:innen zusammen.<br>Die Rolle erfordert kreative Exzellenz und ein gutes Verständnis für die besonderen Anforderungen der Healthcare-Kommunikation – insbesondere für Rx-Produkte, regulatorische Vorgaben und Review-Prozesse.</p> <ul> <li>Konzeption und Gestaltung von Kommunikationsmitteln für Print, Digital, Social Media und Bewegtbild – von Flyern, Broschüren und Präsentationen bis zu digitalen Assets und Kampagnenformaten</li> <li>Entwicklung visueller Identitäten, Corporate Designs, Branding-Lösungen, Kampagnenwelten und visueller Narrative für Pharma-, Biotech- und Medtech-Kund:innen</li> <li>Übersetzung medizinischer und wissenschaftlicher Inhalte in klare, zielgruppengerechte und visuell überzeugende Lösungen, insbesondere für Rx-, Disease-Awareness- und Patient-Engagement-Projekte</li> <li>Präsentation und überzeugende Vermittlung von Ideen gegenüber Kund:innen sowie Begleitung der Umsetzung und Sicherstellung der gestalterischen Qualität über alle Kanäle und Formate hinweg</li> <li>Zusammenarbeit mit internen Fachbereichen und externen Partner:innen wie Fotograf:innen, Filmproduktionen, Freelancer:innen und Partneragenturen sowie Unterstützung bei Pitches, Neugeschäftsprojekten und der Weiterentwicklung bestehender Kund:innenbeziehungen</li> </ul> <p>Was du mitbringst: </p> <ul> <li>Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Grafiker:in EFZ, Studium in Visueller Kommunikation, Grafikdesign oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Art Director in einer Healthcare-, Pharma- oder Kommunikationsagentur</li> <li>Fundierte Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Kund:innen aus Pharma, Biotech und/oder Medtech sowie nachweisbare Erfahrung mit Kommunikationsmassnahmen für Rx-Produkte</li> <li>Gutes Verständnis für medizinische Inhalte, regulatorische Anforderungen und Review-Prozesse in der Healthcare-Kommunikation</li> <li>Ausgeprägte konzeptionelle und gestalterische Fähigkeiten, ein überzeugendes Portfolio sowie sicherer Umgang mit der Adobe Creative Cloud und gängigen Design- und Präsentationstools</li> <li>Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten, ein sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Kund:innen sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift</li> <li>Erfahrung mit Patient Engagement, PR- und Awareness-Kampagnen sowie Kenntnisse in Motion Design und Social/Digital Content Creation sind ein Plus.</li> <li>Du verbindest kreative Exzellenz mit strategischem Denken und kannst komplexe Inhalte schnell erfassen und in relevante visuelle Ideen übersetzen.</li> <li>Du arbeitest proaktiv, selbständig, lösungsorientiert und zuverlässig – sowohl an grösseren Projekten als auch an konkreten Kommunikationsmitteln im Tagesgeschäft.</li> <li>Du kommunizierst klar, präsentierst sicher und kannst Kund:innen für deine Ideen begeistern. Die Zusammenarbeit in interdisziplinären und internationalen Teams macht dir Freude.</li> <li>Du bringst Resilienz und Flexibilität für einen dynamischen und phasenweise intensiven Agenturalltag mit. Nicht alles ist planbar, Prioritäten und Timings können sich kurzfristig ändern.</li> <li>Auch bei hohem Tempo und mehreren parallelen Projekten bewahrst du den Überblick, hast einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch und übernimmst Verantwortung. In intensiven Phasen bist du bereit, gemeinsam mit dem Team die Extrameile zu gehen.</li> </ul> <p>Wir glauben an die Kraft von Diversität und Kollaboration. Den Herausforderungen der heutigen Welt können wir nur gemeinsam begegnen. Wir verpflichten uns daher, für den Job in Frage kommende Bewerber:innen ausschließlich nach ihren Fähigkeiten und grundsätzlich unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, sexueller Orientierung, Behinderung oder Religion zu beurteilen.</p> <p>Das klingt nach einer spannenden Herausforderung? Sehr gut, dein Ansprechpartner Kai Schlüter freut sich über deine Bewerbung!<br>Aus Gründen der Nachhaltigkeit und des Datenschutzes bitten wir darum, Bewerbungsunterlagen ausschließlich über unsere Bewerber:innenplattform Greenhouse an uns zu senden. Wir würden uns freuen, wenn auf das Mitsenden eines Fotos verzichtet würde.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>At Ogilvy, our people are at the heart of what we do: a creative agency that sparks game-changing ideas across culture and business through collaboration, integrity, and a celebration of self-expression. </p> <p>We believe in building powerful teams with purpose - and we relentlessly curate transformative initiatives that make our commitment to fairness, and equity a reality. </p> <p>Our ultimate mission is to leave a positive impact on the world, creating a better future for all, while supporting and uplifting the global communities we serve.  This is central to our mantra of Borderless Creativity.</p> <p><span data-teams="true">Ogilvy is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.</span></p> <p>If you need any assistance seeking a job opportunity, or if you need reasonable accommodation with the application process, please contact us at ----- Please note that this contact is only for candidates who are requesting accommodation. Emails for other purposes, including application status requests, will not receive a response.</p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Brand Manager
description: About Flink Flink Robotics delivers superhuman physical work. We are a Zürich-based deep tech startup developing a physics-based world model that lets machines reason about the physical world and do work robots couldn't do before - starting with logistics. We're a team of engineers and researchers with roots at ETH Zürich, backed by leading European investors. The technology is ambitious; now we want the way we look and show up to match it. The role You make Flink look as cool from the outside as it is on the inside. As our first brand & marketing hire, you own how Flink shows up to the world and help shape how it feels to work here. This is a hands-on role with a lot of ownership from day one. You'll work directly with the CEO and the whole team, and you'll have real freedom to set the tone. We care more about taste, energy and drive than years of experience; junior profiles are very welcome. What you'll do Own our look and feel. Evolve and guard Flink's visual identity. Logo use, colours, typography, photo and video style: and make sure everything we put out is consistent. Run our website. Keep flink.so fresh, fast and on-message: new pages, news, job posts, visuals. Work with freelancers or agencies where needed. Build our social presence. Plan and create content for LinkedIn and other channels. Robot footage, behind-the-scenes, team stories, milestones and grow an audience that gets excited about what we do. Run marketing campaigns. Turn our story into campaigns, from product launches and trade fair pushes to customer and recruiting campaigns. You own the creative and the message, and work closely with the Growth team on goals, audiences and channels. Tell our story visually. Create or coordinate photos, videos, graphics and animations of our robots and technology. Support pitch decks, investor updates and sales materials so they look world-class. Organise events. From trade fairs and demo days to meetups, customer visits and team events. Plan them, run them and make them memorable. Make our space amazing. Shape how our office and workshop look and feel, so every visitor - investor, customer or candidate - gets the Flink vibe. Strengthen our employer brand. Help us attract top engineers: careers page, job ads, recruiting content, how candidates experience Flink. Bring the brand inside. Help build team culture through internal communication, onboarding touches, swag; you name it. What you bring A strong eye for design and visuals: you know what looks great. Creativity and ideas of your own: you don't wait for a brief to start making things Hands-on skills in design tools (e.g. Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Canva) and comfort creating content for social media A portfolio that shows your taste: professional, freelance, student or side projects all count Organisational talent: you can juggle an event, a website update and a video shoot in the same week Excellent written and spoken English Curiosity about technology and robotics: you don't need to be an engineer, but you want to understand what we build First experience in branding, marketing, design or communications (internships count) Nice to have German (spoken or written) Photo or video shooting and editing skills Experience with website design Interior design, set design or event production experience Previous startup or tech-company experience What we offer The chance to build a brand from the ground up at a deep tech startup on the rise Real ownership and direct access to the founders: your work is visible from day one Robots, a workshop and a story worth telling: some of the most exciting content in tech, waiting to be shown to the world A growing, ambitious team in Zürich Competitive salary and employee stock options Budget and freedom to try new ideas Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Chief of Staff
description: Overview Physical AI, a real model of the world, is the next trillion dollar opportunity and a foundational pillar for energy, robotics and superintelligence. At Jua we are building it now. Our models already run on four continents and help power the energy buildout needed to support ever larger intelligence. We are assembling a world-class team of researchers and entrepreneurial minds to turn this model into reality at global scale. If you want the opportunity of your life, come build physical AI with us. The Role You work directly with Jua’s Leadership. You operate as a force multiplier — plugging into whatever's highest-leverage that day, from fundraising and investor work to product calls, deals, and fixing what's broken before it slows us down. What you're pulled into will shift as the business does — some stretches this is heavily fundraising and investor-facing, others it's operational firefighting or unsticking a cross-functional project. The pace is high, the context load is real, and you'll see everything. This is also a launchpad into an executive leadership role. This role is best suited for someone who has been an early-stage operator or ex-founder, and has hands-on experience with start-ups that are still in the build-phase. If that's you, expect a founder's vantage point on how Jua scales — the pace and stakes of building it yourself, without carrying it alone. What You Will Do Problem-solve directly with the leadership team on the highest-leverage issues across the business — from product, marketing and operations to fundraising and partnerships. Sit in high-stakes meetings with customers, investors, and strategic partners, and turn what happens there into clear next steps. Bring clarity to priorities and make sure decisions actually turn into action. Build lightweight dashboards and operating rhythms that help the team learn from data that's still evolving — without pretending it's cleaner than it is. Be the glue across the business: spot where cross-functional work is stuck and personally unblock it — including outside your core areas, whether that's a marketing crunch, a vendor issue, or whatever's fallen through the cracks. Write sharp briefs, investor materials, and internal notes. Handle practical execution when it matters — travel, schedules, logistics, on-site coordination. Who You Are A fast learner who can switch contexts without dropping quality — the mix of what you're doing will genuinely change over time, and you're energised by that rather than needing it to settle. Real depth in one or two areas, not experience scattered thinly across many — we'd rather see two or three things you've actually driven than a long list of things you've touched. Comfortable with data and analytical tools (vibe coding is enough) — precise enough to help the team make calls on metrics that are still taking shape, without waiting for perfect numbers. A clear, concise communicator who compresses complexity. High ownership and bias toward action. Comfortable with ambiguity — figuring things out as you go — and good at building real relationships across the team to get things done through others. Challenges directly — firm, honest input with no ego or personal agenda — then backs the CEO's call fully, including the ones that don't pan out. Spots problems before anyone else does, and gets ahead of them — not just reactive once something's already stuck. A professional background in a leadership position in one of the following domains, along with cross-functional experience in other parts of the business too : Product, Commercial, People and/or Engineering. Hands-on experience at an early-stage startup that is still building, still raising — or founder experience — is a strong plus over scale-up experience. Requirements Zurich-based strongly preferred - either current location or planning to relocate. Frequent short-notice travel to the UK, Nordics, US, and Asia. Comfortable operating at high speed with fast decision cycles. Professional experience, relationships or network relevant to Jua's industry and customer base preferred. At Jua, we foster a performance culture and value people who embody our beliefs of service and adventure. We prioritize agility, operating at the highest clock speed to adapt quickly to change. We innovate on behalf of our users and leverage data supremacy to maintain our competitive edge. Through clear communication and fact-based decision-making, we ensure alignment in our pursuit of excellence. With these principles, we aim to create a customer-focused, value-centric organization that sets new standards in the industry. We value the unique perspectives that each individual brings to the table and believe that embracing diverse backgrounds and experiences enriches our collective journey towards growth and success. title: Account Executive - Enterprise - DACH
description: Account Executive - Enterprise - DACH Munich or Berlin Language requirement: Fluency in both German & English Wordsmith Wordsmith is building the legal operations platform for in-house teams, and we are growing fast. We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents, and disconnected systems. Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgment matters, and every step is captured as work happens. We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend, and become a function the business can run with. More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling, and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe, and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI. The Role We’re hiring an Enterprise Account Executive - DACH to lead complex, high-value deals across large organisations across the DACH region. You’ll be responsible for building and progressing a focused set of strategic opportunities. title: Product Manager – Android Integration & Ecosystem
description: Your mission As our Product Manager – Android Integration & Ecosystem , you will define the product what and why for how ProGlove devices connect, integrate and create value within the enterprise Android ecosystem. ProGlove is evolving from a wearable scanner company into a Worker Companion company, bringing together ergonomic wearable hardware, software, connectivity, workflow guidance, data and intelligence. With the MAI Wearable Companion, we are entering a broader ecosystem of enterprise applications, technologies, standards, partners and customer infrastructure. Your mission will be to make our products easy to adopt, integrate and deploy at scale – without turning every customer opportunity into a bespoke engineering project. You will identify recurring customer needs, translate them into scalable capabilities and propositions, and decide where ProGlove should own, enable or partner. In doing so, you will help turn integration from a technical necessity into a source of differentiation, customer value and commercial opportunity. You will work closely with the Product Manager responsible for the Wearable Companion device. While they own the device proposition, you will own how the device connects to and creates value in the wider ecosystem. Together, you will shape a coherent end-to-end proposition for customers, developers, integrators and partners. Your day-to-day Define and evolve the product strategy and priorities for ProGlove’s enterprise Android integration and ecosystem capabilities, aligned with customer needs and business goals. Work directly with customers, Sales and Solution Architecture to identify recurring problems, distinguish individual requests from broader market needs and turn the right opportunities into scalable solutions. Translate recurring integration needs into repeatable product capabilities such as APIs, SDKs, tools, interfaces, documentation, integration patterns and deployment solutions. Shape the product experience around device setup, provisioning, application distribution, device management and other capabilities required to deploy and operate connected device fleets at scale. Make clear, pragmatic decisions about where ProGlove should own, enable or partner , balancing customer value, strategic control, speed, scalability and technical complexity. Identify the platforms, applications, standards and ecosystem players that matter to our customers, and shape the integrations, certifications and technology partnerships that strengthen our proposition. Explore where integration capabilities, software, services and ecosystem propositions can create differentiated value and support commercial or recurring-revenue opportunities. Partner closely with Engineering and the Product Manager for the Wearable Companion to create alignment on customer problems, priorities, trade-offs and desired outcomes. Enable Sales and other customer-facing teams to clearly explain our Android proposition, supported capabilities, integrations and common deployment patterns. Maintain a forward-looking view of enterprise Android, AOSP, enterprise mobility, AI and adjacent technologies, and translate relevant developments into strategic options and product priorities. Your profile At ProGlove, technical expertise matters, but how you work is just as important. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, stays curious, collaborates openly and turns complexity into clear, pragmatic decisions. You bring strong Product Management experience in B2B or enterprise technology and can define strategy, discover meaningful customer problems, prioritize opportunities and turn them into scalable products or propositions. You are commercially minded and naturally connect product decisions with customer value, differentiation, business impact and opportunities to capture value. You are comfortable working with enterprise software, platforms, connected devices, integrations or technology ecosystems, and understand the realities of complex customer IT environments. You have enough technical depth to understand architecture, interfaces and trade-offs, contribute credibly to platform and integration discussions, and recognize when deeper engineering expertise is needed. You think in systems and patterns: when faced with a customer requirement, you look beyond the immediate request to understand why it exists, how broadly it applies and what a simple, repeatable solution could look like. You take end-to-end ownership, move topics forward without waiting for perfect instructions and remain effective when the product space or path ahead is not yet fully defined. You collaborate generously and build trust across Product, Engineering, Sales, Solution Architecture, customers and external partners. You can create alignment and drive decisions without relying on formal authority. You communicate clearly and transparently, raise risks early and can make complex technical and commercial topics understandable to different audiences. You are curious about customers, the business and emerging technologies, and continuously test assumptions rather than pursuing technology for its own sake. You use pragmatic judgment to balance speed, simplicity, quality and long-term value. You are fluent in English and comfortable working in an international environment. Experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable, but is not required: Enterprise Android, AOSP or adjacent Android ecosystems, including environments operating outside standard Google Mobile Services. Enterprise mobility management, MDM/EMM, device provisioning, application deployment or connected fleet management. Rugged or industrial devices, IoT or edge devices, connected hardware or other B2B technology ecosystems. APIs, SDKs, developer or integrator experiences and enterprise integrations. Platform or ecosystem strategy, technology partnerships, certification programs or developer and partner ecosystems. Enterprise customers deploying technology at scale. Direct Android Product Management experience is an advantage, but not essential if you bring strong Product Management expertise and relevant experience from an adjacent enterprise technology ecosystem. Why us? This is an opportunity to shape an important part of a category that is still being defined.
