title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic AI
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; color: #662d91;">Teamwork makes the stream work.</h2> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Roku is changing how the world watches TV</strong></h3> <p>Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.</p> <p>From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.</p> <p> </p></div><p> </p> <h3><strong>What does the team work on?</strong></h3> <p><br>At Roku, the Device Monetization and Themed Experiences (DMTE) team, a part of the Advertising organization, is where the magic behind the scenes happens. We're the engineers who build the high-performance graphics and UI foundations that power the AD Display — the core technology enabling Roku's smooth, responsive, and visually rich experiences on millions of devices worldwide. Our work lives in the middleware and UI layers, and its impact is felt every time a user navigates a menu, enjoys an animated ad, or is wowed by the bespoke experience built to market the latest TV show or Movies. We thrive on solving the toughest technical challenges — from optimizing UI rendering to fine-tuning memory usage — using BrightScript (a JavaScript-like language) to deliver rock-solid, high-performance solutions. We work in a collaborative, high-trust environment where great ideas can come from anywhere, partnering closely with firmware, UI, and product teams to ensure our platform is lightning fast, reliable, and ready for the next generation of streaming innovation. If you love building the invisible foundations that make great user experiences possible, this is the team for you.</p> <p> </p> <h3><br><strong>What is the role?</strong></h3> <div><br>As a Senior Agentic AI Engineer in the DMTE team, you'll be the driving force behind embedding intelligent, autonomous AI capabilities into Roku's platform — reimagining how our systems create, optimize, and deliver experiences to tens of millions of devices. Rather than building UI features directly, you'll design and deploy agentic AI systems that reason, plan, and act across our development and delivery pipelines — from automating the generation of themed experiences to enabling self-optimizing rendering workflows within the AD Display. You'll leverage your years of experience in software engineering and building world class UI to build AI agents that understand the constraints of embedded, performance-critical systems and operate effectively within them. This is a role for engineers who think in terms of autonomous systems, multi-step reasoning, and tool-use architectures — and who want to fundamentally reshape how a streaming platform is built, maintained, and evolved.</div> <div> <p> </p> <h3><strong>How will I use AI at Roku?</strong></h3> <p>At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. <br>We value your AI skills if have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.</p> <p> </p> </div> <h3><br><strong>What are the responsibilities of the role?</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Apply strong software engineering principles to design, build, and ship reliable, performant systems at scale</li> <li>Bring rigorous software engineering practices — clean architecture, testing, code review - to building systems that are reliable and performant at scale</li> <li>Apply sound software engineering fundamentals (system design, testing, code review) to ship reliable, performant systems at scale</li> <li>We don't train models, we don't 'fine-tune' LLMs; We build automated agentic processes</li> <li>Design, build, and deploy agentic AI systems that autonomously generate, test, and optimize BrightScript/TypeScript code and UI experiences for the FRAME engine</li> <li>Architect multi-agent workflows (planning, tool-use, retrieval, execution, validation) that accelerate development and reduce manual engineering effort across the team</li> <li>Develop AI-powered automation that understands the constraints of embedded C++ environments and produces performance-safe, memory-efficient outputs</li> <li>Build and maintain evaluation frameworks to measure agent reliability, accuracy, and performance in production-critical contexts</li> <li>Collaborate with cross-functional teams (firmware, UI, product) to identify high-impact opportunities for AI-driven automation and intelligent tooling</li> <li>Stay at the forefront of agentic AI research — including LLM orchestration, RAG, function calling, and autonomous code generation — and bring those advances into our platform</li> <li>Mentor engineers across the team on AI-first development practices and help establish best practices for human-agent collaboration</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><strong>What experience would help someone be successful in the role at Roku?</strong> </h3> <ul> <li>Proven experience building agentic AI systems that generate, optimize, and deliver scalable applications in production environments</li> <li>Strong software engineering foundation with a track record of shipping reliable, performant systems at scale</li> <li>Deep familiarity with modern LLM orchestration tools, prompt engineering techniques, and AI/ML frameworks</li> <li>Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), function/tool calling, and evaluation-driven development for AI agents</li> <li>A builder's mentality — you don't just use AI tools, you create autonomous systems that multiply the impact of entire teams</li> <li>Proficiency in TypeScript (or similar languages) and Python for agent development, scripting, and pipeline automation</li> <li>A software engineer's instinct for reliability, testability, and clean architecture — applied to the unique challenges of non-deterministic AI systems</li> <li>Excellent technical communication, root cause analysis abilities, and a proactive mindset with passion for fast iteration</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h6>#LI-NM1</h6> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong><span style="font-family: GothamBold, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;">What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?</span></strong></h3> <p>Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.</p> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What are some of the benefits?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.</p> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Accommodations</strong></h3> <p>Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to <a ---------- <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What should I know about Roku's culture?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. </p> <p>We have a unique culture that we are proud of. title: Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>At Poka, we're changing how the world's industrial teams work — capturing the knowledge of their best people and putting it in every operator's hands.</strong></p> <p><strong>Our connected worker platform is purpose-built for manufacturing and the wider industrial world, with industrial AI inside the shift, not on top of it. The result: frontline performance that becomes compounding knowledge and measurable impact — every shift, every site, every region.</strong></p> <p><strong>We're proud to support global leaders like Nestlé, Bosch, Mars, and Danone across 3,000+ sites in 70+ countries. And as a fast-growing part of the IFS family, you'll join a team whose daily work directly shapes the platform behind how modern manufacturing gets done.</strong></p> <hr> <p> </p></div><div> <p>Most enterprise SaaS gets sold to people in offices. You'll be selling something that lives on the factory floor, across a continent of different markets, languages, and ways of working. You'll need to be as credible with a plant manager in Southampton as with a CIO in Munich.</p> <h3><strong>Role overview</strong></h3> <p>As an Enterprise Account Executive, you'll bring Poka to some of Europe's best-known manufacturers. You'll help them solve real operational problems, move their digital transformation forward, and show measurable impact across their frontline operations.</p> <p>You'll own new business from the first conversation to signature. That means finding the right accounts, running discovery that gets to the heart of how a plant actually works, and building business cases that both operations and finance believe in. It also means closing multi-site, often multi-country deals with many stakeholders. You'll work alongside Sales Development, Solutions Consulting, Customer Success and our IFS partners, and you'll have a real say in how Poka grows its European business.</p> <p>This is a high-impact role for someone who pairs sharp commercial instincts with a real understanding of manufacturing and of how European enterprises buy software.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll be doing</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Find and develop new business across your European territory through market research, outbound prospecting and close work with the Sales Development team</li> <li>Own the full sales cycle: discovery and needs analysis, product demos, proposals, negotiation and close</li> <li>Build tailored business cases that tie Poka's platform to each prospect's operational priorities and show clear value</li> <li>Handle cross-border deals where group-level decisions have to work for local sites, works councils and regional IT</li> <li>Partner closely with Customer Success and other teams so customers move smoothly from signature to long-term value</li> <li>Keep opportunities, forecasts and account activity accurate and up to date in Salesforce</li> <li>Put AI to work in your day-to-day, from research and account planning to conversation intelligence, drafting and CRM copilots, so you sell smarter and spend more time with customers</li> <li>Bring customer insights and market feedback to leadership to help shape go-to-market strategy and product direction</li> <li>Represent Poka at trade shows, industry events and virtual conferences across Europe</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of new business experience, in B2B sales or a similar Account Executive role</li> <li>Proven experience selling SaaS, ideally into manufacturing, industrial technology or digital transformation </li> <li>Confidence leading complex sales conversations with many stakeholders, from the plant floor to the C-suite</li> <li>Experience selling across more than one European market, and an understanding of how buying differs between them</li> <li>Strong negotiation, relationship-building and problem-solving skills</li> <li>A results-driven mindset and a track record of meeting or beating sales targets</li> <li>A hands-on, curious approach to AI and modern sales tools. You already use them to work smarter and want to keep learning</li> <li>Fluent written and spoken English, with strong presentation skills (another language, such as German or French, is an advantage)</li> <li>Based in the UK or Ireland and willing to travel up to 40%</li> </ul> <p>We know great sellers come from varied paths. If you don't tick every box but you've consistently landed complex new business and can quickly earn the trust of operations leaders, we'd love to hear from you.</p> <h3><strong>Why Poka</strong></h3> <p>Manufacturers are under pressure on three fronts:</p> <ul> <li>capturing what a retiring workforce knows</li> <li>getting new people productive faster</li> <li>getting AI onto the floor in a way operators actually use</li> </ul> <p>Poka is one of very few platforms that does all three, and it's already trusted at 3,000+ sites. Many of the world's biggest manufacturers are headquartered in Europe, so you'll be selling close to where the big decisions get made. You'll have the reach of IFS behind you and the pace and ownership of a growth-stage company.</p> </div> <p><span style="font-weight: 400; color: #ffffff;">#LI-TK</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p data-ghq-card-content-type="paragraph"><strong>What we offer:</strong></p> <ul> <li><span data-ghq-card-content-type="paragraph">Generous vacation policy</span>, additional paid days, and charity day.</li> <li>Scale-up energy with huge backing and a global yet close-knit team.</li> <li>A truly flexible schedule and remote-friendly working - including up to 8 weeks a year working from abroad.</li> <li>Wellbeing support from day one, including free 1:1 sessions with certified coaches and therapists.</li> <li>MacBook Pro, plus home-office and monthly allowances to set you up properly.</li> <li>An annual learning and development budget to keep your career moving.</li> <li>Regular team meetups and industry events - remote never means disconnected.</li> <li>A rewarding employee referral program for successful hires.</li> </ul> <p><em>Exact benefits vary by country - we'll walk you through your full local package during the hiring process.</em></p> </div> <p><em>Want to learn more about our culture? Click <a href="https://2394300.fs1.hubspotusercontent-na1.net/hubfs/2394300/HR%20files/CultureBook-En-screen.pdf" target="_blank">HERE</a>.</em></p> <p><strong>Please note: </strong>An understanding of English is essential at Poka, as it is the language used during company-wide meetings and many internal communications, ensuring effective collaboration and decision-making. In addition, as Poka operates in an international environment, English is the primary language for communicating with our clients and partners, enabling us to better serve them and represent Poka in a professional manner.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Sales Development Senior Manager
description: <p><strong>Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.</strong></p> <p><strong>GET TO KNOW US</strong></p> <p>At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. </p> <p><strong>Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!</strong></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>THE OPPORTUNITY</strong></p> <p>We are hiring a <strong>Sales Development Senior Manager</strong><strong> </strong>to join our <strong>Sales </strong>team in <strong>Berlin!</strong> </p> <p>This is a<strong> hybrid</strong> role, requiring a minimum of two days per week in our office.</p> <p><strong>YOUR IMPACT</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the direct leader and mentor for our front-line Business Development Representative (BDR) team, fostering a culture of growth and purpose.</li> <li>Conduct live call-shadowing and deep-dive reviews to sharpen your team's ability to communicate the transformative power of Wellhub.</li> <li>Take full accountability for a team of 5–8 BDRs, guiding their professional journey and ensuring they hit the milestones that drive our mission forward.</li> <li>Lead the interview process for new talent and execute a seamless onboarding program that gets new starters hitting "active" status within 30 days.</li> <li>Excellence in building strong partnerships with marketing and sales.</li> <li>Deeply understand the UK B2B ecosystem to teach your team how to position wellbeing as a "business-critical" priority for CHROs and CFOs.</li> <li>Pivot messaging based on market shifts to ensure Wellhub remains a vital solution for companies navigating industry headwinds.</li> <li>Manage the "speed-to-lead" for inbound inquiries, ensuring high conversion rates through rigorous qualification.</li> <li>Work with the team to build hyper-personalised outbound "clusters." You’ll move beyond generic sequences to high-intent, research-backed prospecting.</li> <li>Ensure the team is getting maximum ROI out of Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and AI-assisted prospecting tools.</li> <li>Develop the best-in-class strategies for managing the rep's book of business and running the outreach-prospecting playbook and turning curiosity into attention with intention.</li> <li>Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHO YOU ARE</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven Track Record: 5+ years in Sales, with at least 1-2 years of experience as a Lead BDR or Front-line Manager.</li> <li>The "Coach" DNA: A passion for seeing others succeed.</li> <li>You can look at a conversion funnel and pinpoint exactly where the "leak" is-whether it’s the initial hook, the discovery call, or the hand-off to the AE.</li> <li>Proven experience managing SDR/BDR teams for a Challenger Brand or a "non-commodity" solution.</li> <li>You must demonstrate the ability to create urgency for a product that is not yet a "household name" or is perceived as discretionary spend.</li> <li>You have moved beyond "feature-selling" and can coach reps to pivot from Product Interest to Business Impact.</li> <li>You should be able to show how you’ve successfully positioned a solution as "mission-critical" during budget-conscious cycles.</li> <li>You are familiar with the HR space and can talk the CHRO language.</li> </ul> <p>We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. </p> <p> </p> <p><strong>WHAT WE OFFER YOU </strong></p> <p>With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:</p> <p><strong>WELLHUB:</strong>  Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you. </p> <p><strong>FLEXIBLE WORK:</strong> As a Flexible First company, we offer options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role is Hybrid,<strong> with a minimum of 2 days per week in-office</strong>.<strong> </strong>We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.</p> <p><strong>FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: </strong> Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.</p> <p><strong>PAID TIME OFF:</strong> We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive a minimum of 25 days paid holiday per year (including an extra holiday on your birthday!).</p> <p><strong>PARENTAL LEAVE:</strong> Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.  </p> <p><strong>CAREER GROWTH:</strong> Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. </p> <p><strong>CULTURE:</strong> You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. <a href="https://wellhub.com/en-us/careers/our-values/">Learn more about our shared culture and values here. </a></p> <p><strong>And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on </strong><a href="https://www.instagram.com/lifeatwellhub/"><strong>Instagram</strong></a><strong> @lifeatwellhub</strong> <strong>and </strong><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/wellhub/"><strong>LinkedIn</strong></a><strong>!</strong></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub</strong></p> <p>We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self.</p> <p>Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.</p> <p>Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/posts/wellhub_fairpay-syndio-activity-7407826561531363328-wbN_?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAAAzHQWABKsRqcpvxy4QpDCJNe_szRdC4hgY">Read more about it here.</a></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><strong> #LI-HYBRID</strong></span></p> <p> </p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Sr.Enterprise Account Executive  - Munich
description: <div class="content-intro"><div><span style="font-size: 18pt;"><strong>About Neo4j:</strong></span></div> <div> <p>Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.</p> <p>Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.</p> </div> <div><span style="font-size: 18pt;"><strong>Our Vision: </strong></span></div> <div> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.  </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.</span></p> </div></div><p><strong><br></strong><strong>About the Role:</strong><strong><br></strong><strong><br></strong><strong> We are seeking a driven, high-energy individual who is passionate about new business acquisition and enterprise sales. As a Senior Enterprise Account Executive, you will be responsible for executing a strategic sales plan in your assigned territory, with a focus on revenue growth and new customer acquisition. This role offers the opportunity to work closely with cross-functional teams, including solution engineering (pre-sales), marketing, and professional services, to ensure customer satisfaction and long-term success.</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and execute a territory plan based on target agencies and applicable use cases, resulting in a pipeline of opportunities in the target market, that will help you achieve quarterly and annual sales metrics.</li> <li>Develop expert knowledge of Neo4j solutions and applicability in the target market.</li> <li>Develop and present to customers a strong understanding of the benefits and advantages of graph technology versus alternative database approaches.</li> <li>Execute sales cycles that employ Strategic Selling strategies and tactics.</li> <li>Build and present proposals for Neo4j solutions that involve Neo4j products and Services.</li> <li>Work with the Solution resources to scope and deliver on well-qualified POC’s</li> <li>“Land & Expand” - Grow the business in accounts that you have landed</li> <li>Provide guidance, direction, and support to your assigned SDR in their efforts to support your pipeline development.</li> <li>Provide guidance and direction to your Field Marketing resources so they can target programs to your target accounts.</li> <li>Provide guidance and direction to the Channel Director so they can target partners and programs for your target accounts.</li> <li>Maintain Neo4j<a href="http://salesforce.com"> Salesforce.com</a> CRM system with accurate information about your pipeline, in accordance with Neo4j forecasting guidelines.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>Ideally, you should have:</p> <ul> <li>Coursework in database, SQL, computer programming, Computer Information Systems, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or similar, is desirable.</li> <li>Experience selling information management tools to customers in the enterprise market.</li> <li> 7-10 years of consistent success meeting or exceeding sales objectives selling technical solutions and software products into the enterprise market.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience executing enterprise complex sales strategies and tactics.</li> <li>Experience with the commercial open-source business model, selling subscriptions for on-premise deployments and/or hybrid on-prem/cloud deployments. <ul> <li>Previous experience and thrive in a smaller, high-growth software company, where you have leveraged dedicated SDR resources, Field Marketing resources, and Pre-Sales Engineering helping build the business.</li> <li>Strong conviction and approach to how and where graph solutions fit into the enterprise marketplace.</li> <li>Be a hard-working, responsible, self-starter, with the ability to work remotely in a home-office environment, as well as travel to client sites to run meetings.</li> <li>Excellent references, ideally from previous Sales managers and/or customers.</li> <li>Demonstrate attention to detail, ensuring accurate entry and management of lead data in our<a href="http://salesforce.com"> SalesForce.com</a> CRM system.</li> <li>Be proficient with standard corporate productivity tools (e.g., Google Docs, MS Office,<a href="http://salesforce.com"> Salesforce.com</a>, web conferencing).</li> <li>Be a team player with the highest level of integrity and humour.</li> </ul> <strong>Languages: Fluency in both German and English is required.</strong> <p> </p> </li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><div><span style="font-size: 18pt;"><strong>Why Join Neo4j?</strong></span></div> <div> <p>Neo4j is, without question, the most popular graph intelligence platform in the world. We have customers in every industry globally, and our products are a proven product/market fit. Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j. </p> <ul> <li>Neo4j is one of the fastest-scaling technology companies in this industry. It <a href="https://neo4j.com/press-releases/neo4j-revenue-milestone-2024/">recently surpassed $200M</a> in annual recurring revenue (ARR), doubling its ARR <a href="https://neo4j.com/press-releases/2021-company-momentum/">over the past three years.</a> </li> <li>Raised the biggest funding round in database history ($325M Series F). Backed by world-class investors like Eurazeo, GV (formerly Google Ventures), and Inovia Capital, Neo4j has raised over $600M in funding and is currently valued at over $2Bn. This puts Neo4j among the most well-funded database companies in history.</li> <li>84% of the Fortune 100 and 58% of the Fortune 500 use Neo4j. Examples include <a href="https://neo4j.com/case-studies/boston-scientific/">Boston Scientific</a>, <a href="https://neo4j.com/case-studies/bt/">BT Group</a>, <a href="https://neo4j.com/case-studies/caterpillar/">Caterpillar</a>, <a href="https://neo4j.com/case-studies/cisco/">Cisco</a>, <a href="https://neo4j.com/case-studies/comcast/">Comcast</a>, <a href="https://neo4j.com/case-studies/department-for-education-uk/">Department for Education UK</a>, <a href="https://neo4j.com/case-studies/ebay/">eBay</a>, <a href="https://neo4j.com/case-studies/nbc-news/">NBC News</a>, <a href="https://neo4j.com/case-studies/novo-nordisk/">Novo Nordisk</a>, <a href="https://neo4j.com/case-studies/worldline/">Worldline</a>, and <a href="https://neo4j.com/case-studies/">others</a>. </li> <li>Co-founder and CEO Emil Eifrem has built an amazing culture that prides itself on relationships, inclusiveness, innovation, and customer success.</li> <li>Countless <a href="https://neo4j.com/awards/">industry awards</a>. Massive enterprises and individual developers/data scientists love Neo4j. A strong sense of community and ecosystem is built around the platform.</li> <li>A recent Forrester Total Economic Impact™ Study cited Neo4j as delivering 417% ROI to customers. </li> </ul> <p><a href="https://www.bizjournals.com/bizwomen/news/profiles-strategies/2022/07/getting-the-job-how-gender-equity.html?page=all">Research</a> shows that members of underrepresented communities are less likely to apply for jobs when they don’t meet all the qualifications. <strong>If this is part of the reason you hesitate to apply, we’d encourage you to reconsider and give us the opportunity to review your application. </strong>At Neo4j, we are committed to building awareness and helping to improve these issues. </p> <p>One of our central objectives is to provide an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace for everyone to develop their potential and have a positive, career-defining experience. initiatives aligned with wider data engineering work</p> </li> </ul> <h2>You'll be great for this role if...</h2> <ul> <li> <p> More than 6 years of experience building production-grade ML Docker, Kubernetes, or Terraform</p> </li> <li> <p>Track record of partnering with stakeholders to turn workflow pain points into reusable, self-service platform capabilities</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Why title: People & Operation Manager
description: ZeitMind, the autonomous data engineer for the European mid-market About Zeit AI In the coming years, companies will replace their internal data teams with AI agents to run more efficiently. We will be the solution they'll use. ZeitMind connects to the systems companies already run (ERP, CRM, spreadsheets, internal databases), cleans messy data, runs analyses on its own and builds data applications. Every employee can then work with data in plain language, with no technical degree and no help from IT. Our customers use it to organise agricultural inventories, to schedule maintenance, crew and flights for jet operators, and to replace controllers' manual Excel reports.. Founded by Marvin and Leopold, both ex-Palantir. YC S24, backed by Oxford Seed Fund and Sequoia Scout. Customers in manufacturing, agriculture and aviation. Zero to €1M ARR in our first twelve months with six people. Small team, one room in Munich, regular team offsites. What This Role Is At our size, every hire shapes the company, and the team we build over the next year will decide how far ZeitMind goes. That's why this role matters so much to us. As our first People hire, you own how people join and grow at Zeit AI, from a candidate's first touchpoint to their first months on the team. You make hiring fast, personal and professional. You keep us compliant across Germany and the UK, and you build the People foundations we'll rely on at 20, 50 and 100 people. You work directly with Marvin and Leopold, shape the function from day one, and help make Zeit AI a place great people want to join and stay. Your Daily Business - no two days are alike Recruiting in Ashby, end to end: job postings, sourcing support, screening, scheduling interviews, collecting feedback and following up with candidates. No candidate waits a week for an answer Comfortable hiring for both technical and non-technical roles. You can run a process for a senior engineer as confidently as for a sales or ops hire, and you know what good looks like in each Offers and contracts: you prepare offer slides that make candidates excited to say yes, and you draft and manage employment contracts through to signature Candidate experience: every applicant, hired or not, leaves with a good impression of Zeit AI. You own interview guides, scorecards and the debrief rhythm with the hiring team Onboarding: contracts, equipment, accounts and a first week that never feels improvised Payroll and benefits: you run payroll with Project B, handle benefits and insurance, and keep finance up to date on headcount and people costs HR systems and data: you own our People tools and keep employee records accurate and secure. You pull the numbers the founders need, such as time-to-hire, pipeline health and headcount plans Compliance: you keep contracts, policies and processes in line with German and UK employment law and know when to bring in external counsel Visa and relocation: you guide international hires through work permits, visas and moving to Munich if needed People processes: you design how we run feedback, performance conversations and the operating rhythm, together with the founders Team and culture: you lead offsites, team events, the office Automation: you find the repetitive work in People Ops and automate it rather than just documenting it Your Skillset - what you bring to the table 2+ years in People Operations, Recruiting, HR Generalist or Talent roles, ideally at a fast-growing startup or scale-up Hands-on recruiting experience with an ATS. Ashby is a plus, but Greenhouse, Lever, Personio or similar count too Solid working knowledge of German and UK employment law, contracts and payroll processes. title: Staff/Senior Software Engineer - Hydris - Golang (d/f/m)
description: New Challenge About Us Project Q GmbH ("Q") is a Germany-based DefenseTech company with offices in Berlin and Munich. We network market-available sensors, effectors, or situational awareness systems into a tactical IoT backbone that reliably provides armed forces and security agencies with cross-domain information superiority — automated, scalable, and cost-efficient. Our solutions integrate seamlessly into existing defense and maritime infrastructures, delivering fast data fusion and AI-enhanced analytics for robust situational awareness in dynamic environments. We build platform-agnostic systems that enable real interoperability across domains. As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll directly impact the technical direction of our orchestration products – Hydris – the coordination engine for sensors and mission systems, and the interoperability API that underpins it. You'll work at the layer where heterogeneous real-world systems like radars, AIS receivers, LoRa mesh radios, satellite feeds, and C2 platforms become a single coherent picture. The problems lie in distributed systems, protocols, and data modeling areas. They play out in environments that are bandwidth-constrained, intermittently connected, and operationally unforgiving. The role is deeply hands-on, but it expects you to shape what we build and how we build it, not just deliver what's specified. What you'll do Core engine development Design and build the systems that power Hydris. Go is your primary language. You should be comfortable reading Rust and TypeScript across the codebase, even if you're not writing in them day-to-day. Own the architecture of a system that must run reliably on edge hardware, in disconnected mesh networks, and at scale — often all of that simultaneously. Protocol and integration architecture Evolve the schema that defines how every sensor, asset, and mission system talks to Hydris. Make API design decisions that hold up across our client libraries without creating a maintenance burden. Continue refining the integration framework that lets Hydris connect to new sensor types, data sources, and command systems. Set the patterns for how built-in integrations (ADS-B, AIS, ASTERIX, Meshtastic, SpaceTrack, TAK, federation) are structured, tested, and maintained. Make it straightforward for external developers and system vendors to build their own plugins/integrations to Hydris. Distributed systems Architect the peer-to-peer mesh and federation layer that keeps Hydris operational in disconnected, denied, intermittent, and limited-bandwidth environments. Solve the hard coordination problems: conflict resolution across federated nodes, eventual consistency of entity state, and track correlation across unreliable links. Ensure the system degrades gracefully rather than failing completely when connectivity is lost or constrained. Technical leadership Set technical standards for the codebase: how we test distributed behavior, how we handle protocol versioning, how we think about backward compatibility in an API-first product. Review code with a focus on long-term maintainability and operational correctness, not just feature completion. Make build-versus-integrate decisions and help the team clearly understand the trade-offs. You should apply if you Have built and shipped distributed systems that run in production, ideally in environments where reliability matters more than convenience. Are comfortable working across the stack, from Protobuf schema design and systems-level Go, to the TypeScript that puts a map in front of a user. Have well-formed views about API design and protocol evolution, informed by experience maintaining APIs that other people depend on. Can operate effectively with a high degree of autonomy but are adept at collaboration with colleagues toward high-quality technical decisions, at scale. Are interested in contributing to European military, maritime, and critical infrastructure defence systems. Write clearly and communicate architectural decisions in a way that survives beyond the conversation where they were made. Working language is English. German is not required. You'd be a great fit with Experience with geospatial systems, sensor fusion, or track management. Familiarity with defense or ISR data standards like CoT/TAK, ASTERIX, SAPIENT, MIL-STD-2525. Background in networking, mesh architectures, or systems designed for contested or degraded communication environments. Experience working on developer-facing open-source infrastructure where adoption depends on the quality of the API and documentation. We Offer Remote work anywhere in Germany, or hybrid/on-site in Berlin or Munich if you're already based there and prefer an office. High degree of autonomy and ownership, a flat structure, and real input into technical direction. Annual €1500 Learning & development budget (available after probation). Bike Leasing and Urban Sports Club membership. 30 days of paid time off. Note: We're unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role – candidates must already be eligible to work in Germany. As Senior Product Manager for Mission Devices, you'll own the hardware that puts Hydris in the field. You'll work end-to-end, from discovery with operators through hardware build cycles to fielded units, and you'll decide what gets built rather than work through someone else's backlog. The bar is concrete: devices that run for months off-grid in contested RF environments. What you'll do Discovery and requirements Spend time with end users in their operating environment to understand their workflows in depth, not just their stated requirements. Validate assumptions about value, usability, feasibility and viability through prototypes, bench tests and field trials before committing to hardware fabrication. Analyze contractual specifications with Program Managers, separating firm constraints from areas where there's room for the best technical solution. Roadmap and delivery Maintain an outcome-focused roadmap aligned to hardware build cycles (EVT/DVT/PVT), firmware releases and OTA update pipelines. Define requirements and field metrics for each device, including detection performance, energy efficiency, mission endurance and SWaP, and make the trade-offs between them. Prioritize investment across the device family, deciding where to extend existing devices and where a new one is needed. Systems and interoperability Make sure devices integrate with Hydris as and interoperate with third-party systems through industry standards and protocols. Design provisioning, commissioning and deployment workflows that are simple and reliable in the field. Investigate issues that span hardware, firmware and communications, and work with engineering to resolve them. Collaboration Act as the main source of product context and the product's champion, making sure the team, leadership and customers understand what we're building and why. Work in a product trio with engineering (hardware and ML) and design. Partner with Program and Capture Managers to keep the product vision aligned with contractual commitments. Write clear PRDs and decision records, and mentor teammates on discovery practice and hardware–software trade-offs. You should apply if you have 5+ years of product management experience with hardware–software products, for example in embedded systems, IoT, robotics, defence systems or edge AI. Experience taking a connected hardware product from EVT/DVT through production into operational use, including in-field updates. Experience running product development end to end, from discovery to engineering-ready work, and the ability to adapt to however a team works. Ability making decisions with incomplete information, and the judgment to know when a decision is risky enough to slow down. Clear communication with hardware engineers, ML researchers and operators alike. Motivation to contribute to European security and sovereignty. Willingness to travel regularly to military exercises, test ranges and customer sites in Germany and NATO partner countries, sometimes in demanding field conditions. Eligibility for German security clearance (SÜ2). Fluency in German and English (C1 or higher). Experience in military, public safety or other mission-critical operational environments. Exposure to sensor fusion, mesh networking or degraded RF environments, including familiarity with interoperability standards such as Cursor on Target, SAPIENT, ONVIF or ASTERIX. Prime Berlin-Mitte location – right between Alexanderplatz and Hackescher Markt. High degree of autonomy and ownership, and flat structure. title: Staff Software Engineer, Vehicle Configuration Platform
description: About Us Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world. The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone. Role Summary A single firmware release must serve every vehicle variant we build across both Rivian and all Volkswagen brands. The vehicle configuration platform that the OTA team supports makes that possible: a schema-driven system that defines every configurable attribute of a vehicle and provisions them onto vehicles in the factory, in service, and over the air customer updates. Getting this wrong can mean anything from the wrong information showing on the driver display to a car that needs to be towed in for service. You will be a technical leader on the team that owns this platform, working as a peer to its lead architect. Where the architect drives the structural evolution of the configuration system itself, you will own the health, reliability, and scalability of everything around it: the compilation and code generation pipelines, the validation and release infrastructure, the provisioning path from schema to vehicle, and the developer experience of every engineer who touches configuration. You will set technical direction for this surface area, drive initiatives that span firmware, build infrastructure, release engineering, OTA, and factory integration across two companies' engineering organizations, and raise the bar for how the team designs, reviews, and ships. This role is based in our Berlin office and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite, with occasional travel to other company and partner sites as needed. Responsibilities Own the technical direction for configuration tooling, validation, and delivery infrastructure, translating platform architecture into a concrete, sequenced roadmap and driving it to completion across teams. Lead initiatives that simplify the platform: consolidating redundant mechanisms, retiring legacy pathways, and reducing the coordination cost of routine changes, while every downstream consumer keeps working. Design the compatibility strategy for data contracts deployed to devices in the field, and build the automated enforcement that makes schema evolution provably safe rather than carefully reviewed. Architect the validation and release pipeline as a product: define what classes of defects must be impossible to merge, and build the layered checks, staged rollouts, and observability that get there. Serve as the senior escalation point for production configuration issues, leading root cause analysis during launches and field events and converting each incident into systemic prevention. Drive alignment across organizational boundaries, negotiating shared contracts, review processes, and release mechanics with firmware, cloud, diagnostics, manufacturing, and partner-brand stakeholders who have differing constraints and conventions. Mentor and multiply the engineers on the team, setting standards through design review, raising the quality of technical writing and decision records, and growing the mid-level engineers toward ownership. Be accountable for the long-term maintenance cost of what the team ships. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications: 8+ years of software engineering experience, including demonstrated ownership of a platform, infrastructure, or developer-facing system used by many teams. A track record of leading cross-team technical initiatives from proposal through delivery, including ones that required deprecating or migrating away from entrenched systems. Deep experience with serialization formats such as Protocol Buffers, including designing schemas with strict backward and forward compatibility guarantees for devices you cannot force-update. Strong Python and working C literacy; real depth in a modern build system such as Bazel, including writing rules and repository-level integration, not just consuming builds. Mature CI/CD and release engineering judgment: you design validation gates and rollout mechanics that encode correctness in automation, and you know which guarantees belong in tooling versus process. Sound judgment under production pressure: you can lead a time-critical fix during a vehicle launch, and you also know when to refuse a shortcut or fence one in and drive its removal afterward. Excellent written and verbal communication with internal and external stakeholders, including the ability to explain tradeoffs to non-software audiences and to write decision documents that hold up over time. The instinct to lead through leverage: you measure your impact by what the team and its users can do without you. Preferred Qualifications Automotive or embedded domain experience: UDS diagnostics, vehicle variant coding, factory provisioning, or OTA update systems. Rust experience. Experience operating in multi-company or partner-engineering environments with separate review and release processes. Experience with code generation toolchains such as protoc plugins or template-based generators. Familiarity with manifest-based multi-repository workflows. title: Move to New Zealand - Technical Strategist (Solution Architect)

The Role: At Propellerhead, the Technical Strategist role focuses on the delivery of resilient software systems that power everything from complex infrastructure to innovative new platforms. This role works alongside our Product Strategists to shape the technical specification and platform direction for a portfolio of client products. We’re looking for someone who combines architectural insight with a strong hands-on engineering background and a genuinely AI-native way of working. You will have spent the formative part of your career as a software developer and still be confident with understanding the structure of software solutions. You'll have knowledge of emerging trends and you are agentic-first where you reach for AI to rapidly prototype new ideas and judge their value in hours, not weeks, and you are at home with directing an AI-assisted delivery pipeline. You’ll be applying and reinforcing Engineering standards for programming, and shape the technical solutions our AI-assisted pipeline builds, in a lean and evolutionary manner. Importantly, you will be responsible for ensuring that client platforms align with our technical strategy. You will work closely with the Chief Technologist and Engineering Principal to apply standards, patterns, and tooling in client contexts, and provide informed input into technical strategy through client platform insights and delivery experience. Propellerhead operates a hybrid working model (work from our office and from your own home). While you must be based in Auckland for this role, we warmly welcome applications from across New Zealand and internationally who are planning to relocate to Auckland. This particular role requires regular in-person office attendance. We offer a culture built on trust, continuous learning, and meaningful impact. You'll join a team that values integrity over ego, and clarity over complexity. If you're looking to contribute your insight and engineering experience to projects that matter - we would like to hear from you. Skills & Experience Required: 8+ years of experience with the development of multi-tier and distributed applications. Agentic-first: very comfortable using AI to rapidly prototype, shape solutions, and direct an AI-assisted delivery pipeline across requirements, testing and code generation. This is central to the role. A confident, credible communicator and presenter in front of senior client stakeholders. Our current technologies include React user interfaces, with services written in C#, so previous experience with both is essential. However we also have Typescript, Java, Go and Rust services, so you will need to show confidence in working with a variety of programming languages. Strong communication skills must be demonstrable, with tangible examples of your skills to bridge technical solutions with business needs and present these concepts to a variety of internal and customer stakeholders. Hands-on experience with designing solutions on Azure is essential, including active participation in building CI/CD pipelines and instrumenting for operations, is required. Experience with streaming and messaging platforms, such as Kafka or NATS, is highly desirable. Proven experience in leading the design of complex software applications, preferably for corporate enterprise, where solutions comprise existing services alongside custom development. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. You will represent Propellerhead in front of stakeholders, so a professional, confident presence and the ability to communicate and influence with clarity are essential. We are particularly looking for technical leaders with experience or demonstrable interest in any of the following: digital identity, verifiable credentials, open banking, AI agent authorization, edge or device-based software deployment. Responsibilities: Authoring, reviewing and communicating solution architecture and specifications in collaboration with the Development teams and our core Engineering team. Championing the technical strategy of Propellerhead as our key business differentiator, and aligning design and implementation of the solutions in your portfolio in line with that technical vision. Building trusted relationships with key client decision-makers. You will be responsible for ensuring our teams understand technical requirements and for clearly explaining our solution design to client technologists. You will be the go-to technical person for our client’s solutions, including facilitating any technical pre-requisites for delivery or addressing improvements from operational feedback. Developing strategies to ensure quality measures such as speed-to-value, security, reliability, maintainability, performance and functional fit for purpose. Specifically, you will be facilitating the evolution of our code base from C# to Rust and the ecosystem of tools, practices and services that implies, with AI central to how we handle requirements, testing and code generation. About Propellerhead: Propellerhead is a leading software services company that designs, delivers, and maintains large-scale, custom-built digital platforms across a range of technologies. We place emphasis on producing technology which is meaningful, has value, and can make a difference in the world. We foster long lasting and trusting relationships with all our clients. Over our 20+ years in the market we have worked with a diverse range of commercial, non-profit, and government organisations. How We Build Software: We build software by structuring solutions in a product-centric manner and focusing on continuously delivering measurable outcomes into production. Our work starts from real stakeholder needs and the value they unlock, with an AI-assisted pipeline now generating much of the code.As a result, our digital platforms are a mixture of custom components and external services which produce a powerful and engaging experience when combined. Benefits: Be part of an innovative team, with a culture of learning and collaboration. Contribute to interesting, diverse, and commercially minded work for well-respected clients. Opportunity for professional growth and development. Fortnightly knowledge sharing sessions, with lunch. Competitive salary. Employee Share Purchase Scheme offering. This role is Auckland based, regular in-office attendance is required. Work within our beautifully designed office and from home (hybrid working model). Propellerhead is an equal opportunity workplace which is free from discrimination. Cover Letter: *Please note - only applications with a cover letter will be reviewed. It's very important to us that you include a cover letter with your application - it's your chance to tell us more about who you are and what you value. At Propellerhead, we use AI thoughtfully as part of our delivery practices - considered integration helps us stay at the forefront of technology and create innovative, valuable solutions for our clients. In recruitment, however, AI isn’t used to assess skills, experience or suitability for a role. Every application is reviewed by a real person to ensure a fair, engaged and thoughtfully human process. Therefore we kindly ask that you refrain from using it in your application. We're excited to learn about your unique experiences and ideas, so please apply as your authentic self! You won't just be querying pre-cleaned data—you possess the technical skills to build the pipelines that feed your insights. You will leverage Cloudflare's Developer Platform (Workers, R2, D1, Workers AI) alongside standard data warehousing tools to extract raw CRM and CPQ data, integrate it into AI workflows, and deliver actionable insights that directly impact margin preservation and our global growth.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build Advanced Dashboards & Analytics: Design and maintain executive dashboards and self-serve reporting systems that provide real-time visibility into deal terms, discount thresholds, win/loss rates, and margin performance across all regions.</li> Finance, Infrastructure and Deal Desk leadership to dive deep into historic and active pricing data, uncovering insights that ensure our quoting strategies consistently align with margin preservation goals.</li> <li>Develop Data Pipelines: Apply your data engineering skills to build and maintain the ELT/ETL pipelines that extract messy data from Salesforce, CPQ, and billing systems, transforming it into clean, usable semantic models.</li> <li>Power AI Workflows: Assist in integrating structured deal data into Deal Desk tools to help automate routine approvals and surface real-time pricing optimizations to deal managers.</li> <li>Data Storytelling & Enablement: Translate complex datasets into clear, actionable narratives for non-technical stakeholders, empowering the Deal Desk team to use your data products for faster, data-driven negotiations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Skills & Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>3-5+ years of professional experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a technical RevOps role, with a strong emphasis on full-stack data problem solving.</li> <li>Experience incorporating data into AI workflows, utilizing LLM orchestration frameworks, or building predictive models.</li> <li>Expert-level SQL and deep proficiency in modern data visualization and BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Sigma, PowerBI) to build intuitive executive reporting.</li> <li>Strong programming skills in Python (or TypeScript) with hands-on experience building ELT/ETL pipelines, interacting with APIs, and cleaning raw data.</li> <li>Experience designing analytical data models specifically tailored for financial and SaaS business analysis (e.g., margins, discount rates, ARR, NRR).</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud data platforms and an interest in edge computing/serverless architectures (Cloudflare Workers, R2, D1).</li> <li>Domain expertise in CRM data structures (especially Salesforce custom objects), CPQ complexities, and the quote-to-cash lifecycle.</li> <li>Exceptional communication skills with the ability to bridge the gap between technical data systems and strategic Finance operations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></p> <h4><em>Background working closely with Deal Desk, Finance, or Sales Strategy teams at a high-growth SaaS or technology company.</em></h4> <ul> <li>Familiarity with data transformation frameworks and orchestration tools (like Airflow).</li> <li>Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform or other analytics databases</li> </ul> <p>If you're excited by fast-paced innovation, dedicated to driving global growth, and want to help build a better internet, we'd love to hear from you.</p> <p><strong> </strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. The operational burden of this work is substantial and largely manual: user lists are pulled by hand, access control lists are reconciled by eye, evidence packages are assembled ticket by ticket, and attestation cycles consume weeks of coordinator time every quarter.</p> <p>This role exists to change that. The DCSC Automation -Specialist will design, build, and operate AI-assisted and automated workflows that eliminate the most time-consuming manual work in the DCSC operating model, freeing compliance coordinators to focus on exception handling, stakeholder relationships, and regulatory judgment rather than data gathering and reconciliation.</p> <p>This is a builder role. covering 338+ sites.</li> <li>Resilience & Coverage: Build fallback handling for portals that block or rate-limit automated access; document exceptions and maintain a coverage registry tracking automation status per portal.</li> <li>Scheduled Execution: Operationalize extraction jobs on a recurring cadence aligned to QAR and MAR cycles, with alerting for failures and drift.</li> </ul> <ol> pipelines that compile audit-ready evidence packages for SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, ISMAP, and IRAP control cycles, pulling attestation logs, portal extraction results, diff reports, and Services packaging and commercialization: </strong>Partner with Professional Services, Finance, Product, Sales Strategy, and GTM leaders on pricing, packaging, business cases, rollout plans, and title: Director, Global Design & Construction
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. This role demands a unique combination of high-level strategic vision, a passion for experimentation, creativity, and a relentless commitment to world-class physical execution.</p> <p>First and foremost, you are a builder of impactful, high-performance spaces. You will be responsible for leading the end-to-end design and construction of workspaces that serve as the tangible, physical manifestation of the local Cloudflare culture.</p> <p>At the same time, you are stepping into uncharted territory. To keep Cloudflare at the absolute forefront of our industry, we are up-leveling how we deliver projects by integrating an AI-first, data-driven approach. We are looking for a visionary leader who can think outside the box to identify and implement how AI can automate workflows, optimize budgets, and improve data-driven design decisions.</p> <p>While automation and AI are the engines of efficiency in this role, the <strong>human element</strong> is its heart. Lead formal change management efforts to iterate on our physical footprints and champion a generative design-supported “kit of parts” for global serviced offices, ensuring they fluidly adapt as work styles and distributed team needs change.</li> <li><strong>Predictive Capital & Site Strategy:</strong> Collaborate with Real Estate and FP&A teams to direct predictive modeling concepts for site selection, due diligence, project cash flows, long-term financial reporting, and financial risk mitigation, steering the department toward highly optimized capital allocation.</li> <li><strong>CapEx Budget Ownership & Financial Governance:</strong> Own and manage the global capital expenditure (CapEx) budget, delivering accurate multi-year financial forecasting, cost-variance reporting, and executive-level capital reporting.</li> <li><strong>Executive Cross-Functional Leadership:</strong> Serve as the strategic bridge and primary liaison between internal executive business customers and external delivery partners (including architects, GCs, and furniture dealers). Ensure all construction activities and global workflows are in strict compliance with local laws while maintaining a focus on sustainable, high-performance building standards.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Proven Seniority:</strong> 10-12+ years of experience leading interior design and complex construction project management, specifically within high-growth technology companies or global enterprises.</li> <li><strong>Scale Mastery:</strong> A proven track record of successfully directing a global corporate office portfolio in excess of 250,000+ total square feet.</li> <li><strong>Curiosity & Growth Mindset:</strong> A profound curiosity for how technology can optimize human interaction. You must be comfortable with ambiguity and excited by the challenge of building unprecedented internal tools from scratch rather than managing legacy workflows.</li> <li><strong>Technical Integration:</strong> Knowledge of technical infrastructure (MEP systems, architectural principles, AV/IT) and a clear vision of how they connect with automated building systems.</li> <li><strong>Sophisticated Communication:</strong> Outstanding leadership and collaboration skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional executives and external partners across multiple time zones.</li> <li><strong>Education:</strong> Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a related field such as Architecture, Project Management, Interior Design, or Engineering.</li> <li><strong>Global Mobility & Presence:</strong> Willingness to work in-office ~3 days a week to lead by example within our local workplace laboratory, with the flexibility to travel globally to oversee high-stakes project transformations.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Certifications:</strong> LEED, WELL, or PMP Certifications.</li> <li><strong>Advanced Technical Skills:</strong> Experience with AI-enhanced workflows, generative design platforms, or transitioning legacy portfolios into AI-assisted operational models.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $223,000 - Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: New York, NY, San Francisco, CA</strong></p> <h4><strong>About the team </strong></h4> <p>The Finance team is a critical pillar of Cloudflare’s success, translating strategy into financial outcomes, and serving as a trusted voice to the public markets, the Board, and our shareholders. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Come join us!</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Cloudflare is looking for a Director of Strategic Finance & Investor Relations to serve as a key leader on our Investor Relations team and a trusted partner to the CFO, CEO, and senior leadership. This role reports to the VP of Strategic Finance, Treasury, Deal Desk, & Investor Relations and is the engine room of how Cloudflare tells its financial story to the public markets — translating one of the most differentiated technology platforms in the world into a clear, credible, and compelling investment narrative.</p> <p>You will own the end-to-end quarterly earnings cycle, drive our long-term financial model and consensus discipline, partner directly with the CFO and senior leadership on guidance, and lead the analytical and communications work behind every major investor and analyst touchpoint — quarterly calls, conferences, our annual Investor Day, and ad-hoc executive projects. You will be the connective tissue between Finance, Accounting, Legal, Communications, Product, Sales, and the executive team, and the person who makes sure every number, every claim, and every word we put in front of Wall Street is accurate.</p> <p>This is a high-visibility, high-ownership role on a very lean IR team. build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with our covering analysts and shareholders.</li> <li>Articulate the Cloudflare investment narrative — our connectivity cloud strategy, the Workers and Developer Platform story, and our long-term financial model — in a way that is both compelling and credible.</li> <li>Plan and execute the calendar of investor events: sell-side conferences, one-on-ones, on-site investor visits, and our annual Investor Day.</li> <li>Prepare the CEO, CFO, and other senior executives for every investor interaction with tailored briefing materials, talking points, and Q&A prep.</li> <li>Develop and maintain core IR collateral: investor presentation, fact sheets, IR website content, and board-of-directors investor update materials.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Investor Day and special projects</strong></p> <ul> <li>Co-lead the planning and execution of our annual Investor Day — invite tracker and registration management, co-author all presentation content and prepared remarks across all presenters, own the supporting documentation, validation, day-of logistics, and post-event follow-through.</li> <li>Lead select strategic finance projects: peer benchmarking analyses, long-range financial modeling, competitive analyses, and ad-hoc executive-level financial analyses.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-functional partnership and analytics</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be a trusted partner to Finance, Accounting, Legal, Communications, FP&A, and the executive team — the person who knows where every number comes from and what it means.</li> <li>Monitor and synthesize analyst coverage, peer performance, investor sentiment, market dynamics, and industry trends; provide actionable insights to the CFO, CEO, and Board of Directors.</li> <li>Build and maintain the internal analytical infrastructure that powers the function — the models, dashboards, trackers, and validation systems that let a small team operate at scale.</li> <li>Drive the IR function's use of AI-native tooling and automation, treating modern tools as a force multiplier on insight, productivity, accuracy, and stakeholder communications.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></h4> <p>To succeed in this role, you should be a strategic thinker with deep financial acumen, exceptional written and verbal communication skills, an ownership mindset, and a genuine intellectual curiosity about both the business and the public markets. Comfort debating modeling assumptions and valuation mechanics.</li> <li><strong>Exceptional written and verbal communication skills</strong> — including the ability to draft in the voice of senior executives, translate complex technical or financial concepts into clear narratives for non-technical audiences, and operate confidently in high-stakes external communications.</li> <li><strong>Advanced financial modeling skills </strong>— fluency in building, maintaining, and stress-testing operating models, share-count and dilution forecasts, guidance sensitivity analyses, and consensus benchmarks.</li> <li><strong>An ownership mindset</strong> — comfort owning a process end-to-end, driving operational structure in a fast-paced environment, and operating with the integrity and accuracy demanded by external disclosure.</li> <li><strong>High-trust collaboration</strong> — the ability to build credibility quickly with senior internal stakeholders (CFO, CEO, Board, Legal, Accounting, FP&A) and external stakeholders (sell-side analysts, institutional investors).</li> <li><strong>AI-native curiosity and skill </strong>— fluency with modern AI tooling and a track record of using it to amplify your impact. Cloudflare is uniquely positioned to help website owners make their content discoverable and to help agents find relevant, trustworthy information across our network. Building these capabilities requires solving problems across distributed systems, crawling, content ingestion, indexing, retrieval quality, developer experience, and reliable product delivery.</p> <p>Cloudflare also has a unique perspective on how the Internet is changing. Our global network observes signals that can help us understand trends, identify when content changes, and measure the pulse of the Internet.
