Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p class="p1"><strong>Please note: This role will require you to be based in Bengaluru</strong></p> <p class="p1"><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p class="p1">Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.</p> <div>The Account Director, IT/ITeS will be responsible for driving strategic growth across a portfolio of India's leading IT services, SaaS, engineering services, BPO, and Global Capability Center (GCC) customers. The role will develop executive relationships, identify new business opportunities, and lead account strategies that accelerate the adoption of cloud and cybersecurity solutions.<br><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong><br> <ul> <li>Own and grow a portfolio of strategic IT/ITeS accounts.</li> <li>Develop executive relationships with CXOs and key business and technology stakeholders.</li> <li>Identify, qualify, and close new cloud and cybersecurity opportunities.</li> <li>Build and execute account plans aligned to customer business priorities.</li> <li>Collaborate with partners and internal cross-functional teams to drive pipeline and revenue growth.</li> <li>Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales engagements and negotiations.</li> <li>Maintain accurate forecasting and deliver against revenue targets.</li> <li>Provide market intelligence and competitive insights to influence go-to-market strategy.</li> </ul> <strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong><br> <ul> <li>10+ years of enterprise technology sales experience, with a strong track record in the IT/ITeS sector.</li> <li>Experience managing large strategic accounts and complex enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Strong understanding of cloud, cybersecurity, AI, and digital transformation.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to engage C-level executives and build long-term strategic relationships.</li> <li>Excellent commercial, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.</li> </ul> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

This position will manage a focused set of ~20-30 accounts with $1B -$25B in annual revenues. The Enterprise Account team will shape and lead Cloudflare’s Go To Market.</li> <li>We will leverage the strength of all Cloudflare functions to become a strategic partner to our customers and their digital transformation efforts. Our product and services and our methods of engagement will differentiate and delight our customers.</li> <li>The AE will interact with both C-level clients and senior technical decision makers, utilizing Cloudflare solutions and resources to drive a business partnership focused on joint success with our customers.  Success requires consultative, solutions-oriented sales, and customer service skills in addition to intense personal energy and focused activity. The role involves handling multiple accounts and will require high degrees of attention to detail and coordination with customers, partners, and internal resources. Lastly, the AE should thrive in an entrepreneurial environment where initiative is celebrated and enthusiasm for the possible is expected.</li> </ul> <h3>Enterprise Account Team Core Values:</h3> <ul> <li>Be Successful – Success comes from hitting your goals on a consistent basis. Be in a position and ready to demonstrate your plan for success.</li> <li>Provide Customers with a Premium Business Experience - Solutions, Empathy, Proactiveness, Anticipation of needs, Company Support, Creativity, and Urgency to Deliver Value are core principles of a Cloudflare Strategic Account Experience. These decisions should be made by the AE who is closest to the issue and most affected by it. Top down management of accounts is outdated because of the speed of today’s business. Be the person who actively seeks to assist the team, shares knowledge, and extends your personal network. We are successful when we are all overachieving as a group.</li> <li>Proactively manage and grow a portfolio of assigned Enterprise level clients.</li> <li>Close new and expansion business monthly, quarterly, and annual basis, meeting or exceeding assigned quota.</li> <li>Manage customer relationships and assume ownership of deadlines and deliverables to ensure Cloudflare is correctly positioned to win business.</li> <li>Develop C level and Decision Maker relationships within accounts for the purpose of establishing strategic alignment to customer’s transformative objectives.</li> <li>Develop pipeline by maintaining a high level of activity/outreach directly and indirectly, deeply understanding the customers goals and objectives, and analyzing where Cloudflare can add value.</li> <li>Maintain accurate forecasts and report to the sales leader on the status of New and Expansion opportunities for weekly sales meetings. Leverage MEDDPIC framework in SFDC document weekly progress.</li> <li>Accountable to reverse closure steps and establish jointly owned timelines with Customers. Understand the purchasing process fully and be able to document progress against required steps to closure.</li> <li>Organize and deliver executive level presentations, proposals, commercial terms with Customers.</li> <li>Leverage the Executive Briefing Center and process to establish key sponsorships and support of accounts with Cloudflare Executives.</li> <li>Build and maintain relationships with channel partners to establish joint value propositions and Customer value.</li> <li>Participate in team meetings and deliver GTM guidance on how to better partner with accounts.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li><strong>This is a remote role but the location requirement is that you reside in the Boston, MA region</strong></li> <li>6+ years of experience coupled with proficiency in Cloud Networking and Security Technology with industry awareness.</li> <li>Demonstrated track record of meeting and exceeding quota.</li> <li>Expert Sales Acumen (Discovery, Position, Compete, Negotiate, Close, Expand).</li> <li>Ability to lead a multidisciplinary team over a long term account horizon.</li> <li>Able to identify key players in organizations and possess the ability to convert business issues into solutions.</li> <li>Comfortable selling to obtain new business or expand existing business. Strong closing skills are essential.</li> <li>Ability to build meaningful relationships quickly.</li> <li>Someone who acts with integrity and honesty in all situations.</li> <li>Be able to demonstrate a positive attitude internally and externally.</li> <li>Expert at building rapport and owning the room.</li> <li>Aggressiveness in execution and planning.</li> <li>Ability to take successes and challenges in stride.</li> <li>Discipline to work w/o instant gratification.</li> <li>Someone who is bold in their actions and never satisfied with complacency.</li> <li>A strong will and fortitude to work a plan in the face of challenge.</li> <li>A business professional who loves the sales profession.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For New York City, Washington, Washington D.C. and California (excluding Bay Area) based hires: Estimated annual OTE of $269,000- $370,000.</li> </ul> <p>This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Miami FL, Atlanta GA, Charlotte NC, Raleigh NC (Southeast Territory)</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Overview</strong></p> <p>The <strong>Partner Engineer (PE)</strong> is a high-impact, strategic technical sales leader  responsible for end-to-end technical lifecycle and enablement of the assigned partners, managing both pre-sales and post-sales engineering activities. Pre-Sales Engineering & Champion Building</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Technical Alignment, Discovery & Enablement: </strong>Own the technical relationship with Partners to align on building joint Go-To-Market (GTM) strategies. Develop, manage, and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure and improve the effectiveness of these partner service deliveries</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Technical Account Management & Architectural Health:</strong> Act as the escalated technical point of contact to ensure long-term architectural health, utilizing telemetry and proactive design to move the partner relationship from reactive to strategics for Cloudflare.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>3. Automation AI Agents & Continuous Innovation</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Leverage Autonomous AI Tools:</strong> Champion the use of Cloudflare OS and AI tools (Agent PAT and Agent Echo) to automate standard, repeatable technical tasks, optimizing operational efficiency and freeing up bandwidth for high-touch, strategic partner engagements.</li> <li><strong>AI & CF1 Product Enhancement Feedback Loop:</strong> Engage partner champions in the Partner Technical Advisory Council (PTAC) to give them early access to beta software, capture raw product feedback, and drive joint co-innovation on CF1 features and emerging AI products.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Enablement:</strong> Participate in continuous cross-training programs to maintain peak proficiency in both pre-sales scoping and post-sales service deployment across the entire Cloudflare One and AI ecosystem.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Qualifications & Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>8+ years of technical, partner-facing experience (e.g., Systems Engineer, Solutions Architect, or Technical Account Manager) in cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, or networking.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong technical depth in Cloudflare One (CF1) or equivalent SASE/SSE architectures, Zero Trust, DNS, and application security, alongside hands-on familiarity with AI deployment, AI Gateway, LLM orchestration frameworks, or vector databases.</p> </li> <li> <p>Proven track record of developing technical talent or building "champion" programs within partner organizations, specifically driving adoption of complex cloud networks and AI technologies.</p> </li> <li> <p>Enterprise Architecture & Project Management: Deep understanding of enterprise IT, multi-cloud, and hybrid cloud environment while managing complex service delivery.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong communication skills with a track record of presenting complex CF1 architectures and AI-driven use cases to partner leadership and technical teams alike.</p> Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin, TX | London, UK | Lisbon, Portugal</p> <h4><strong>About the Department</strong></h4> <p>The Product Management team at Cloudflare steers the strategy, roadmap, and execution that powers a faster, more secure internet. As part of the Zero Trust Security organization, our Email Security team is redefining how the enterprise's most trusted — and most targeted — communication channel gets protected, evolving a platform already trusted by Fortune 500 and Global 2000 organizations into a fast, secure pillar natively integrated with Cloudflare's Zero Trust stack.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Email remains the most trusted, yet most targeted, communication channel in the enterprise. At Cloudflare, we have a proven email security solution which is trusted by Fortune 500 and Global 2000 organizations. We’re looking for an experienced, technical product manager to continue to differentiate our solution in the market, make difficult investment decisions, and own delivering an enterprise-grade email security platform that is fast, secure, and natively integrated with Cloudflare's Zero Trust stack.</p> <p>We are seeking an autonomous, determined, and pragmatic individual who possesses strong conviction, humility, and a decisive bias toward action.</p> <h4>What you'll do</h4> <p>In this role, you’ll be responsible for defining how some of the world's most sophisticated organizations protect their communication, leading the industry's shift away from legacy "boxes" toward an AI-first, cloud-native, and identity-aware security posture. </p> <p>Key responsibilities involve continuously investing in threat intelligence, sustaining current security detection capabilities, rapidly developing features, and expanding into new markets.</p> <h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Own Email Security.</strong> Architect and own the strategic roadmap for our Email Security solution, ensuring Cloudflare remains the definitive answer to evolving threats like Business Email Compromise (BEC) and advanced phishing.</li> <li><strong>Shape Intelligence and Detections.</strong> Work alongside our Threat Intelligence and Detections teams to improve how customers consume, enforce, and understand Cloudflare One. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. 1.5;">Responsibilities </h3> <ul> <li style="line-height: 2;">Lead cross-functional teams of technical professionals, consultants, FDE’s, partners, vendors, and customer stakeholders to deliver style="line-height: 2;">Ensure Professional Services engagements are delivered on time and within budget by actively managing project financials, resource forecasts, scope performance, timeline performance, change requests, and executive reporting.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Develop, implement, and refine scalable methodologies, playbooks, templates, and best practices that improve the global efficiency and effectiveness of Professional Services delivery.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Ensure a seamless and consultative sales-to-delivery transition by validating scope, assumptions, risks, dependencies, and customer success criteria before project kickoff.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Proactively identify project risks, including zero- or low-downtime migrations, multi-vendor dependencies, resource constraints, scope changes, and customer operational impact, and implement mitigation strategies to protect customer outcomes.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Transform raw project data into clear, data-driven insights and regular status narratives for internal and external leadership regarding project health, risks, decisions, financials, and resource utilization.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Proactively leverage AI tools to optimize project workflows and technical delivery, serving as a force multiplier for project teams by streamlining administrative work, improving visibility, and increasing overall project productivity.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Collaborate across Account Teams, Customer Engineers, Support, Product, Engineering, Professional Services leadership, and other internal stakeholders to resolve blockers, advocate for customer requirements, and maintain a unified one-team approach to delivery.</li> </ul> Management</strong>: Experience in organizational change management, including guiding enterprise customers through the cultural and operational shifts required by digital transformation and technology migration programs.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;"><strong>Conflict Resolution</strong>: Advanced skills in managing friction within project teams, across internal stakeholders, or with customers to reach mutually beneficial outcomes.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;"><strong>Collaborative Leadership</strong>: Proven ability to navigate and influence a complex matrix of internal stakeholders, including Account Teams, Customer Success Managers, Support, Product, Engineering, and Professional Services leadership, to resolve blockers, advocate for customer requirements, and management skills and the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, dependencies, and executive stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Demonstrated track record of leading high-profile, high-impact projects involving third-party partners, consultants, technical delivery teams, and complex multi-vendor ecosystems.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Experience managing strategic customer programs from kickoff through closeout, including project charters, governance cadences, risk management, change control, executive reporting, and lessons learned.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Sound business judgment, an ownership mindset, strong analytical capability, and a proven ability to influence results across global stakeholders.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Expert proficiency with Jira, Salesforce, Professional Services Automation (PSA), or equivalent project / portfolio management tools.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or related advanced project / program management certification is highly preferred.</li> </ul> <h3 style="line-height: 1.5;"><strong>Compensation</strong> </h3> <p style="line-height: 1.5;">Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. <span data-sheets-root="1">This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.</span></p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $155,000 - $213,000.</span></li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For NY and Washington DC based hires: Estimated annual salary of $149,000 - $205,000.</span></li> </ul> <h3 style="line-height: 1.5;"><strong>Equity</strong></h3> <p style="line-height: 1.5;">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3 style="line-height: 1.5;"><strong>Benefits</strong></h3> <p style="line-height: 1.5;">Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3 style="line-height: 1.5;"><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></h3> <u

If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: Austin, TX </strong></h3> <div class="flex-1 overflow-y-auto"> <div class="mx-auto max-w-3xl px-4 py-4"> <div> <div data-index="3"> <div class="pb-5"> <div class="flex justify-start"> <div class="max-w-[85%] min-w-0 space-y-1.5"> <div class="prose-chat text-sm text-foreground"> <div class="doc-section"> <h3>About the role</h3> <p class="doc-paragraph">Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a massively successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</p> <p class="doc-paragraph">The <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/queues/"><strong>Cloudflare Queues</strong></a> team builds a managed, global message queuing service for developers. Queues allows customers to send, buffer, and reliably deliver messages between Workers with at-least-once delivery, batching, and configurable delivery guarantees, without managing infrastructure or paying bandwidth egress fees. Deeply integrated with Cloudflare Workers, Queues supports event-driven and asynchronous applications across the Developer Platform. Generally available since September 2024, Queues runs at global scale on Cloudflare’s edge network and is a foundational building block for event-driven and asynchronous applications.</p> <p class="doc-paragraph">In this role, you will help design and build <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/queues/"><strong>Cloudflare Queues</strong></a>, improving reliability, performance, and delivery guarantees while shipping new features at global scale. the software development lifecycle.</li> <li>Strong judgment for when to rely on AI tools and when to validate independently.</li> <li>Strong ownership of correctness, security, and quality.</li> understanding of TypeScript/JavaScript.</li> <li>Strong systems-level programming skills.</li> <li>Understanding of security issues and responsibilities.</li> <li>Experience monitoring, alerting, and platform sunset/replacement).</li> </ul> <h4><strong data-path-to-node="3" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h4> <p data-path-to-node="4">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s vectors and turn them into engineering requirements.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>Five or more years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience building and operating distributed systems or backend services in production.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience designing and building data or event pipelines (e.g., Kafka, Pub/Sub, or similar).</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, service security, and API standards such as OpenAPI, OAuth, or JWT.</p> </li> <li> <p>Working knowledge of SQL, data modeling, and relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.</p> </li> <li> <p>Comfort owning ambiguous, 0-to-1 problems with limited existing infrastructure or precedent.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong troubleshooting, cross-functional communication, and project ownership skills.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Bonus Points</strong></h3> billing, subscriptions, or other financial/transactional systems.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience building internal tools or dashboards for non-engineering stakeholders (analysts, support, finance).</p> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <h4>Compensation</h4> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <p> </p> <h4>Equity</h4> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity title: Senior Software Engineer, PKI & Cryptographic Systems
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations: Austin, London, or Lisbon (Hybrid)</h3> <h3 id="JD—SeniorSoftwareEngineer,PKI&CryptographicSystems(MergedDraft)-Abouttherole">About the role</h3> <p>TLS is the connective tissue of the Internet, and Cloudflare terminates a large fraction of it. Every day our network handles tens of millions of certificate operations across products like Universal SSL, SSL for SaaS, Origin CA, Cloudflare Access, and Cloudflare Tunnel — and the WebPKI ecosystem underneath all of it is undergoing its largest structural change in a generation: shorter certificate lifetimes, a shift toward post-quantum-safe signature algorithms, and new automation and trust-establishment mechanisms on the horizon.</p> <p>We are investing in the next generation of Cloudflare’s PKI and cryptographic infrastructure to keep up with, and stay ahead of, that shift. As a Senior Software Engineer on this team, you will design and build the systems that manage certificate lifecycles, protect and use private keys at scale, integrate with hardware security modules, automate issuance and renewal, and take Cloudflare’s cryptographic stack into the post-quantum era. You will work at the intersection of applied cryptography, distributed systems, and security engineering — on infrastructure that a large fraction of the Internet quietly depends on.</p> <p>This is an early-days role on a growing team. The design decisions you make in the first year will shape how Cloudflare’s certificate and key infrastructure operates for years to come.</p> <h3 id="JD—SeniorSoftwareEngineer,PKI&CryptographicSystems(MergedDraft)-Responsibilities">Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Design and build core PKI systems</strong> — certificate lifecycle management, X.509 issuance and validation logic, key parameter enforcement, and policy engines aligned with industry standards including CA/Browser Forum guidance and browser root program policies.</li> <li><strong>Own the cryptographic core.</strong> Integrate with FIPS 140-2 Level 3 (and, where required, Level 4) HSMs via PKCS#11 and vendor-native SDKs; build key ceremony and key-lifecycle tooling; enforce strict key-usage boundaries in code.</li> <li><strong>Automate at scale.</strong> Build and evolve ACME-based issuance and renewal pipelines, short-lived certificate rotation, and revocation mechanisms that serve at Cloudflare’s global scale.</li> <li><strong>Instrument transparency and audit trails.</strong> Integrate with Certificate Transparency, build append-only tamper-evident logging, and design evidence pipelines that hold up to rigorous third-party audit.</li> <li><strong>Maintain accreditation and respond to a changing compliance landscape.</strong> PKI operations must maintain compliance under CA/B Forum, WebTrust, and root store program frameworks. You will be aware of, and adapt to, changes in relevant policies, participate in public incident disclosure and discourse, and participate in regular third-party audits.</li> <li><strong>Represent Cloudflare in the WebPKI community.</strong> Write public CA incident reports and serve as a primary contact with the WebPKI community; clear technical writing is core to this role.</li> <li><strong>Ship the post-quantum future.</strong> Contribute to Cloudflare’s ongoing post-quantum migration — including work on post-quantum encryption and authentication — so that Cloudflare’s cryptographic infrastructure stays ahead of the transition.</li> <li><strong>Own code end-to-end</strong> from design through production incident response. Cryptographic infrastructure cannot silently fail; you will build the observability, runbooks, and on-call posture that keep the service inside SLO.</li> <li><strong>Partner across the org</strong> — with the SSL/TLS product teams, the HSM and data-centre infrastructure teams, the Cloudflare Research applied cryptography group, and adjacent product teams that consume PKI as a platform.</li> <li><strong>Raise the bar.</strong> Mentor other engineers joining an early-stage team, run design reviews, and establish the engineering standards, threat models, and secure-development practices this team will operate under for years.</li> </ul> <h3 id="JD—SeniorSoftwareEngineer,PKI&CryptographicSystems(MergedDraft)-DesirableSkills,Knowledge&Experience">Desirable Skills, Knowledge & Experience</h3> <ul> <li><strong>5+ years of production systems software experience,</strong> with a strong operational track record — you have carried a pager for something people depend on.</li> <li><strong>Deep working knowledge of applied cryptography and PKI.</strong> X.509, ASN.1/DER, RFC 5280, CRL distribution, Certificate Transparency, ACME, and the CA/Browser Forum Baseline Requirements. You do not need to be a cryptographer, but you need to reason precisely about certificate profiles, key parameters, and issuance policy.</li> <li><strong>Familiarity with HSMs.</strong> PKCS#11 integration, key ceremonies, key-attestation flows, and understanding of what FIPS 140-2/3 validation actually means in production.</li> <li><strong>Strong systems programming background</strong> in at least one of Go, Rust, or C/C++.</li> <li><strong>Distributed systems fluency</strong> — you have built or operated globally replicated, availability-critical services with strict correctness guarantees.</li> <li><strong>Experience designing and operating database schemas for high-integrity systems</strong> (Postgres or equivalent).</li> <li><strong>Security-hardened system design instincts</strong> — threat modelling, defence in depth, least privilege, and secure key handling.</li> <li><strong>Comfort with high-consequence work.</strong> A mis-issued or mis-revoked certificate is a public, industry-visible event. You need the temperament to move quickly and the discipline to be careful.</li> </ul> <h3 id="JD—SeniorSoftwareEngineer,PKI&CryptographicSystems(MergedDraft)-BonusPoints">Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Direct experience working on or with a publicly-trusted or private CA, or a large-scale internal PKI (Let’s Encrypt / Boulder, Google Trust Services, DigiCert, Sectigo, ISRG, Entrust, Microsoft PKI, HashiCorp Vault PKI, step-ca, CFSSL, or an internal CA at scale).</li> <li>Experience with <code>crypto/x509</code>, BoringSSL, OpenSSL/AWS-LC, CFSSL, or an equivalent PKI codebase.</li> <li>Experience with WebTrust for CAs / WebTrust BR / WebTrust Network Security audit engagements.</li> <li>Familiarity with post-quantum cryptography — ML-DSA, ML-KEM, hybrid signature schemes, and the current state of PQ signature standardisation.</li> <li>Familiarity with emerging browser trust-establishment proposals (e.g. Merkle Tree Certificates).</li> <li>Prior participation in the CA/Browser Forum, IETF LAMPS / TLS / PLANTS / PQUIP working groups, the transparency.dev community, or a browser root program review.</li> <li>Experience running or automating offline key ceremonies.</li> <li>Experience operating Certificate Transparency log infrastructure or CT monitoring at scale.</li> <li>Familiarity with formal methods, differential fuzzing, or property-based testing for cryptographic protocol code.</li> <li>Kubernetes experience.</li> </ul> <h4 data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h4> <ul data-path-to-node="1"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="1,0,0">For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €66,000 - You will lead the technical path for complex opportunities, translating customer risks, operational requirements, and business priorities into architectures that give stakeholders confidence to adopt Cloudflare.</p> <p>Zero Trust is the primary focus of this role, with enterprise WAN and AI as the next priorities. Successful candidates will bring meaningful customer-facing Zero Trust experience and practical enterprise WAN experience. Email Security experience is welcome but not required. You do not need to be an expert in every part of the portfolio, but you must be able to connect these technologies into a coherent customer strategy and continue developing your expertise as the market evolves.</p> <p>This is a Senior-level individual-contributor role for a curious, commercially aware technical leader who can guide customer evaluations, collaborate across teams, and improve the effectiveness of the broader field organization.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Serve as a trusted technical advisor, leading discovery and designing Cloudflare One architectures that isolation, device posture, and secure connectivity.</li> <li>Design WAN transformation solutions that connect users, offices, data centers, and cloud environments using Cloudflare WAN and Context Protocol (MCP) server controls, and agentic AI governance.</li> <li>Use AI tools thoughtfully to improve research, customer preparation, technical analysis, content creation, demonstrations, automation, and the repeatability of field activities.</li> <li>Support broader Cloudflare One opportunities involving Email Security when relevant to the customer's strategy and requirements.</li> demonstration and proof-of-value patterns, technical guidance, and lightweight automation, and coach peers and partners to execute more effectively.</li> <li>Capture customer feedback, market trends, Services, Support, or implementation teams.</li> </ul> <h3>Qualifications</h3> <p>Successful candidates are customer-focused technical leaders who combine broad security and networking experience with networking, or network transformation.</li> <li>Active professional use of AI tools and demonstrated commitment to learning how AI platforms, AI-enabled threats, data exposure, and governance affect enterprise customers.</li> <li>Experience designing or integrating enterprise security solutions with one or more of the following: identity providers, Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace, public cloud environments, APIs, and SIEM or log-analytics platforms.</li> <li>Proven ownership of technical evaluations or proofs of value, including discovery, architecture, scope, success criteria, deployment dependencies, stakeholder communication, technical decision management, and technical close.</li> <li>Strong written, presentation, and demonstration skills across practitioner, architect, and executive audiences, with the ability to connect technical capabilities to risk reduction, operational improvement, and business outcomes.</li> <li>Ability to collaborate across Sales, Product, Engineering, Support, partners, and customer teams while managing competing priorities and deadlines.</li> </ul> <h3>Preferred Qualifications</h3> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience with Cloudflare One Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. In this role, you will think like a storyteller—transforming our deep data pools, research, and corporate milestones into a sophisticated, multi-platform strategy. You will oversee global social media, executive digital positioning, web-based storytelling, and community-driven engagement to build a cohesive, influential, and authentic digital brand.</p> <p>You are a visionary storyteller, a sharp strategist, and an Internet-native thinker. You understand that how we communicate on GitHub, Reddit, Hacker News, and YouTube matters just as much as a headline in The Wall Street Journal. This role isn't just about managing a content calendar; it’s about strategically deploying Cloudflare's voice on LinkedIn, X, and via digital assets to influence enterprise buyers, developers, tech policy leaders, and the global business community.</p> <p>If you understand Internet subcultures, appreciate a great tech meme, and know how to foster genuine developer loyalty at scale, this is your sandbox.</p> <h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Architect the Digital Strategy:</strong> Define the overarching vision for Cloudflare’s corporate digital channels, ensuring our voice is distinct, authoritative, and deeply understood by tech-savvy audiences and enterprise buyers alike.</li> <li><strong>Elevate Executive Positioning:</strong> Partner directly with our executive leadership team to shape and scale their personal digital brands, turning complex industry trends into compelling online narratives.</li> <li><strong>Drive Multi-Channel Storytelling: </strong>Manage our corporate social media channels (X/Twitter, LinkedIn, YouTube, etc.) while expanding our strategic footprint into emerging platforms and technical communities.</li> <li><strong>Bridge Tech and Culture:</strong> Translate highly complex technical milestones—from network infrastructure to post-quantum cryptography—into creative, engaging, and accessible digital content.</li> <li><strong>Crisis & Rapid Response: </strong>Act as a critical node in our crisis management engine. Workday PRISM or other advanced modules a plus.</li> <li>Demonstrated expertise working with large HR data sets and creating scalable, automated reporting solutions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $xxx-xxx</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. title: Designer/ Art Director Healthcare (m/w/d)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Ogilvy  </strong></p> <p>Ogilvy has been creating impact for brands through iconic, culture-changing, value-driving ideas since the company was founded by David Ogilvy more than 75 years ago. It builds on that rich legacy through Borderless Creativity—innovating at the intersection of intelligence, imagination and influence, with experts across advertising, sports & entertainment, PR & social, consulting, and health collaborating seamlessly across more than 120 offices spanning 90 countries. Ogilvy was named <a href="https://www.ogilvy.com/ideas/ogilvy-brings-home-network-year-2026-cannes-lions-international-festival-creativity">Network of the Year</a> at the 2026 Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity and<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span><a href="https://www.ogilvy.com/ideas/ogilvy-tops-warc-effective-100-creative-100-4th-straight-year" data-outlook-id="e2c78315-ff05-4544-925f-9288319dea2c">ranks</a><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>as the #1 global agency network for creative excellence and effectiveness by WARC for the fourth consecutive year, signifying its ability to deliver creative solutions that drive unreasonable impact for clients and communities. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>For more information, visit <a href="http://www.ogilvy.com/" target="_blank" data-outlook-id="39833259-880d-4fd8-930f-0d84b1c14850">Ogilvy.com</a>, and follow us on<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/ogilvy/" data-outlook-id="735e393e-6e8a-4ca8-804a-74f1bd8166b6">LinkedIn</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/ogilvy" data-outlook-id="d10960ce-761b-48c5-81d5-0a7c4cc6013a">X</a>,<a href="https://www.instagram.com/ogilvy/" data-outlook-id="92ffcb70-6ca7-4d9a-88d5-c130e36e6c4f"> Instagram</a>, and<a href="https://www.facebook.com/ogilvy/" data-outlook-id="3bd2010d-00a2-401b-8cfb-7e8c24deac52"> Facebook.</a></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>About WPP</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <u><a href="http://wpp.com/" data-outlook-id="7f087527-f491-4cb6-a79d-3b4a67d1ec89">WPP.com</a></u>.</p> <p> </p></div><p>Ogilvy Health DACH ist eine grenzenlos agierende Kreativagentur, die durch nahtlose Zusammenarbeit über Disziplinen und Märkte hinweg Projekte realisiert – von lokalen Initiativen bis hin zu globalen Kampagnen. Unser Team arbeitet an der Schnittstelle von <strong>Healthcare, Social Media, Strategie, Experience und Influence</strong>.</p> <p>Von Zürich aus betreuen wir das Healthcare-Portfolio von Ogilvy für die DACH-Region sowie ausgewählte internationale Kund:innen aus den Bereichen Pharma, Biotech und Medizintechnik. Unser interdisziplinäres Health-Team vereint Account Management, Medical Writing, PR, Digital, Strategie und Kreation.</p> <p>Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir eine:n<strong> Designer/ Art Director Health (m/w/d) </strong>in Berlin, Hamburg, Frankfurt/ Main, Düsseldorf oder Zürich. </p> <p> Das bieten wir:</p> <ul> <li>Möglichkeit zur Arbeit im Mobile Office (bis zu 100%) </li> <li>Nutzung unseres WPP Weiterbildungsnetzwerkes, inkl. LinkedIn Learning </li> <li>Unterstützung bei der privaten Altersvorsorge und die Gewährung von vermögenswirksamen Leistungen </li> <li>Jubiläumsprämien in Form von zusätzlichen Urlaubstagen </li> <li>Möglichkeit zur Nutzung eines Job Bikes </li> <li>Erweiterte Betriebliche Krankenversicherung mit einem zusätzlichen Budget von bis zu 300€ im Jahr </li> <li>Zugriff auf unser Employee Assistance Programm TELUS Health </li> <li>Kostenlose Nutzung der Headspace-App </li> <li>Subventionierte Gympass-Mitgliedschaft </li> </ul> <p>Deine Aufgaben: </p> <p>Als Art Director Health entwickelst und gestaltest du Kommunikationslösungen für renommierte Kund:innen aus dem Healthcare- und Pharmabereich. Dein Aufgabenspektrum reicht – je nach Projekt – von konkreten Kommunikationsmitteln wie Flyern, Broschüren, Präsentationen und Sales-Materialien bis hin zu visuellen Identitäten, digitalen Inhalten und integrierten Kampagnen.<br>Du entwickelst starke visuelle Konzepte, übersetzt medizinische und wissenschaftliche Inhalte in klare, relevante Kommunikation und begleitest Projekte von der ersten Idee bis zur finalen Umsetzung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Medical Writing, Client Services, Strategie, Creative Direction, Digital, PR, Production und externen Partner:innen zusammen.<br>Die Rolle erfordert kreative Exzellenz und ein gutes Verständnis für die besonderen Anforderungen der Healthcare-Kommunikation – insbesondere für Rx-Produkte, regulatorische Vorgaben und Review-Prozesse.</p> <ul> <li>Konzeption und Gestaltung von Kommunikationsmitteln für Print, Digital, Social Media und Bewegtbild – von Flyern, Broschüren und Präsentationen bis zu digitalen Assets und Kampagnenformaten</li> <li>Entwicklung visueller Identitäten, Corporate Designs, Branding-Lösungen, Kampagnenwelten und visueller Narrative für Pharma-, Biotech- und Medtech-Kund:innen</li> <li>Übersetzung medizinischer und wissenschaftlicher Inhalte in klare, zielgruppengerechte und visuell überzeugende Lösungen, insbesondere für Rx-, Disease-Awareness- und Patient-Engagement-Projekte</li> <li>Präsentation und überzeugende Vermittlung von Ideen gegenüber Kund:innen sowie Begleitung der Umsetzung und Sicherstellung der gestalterischen Qualität über alle Kanäle und Formate hinweg</li> <li>Zusammenarbeit mit internen Fachbereichen und externen Partner:innen wie Fotograf:innen, Filmproduktionen, Freelancer:innen und Partneragenturen sowie Unterstützung bei Pitches, Neugeschäftsprojekten und der Weiterentwicklung bestehender Kund:innenbeziehungen</li> </ul> <p>Was du mitbringst: </p> <ul> <li>Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Grafiker:in EFZ, Studium in Visueller Kommunikation, Grafikdesign oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Art Director in einer Healthcare-, Pharma- oder Kommunikationsagentur</li> <li>Fundierte Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Kund:innen aus Pharma, Biotech und/oder Medtech sowie nachweisbare Erfahrung mit Kommunikationsmassnahmen für Rx-Produkte</li> <li>Gutes Verständnis für medizinische Inhalte, regulatorische Anforderungen und Review-Prozesse in der Healthcare-Kommunikation</li> <li>Ausgeprägte konzeptionelle und gestalterische Fähigkeiten, ein überzeugendes Portfolio sowie sicherer Umgang mit der Adobe Creative Cloud und gängigen Design- und Präsentationstools</li> <li>Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten, ein sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Kund:innen sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift</li> <li>Erfahrung mit Patient Engagement, PR- und Awareness-Kampagnen sowie Kenntnisse in Motion Design und Social/Digital Content Creation sind ein Plus.</li> <li>Du verbindest kreative Exzellenz mit strategischem Denken und kannst komplexe Inhalte schnell erfassen und in relevante visuelle Ideen übersetzen.</li> <li>Du arbeitest proaktiv, selbständig, lösungsorientiert und zuverlässig – sowohl an grösseren Projekten als auch an konkreten Kommunikationsmitteln im Tagesgeschäft.</li> <li>Du kommunizierst klar, präsentierst sicher und kannst Kund:innen für deine Ideen begeistern. Die Zusammenarbeit in interdisziplinären und internationalen Teams macht dir Freude.</li> <li>Du bringst Resilienz und Flexibilität für einen dynamischen und phasenweise intensiven Agenturalltag mit. Nicht alles ist planbar, Prioritäten und Timings können sich kurzfristig ändern.</li> <li>Auch bei hohem Tempo und mehreren parallelen Projekten bewahrst du den Überblick, hast einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch und übernimmst Verantwortung. In intensiven Phasen bist du bereit, gemeinsam mit dem Team die Extrameile zu gehen.</li> </ul> <p>Wir glauben an die Kraft von Diversität und Kollaboration. Den Herausforderungen der heutigen Welt können wir nur gemeinsam begegnen. Wir verpflichten uns daher, für den Job in Frage kommende Bewerber:innen ausschließlich nach ihren Fähigkeiten und grundsätzlich unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, sexueller Orientierung, Behinderung oder Religion zu beurteilen.</p> <p>Das klingt nach einer spannenden Herausforderung? Sehr gut, dein Ansprechpartner Kai Schlüter freut sich über deine Bewerbung!<br>Aus Gründen der Nachhaltigkeit und des Datenschutzes bitten wir darum, Bewerbungsunterlagen ausschließlich über unsere Bewerber:innenplattform Greenhouse an uns zu senden. Wir würden uns freuen, wenn auf das Mitsenden eines Fotos verzichtet würde.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>At Ogilvy, our people are at the heart of what we do: a creative agency that sparks game-changing ideas across culture and business through collaboration, integrity, and a celebration of self-expression. </p> <p>We believe in building powerful teams with purpose - and we relentlessly curate transformative initiatives that make our commitment to fairness, and equity a reality. </p> <p>Our ultimate mission is to leave a positive impact on the world, creating a better future for all, while supporting and uplifting the global communities we serve.  This is central to our mantra of Borderless Creativity.</p> <p><span data-teams="true">Ogilvy is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.</span></p> <p>If you need any assistance seeking a job opportunity, or if you need reasonable accommodation with the application process, please contact us at ----- Please note that this contact is only for candidates who are requesting accommodation. Emails for other purposes, including application status requests, will not receive a response.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Staff System Architect -SNSPD Systems
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About IonQ: </strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2F&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=IonQ%2C+Inc&index=7&md5=0818ffbedc6dbad8c4d1611ac94c2a0f" target="_blank">IonQ, Inc</a></u>. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=Amazon+Web+Services%2C&index=8&md5=a7f94ee9b71a392dca3cd6c413722e51" target="_blank">Amazon Web Services, </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=and&index=9&md5=2bed627b388878763f41ffe0e4edb16c" target="_blank">and </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=AstraZeneca&index=10&md5=757c1f2c2ec94cf3982700106122164f" target="_blank">AstraZeneca</a></u> achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-achieves-landmark-result-setting-new-world-record-in-quantum-computing&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=setting+a+world+record+in+quantum+computing+performance&index=11&md5=32e9cb88afbd439026a352666cc72c91" target="_blank">setting a world record in quantum computing performance</a></u>.<br><br>Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  </p></div><p><span class="s1"><span class="TextRun SCXW3980620 BCX0" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW3980620 BCX0"><strong>What to expect</strong></span></span></span></p> <p>We are looking for a Staff System Architect to be fully dedicated to the SNSPD product line, with a strong focus on leading the technical architecture and roadmap for our next-generation rack-mountable SNSPD (Superconducting Nanowire Single-Photon Detector) platform. This role is critical to defining and guiding the technical evolution of our cutting-edge cryogenic photon detection systems, ensuring architectural coherence across hardware, software, and integration domains while supporting our product vision and market requirements.</p> <p>We are looking for a proven architect of complex, multi-domain instruments, whether from space systems, astronomical instrumentation, scientific or medical imaging, electron or advanced optical microscopy, semiconductor equipment, or comparable fields who can bring that system-level rigour to our platform.</p> <p><span class="s1"><span class="TextRun SCXW3980620 BCX0" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW3980620 BCX0"><strong><span class="TextRun SCXW243108471 BCX0" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW243108471 BCX0">What you'll be doing</span></span></strong></span></span></span></p> <p>In this role, you will be an integral part of the development process for IDQ's SNSPD platform, with applications across quantum computing, networking, and sensing. You will be at the intersection of quantum photonics, cryogenic systems engineering and embedded systems to create scalable, maintainable architectures for autonomous 24/7 detector operations.</p> <p>You will take ownership of the end-to-end system architecture of the SNSPD platform, ensuring alignment with a shared long-term product vision while translating product requirements into clear system-level designs and specifications. This includes defining system structure, interfaces, and key architectural decisions, as well as driving critical trade-offs across performance, cost, scalability, and integration. You will also align engineering execution with the architectural vision, guiding system integration and resolving complex cross-domain design challenges.</p> <p>In addition, you will play a key role in shaping the technology roadmap and driving the evolution of the platform, continuously evaluating and introducing new technologies where relevant to maintain innovation and competitiveness.</p> <ul> <li>Lead system architecture, design decisions, and cross-functional alignment to ensure a scalable and high-performing SNSPD platform</li> <li>Drive technology roadmap, integration, and innovation by evaluating and implementing new technologies</li> </ul> <p><strong><span class="s1">What you'll bring</span></strong></p> <p>We are seeking an experienced professional with a Master's degree (PhD preferred) in physics, electrical engineering, photonics, or a related field, and 7+ years of experience in the design of complex, multi-domain systems, with demonstrated ownership of system architecture. The ideal candidate has architected instruments or platforms of comparable complexity, combining optics or photonics with electronics, mechanics or thermal design, and embedded or software components and has proven experience integrating these technologies into cohesive, high-performing products.</p> <p>You will demonstrate strong technical leadership across multidisciplinary teams, with the ability to clearly communicate complex system architectures to a wide range of stakeholders. This includes ensuring alignment, supporting informed decision-making, and driving successful collaboration across functions to deliver robust and scalable system designs.</p> <ul> <li>Extensive experience in system architecture and multi-domain integration, with strong system-level thinking</li> <li>Proven technical leadership and communication skills, enabling alignment and effective decision-making across diverse teams</li> </ul> <p><strong><span class="s1">You'll be a great fit with</span></strong></p> <ul> <li>Background in domains of comparable complexity: space instrumentation, astronomy, high-end microscopy or imaging, semiconductor or scientific equipment</li> <li>Experience with photonics, low-noise electronics, cryogenics, or vacuum systems</li> <li>Experience with SNSPDs, single-photon detection, or quantum systems</li> <li>Experience bringing industrialized or rack-mountable systems to market</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment. </p> <p>At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.<br> <br>We are committed to equity and justice. We welcome different voices and viewpoints and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>US Technical Jobs. </strong>The position you are applying for will require access to technology that is subject to U.S. export control and government contract restrictions.  Employment with IonQ is contingent on either verifying “U.S. Person” (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum) status for export controls and government contracts work, obtaining any necessary license, and/or confirming the availability of a license exception under U.S. export controls.  Please note that in the absence of confirming you are a U.S. Person for export control and government contracts work purposes, IonQ may choose not to apply for a license or decline to use a license exception (if available) for you to access export-controlled technology that may require authorization, and similarly, you may not qualify for government contracts work that requires U.S. Persons, and IonQ may decline to proceed with your application on those bases alone.  Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.  </p> <p><strong>US Non-Technical Jobs. </strong>Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.</p> <p> </p> <p>If you are interested in being a part of our team and mission, we encourage you to apply! </p></div> Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-achieves-landmark-result-setting-new-world-record-in-quantum-computing&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=setting+a+world+record+in+quantum+computing+performance&index=11&md5=32e9cb88afbd439026a352666cc72c91" target="_blank">setting a world record in quantum computing performance</a></u>.<br><br>Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  </p></div><p><strong>What to Expect</strong></p> <div> <p>We are seeking a <strong>Senior Mechanical Engineer</strong> to join our R&D team in Geneva. In this hands-on role, you will design, validate, and continuously improve mechanical enclosures and subsystems that integrate optical and electronic components for our quantum products.</p> <p>You will take ownership of mechanical solutions from early prototyping through to industrialized product release, with a strong focus on delivering compact, robust, and cost-effective designs. Your work will ensure compliance with dimensional, thermal, and manufacturability requirements, including for highly demanding applications such as cryogenic systems.</p> </div> <p><strong>What You'll be Doing</strong></p> <p>You will be responsible for the mechanical development of cutting-edge quantum systems, translating requirements into detailed designs and verified assemblies. This includes 3D modelling and documentation, engineering calculations and simulations, and hands-on testing to validate thermal dissipation and mechanical performance. You will collaborate closely with optical, electronic, and system engineers to optimise interfaces and block specifications, and you will engage with external suppliers to prototype and manufacture parts efficiently. As a senior contributor, you will help improve design practices, promote a rigorous engineering approach, and support multiple projects as a mechanical subject-matter expert.</p> <ul> <li>Own mechanical design from prototype to industrialised product, including CAD documentation, assembly bring-up, and validation testing</li> <li>Drive thermal management (heat sinking, conduction/convection, interfaces and materials), dimensional stability, and manufacturability through design, simulation, and optimization, working closely with cross-functional teams and suppliers</li> <li>Perform thermal simulation to predict temperatures, gradients, and heat flows; correlate models with lab measurements and iterate designs and their optimization accordingly</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you'll Bring</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a candidate with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Microtechnology, or equivalent, and at least five years of relevant experience in mechanical design and product development. You have hands-on experience designing with sheet metal and/or machined parts, and a strong ability to develop thermal dissipation solutions for compact systems. Familiarity with cryogenic systems is an advantage.</p> <p>You are rigorous, organised, and proactive, able to work independently while collaborating effectively in a multidisciplinary and Agile environment. Strong communication skills are essential, with fluency in English required; French is considered a plus.</p> <ul> <li>Solid mechanical engineering foundation with proven experience delivering compact, industrial-grade designs</li> <li>Structured, collaborative engineer with strong communication skills and a hands-on approach to validation</li> <li>Knowledge of applicable norms and compliance requirements, including EMC and electrical/product safety aspects</li> </ul> <p><strong>You'll be a great fit if:</strong></p> <div> <p>You bring a track record of taking ownership of mechanical subsystems across multiple development phases—requirements, design, verification, and industrialisation—and you are comfortable acting as the mechanical reference point within a multidisciplinary R&D team. Experience with compact thermal management and exposure to cryogenic constraints are strong assets.</p> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment. </p> <p>At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.<br> <br>We are committed to equity and justice. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>US Technical Jobs. </strong>The position you are applying for will require access to technology that is subject to U.S. export control and government contract restrictions.  Employment with IonQ is contingent on either verifying “U.S. Person” (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum) status for export controls and government contracts work, obtaining any necessary license, and/or confirming the availability of a license exception under U.S. export controls.  Please note that in the absence of confirming you are a U.S. Person for export control and government contracts work purposes, IonQ may choose not to apply for a license or decline to use a license exception (if available) for you to access export-controlled technology that may require authorization, and similarly, you may not qualify for government contracts work that requires U.S. Persons, and IonQ may decline to proceed with your application on those bases alone.  Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.  </p> <p><strong>US Non-Technical Jobs. </strong>Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.</p> <p> </p> <p>If you are interested in being a part of our team and mission, we encourage you to apply! </p></div> Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow
